Job description:

  • Carry out routine servicing of lift equipment, including minor repair work and the routine replacement of components and in accordance with approved company procedures (PPE, PDA, Expert+ etc)

  • Conduct the routine inspection and adjustment of lift in accordance with approved procedures. Reinstate lift and complete service documentation

  • Carrying out more advanced fault finding and diagnostic procedures using a range of techniques, technical manuals and appropriate test equipment, restoring equipment to service

  • Conduct site survey

Profile description:

  • Previous experience in lift servicing, maintenance or repairs is preferred

  • NVQ Level 3 in Lift Maintenance (or an equivalent qualification)

  • Excellent fault-finding, diagnostic and problem-solving skills

  • A full UK driving licence

  • Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines and maintain high standards of efficiency

  • Confident working independently, with a flexible and proactive approach

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships with clients, Service Leaders and Inspectors

  • Good manual dexterity, with the ability to safely use hands, arms and feet for repetitive tasks, operate hand and power tools, and complete written records

  • Private medical cover with a trusted provider, plus 24/7 virtual GP access

  • Employee Assistance Programme offering confidential support

  • Access to a range of employee benefits, including Tech and Cycle to Work schemes, plus exclusive retailer discounts

description:

We are looking for a qualified and compassionate School Counsellor to support the mental health, clinical case management, and social-emotional development of student adolescents at a secondary school in Yishun.

title: Sr. Program Manager
description:
Job Summary

The Sr. Program Manager provides strategic leadership and independent oversight across multiple operational functions (HR, procurement, D&T, finance, contracting, comms, domains), ensuring seamless execution of complex programs and compliance with federal standards. This role exercises significant judgment in prioritizing initiatives, resolving operational challenges, and implementing process improvements. The Sr. Program Manager independently develops strategies for operational matters, while proactively identifying risks and driving mitigation plans. Acting as a key decision-maker, this position collaborates with stakeholders to align program objectives with organizational goals, ensures resource optimization, and leads cross-functional teams to achieve mission-critical outcomes for federal programs and projects.

Note, the candidate must be a US Citizen and be able to pass and maintain a Public Trust background check.

Primary Job Functions

  • Collaborate closely with the Operations Lead and Alliance Director to translate strategic and operational objectives into actionable plans, ensuring day-to-day execution aligns with program goals and organizational priorities.
  • Direct and advise on operational activities in the absence of the Operations Lead, ensuring continuity of critical workflows, resolving issues, and making informed decisions to maintain alignment with strategic objectives and organizational standards.
  • Interpret and apply federal compliance standards to daily operations, advising teams on best practices and ensuring adherence across program areas.
  • Develop and execute Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across key operational domains—including but not limited to HR, Finance, Contracting, and Communications—in collaboration with team members, ensuring clarity, consistency, and alignment with organizational standards while driving adoption and continuous improvement.
  • Drive and optimize operational workflows by independently establishing priorities, ensuring alignment with established SOPs, proactively identifying deviations, and implementing corrective actions or process improvements to maintain efficiency and compliance.
  • Oversee organizational health, by reviewing performance indicators, and operational activities driving improvements independently through the implementation of a standardized and repeatable project review process
  • Analyze monthly financial performance, including labor, expenditures, and profit/loss metrics, and collaborate with the Operations Lead, Alliance Director, and Finance Manager to identify trends, recommend corrective actions, and drive and own improvements that align with organizational objectives.
  • Coordinate and influence communications between internal teams and external stakeholders in partnership with the Communications Director, ensuring timely information flow, alignment with messaging standards, and proactively resolving conflicts or bottlenecks.
  • Provide strategic oversight and guidance throughout all phases of the contracting process with clients and subcontractors, including proposal development, by ensuring alignment with program objectives, advising on compliance requirements, and influencing decision-making to support successful outcomes in close coordination with contracting and legal teams.
  • Collaborates with marketing and business development in the preparation of proposed bids, staff calculations, procedures manual, safety plan development, SOPs, quality assurance and control plans, labor management, payroll management and equipment & materials management.
  • Develop and present reports, dashboards, and presentations for internal and client reviews, using judgment to highlight key insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Education, Experience and Certification

REQUIRED: Bachelor's degree in business, economics, or operationally related field.

REQUIRED: 8 years' Experience in projects or operations management position or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the job. Highly experienced in government contracting and financial administration.

Working Conditions

  • Occasional exposure to elements such as heat, cold, noise, dust, dirt, chemicals, etc.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge of U.S. Government procurement regulations and labor laws.
  • Advanced management and employee relations skills.
  • Ability to work independently and recommend and direct solutions to problems.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint and Project.
  • Superior attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and project management tools.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while attending to multiple tasks and demands.
  • Must be able to successfully pass a government background screen for admittance to jobsites.

Up to 10%

title: Data Analyst Manager - DHA
description:
Data Analyst Manager


Location: Remote (U.S)

Level: Manager

Clearance: Public Trust

Montcure, LLC is an SBA-certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business delivering financial management, audit readiness, internal controls, data analytics, and program support to federal clients across the Department of Defense and civilian agencies. This role supports a Department of Defense health program serving wounded, ill, and injured service members and their caregivers.

About the Role

We're seeking a Data Analyst Manager to build and run the recurring report pipeline — monthly performance, quarterly quality assurance and caregiver compensation, and annual and survey outcome reporting — and to maintain the written procedure behind each product. You'll own cohort extraction and validation, maintain the caregiver compensation database, and serve as the independent check on other analysts' output.

What You'll Do

  • Build and run the recurring report pipeline: monthly performance, quarterly quality assurance and caregiver compensation, and annual and survey outcome reporting
  • Maintain the written procedure for each recurring reporting product
  • Perform cohort extraction and validation
  • Maintain the caregiver compensation database
  • Deliver system user training
  • Re-perform calculations as the independent quality check on other analysts' output

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5+ years of data analysis experience
  • Demonstrated ownership of recurring analytic reports from extract through delivery
  • SQL; advanced Excel; Power BI or comparable visualization tooling
  • Experience documenting data lineage and maintaining written reporting procedures
  • Experience performing quality control and re-performance on another analyst's work
  • Experience extracting and validating population or cohort lists from a system of record

Preferred Qualifications

  • Recognized data analytics certification
  • Experience working with survey data and response analysis
  • Experience maintaining a program database of record
  • Experience delivering end-user system training
  • Experience producing statistical charts including box, violin, and control charts
  • Familiarity with military health or personnel data

What Success Looks Like

  • Owns the numbers end-to-end and can explain exactly how any figure was derived
  • Comfortable serving as the quality check on someone else's work without friction
  • Documentation-minded — writes procedures others can actually follow
  • Reliable against recurring, calendar-locked reporting cycles

Benefits

  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Paid time off (PTO)

Status: Contingency – This work is contingent upon award.

Salary: $100,000 - 120,000 per year, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Montcure, LLC is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Vice President, Global Benefits
description:
Vice President, Global Benefits

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives. We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work. Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at

The VP, Global Benefits partners with the Head of Total Rewards to execute Circana’s global benefits strategy, and is the primary owner of benefits governance, budget, vendor and broker management, regulatory compliance, and operational delivery. This role is accountable for centralizing benefits delivery currently dispersed across regional HR Business Partner teams into a consistent, governed, enterprise capability, in service of Circana’s HR vision of a simple, proactive, and scalable employee experience.

Working closely with Compensation, Total Rewards leadership, HR Technology, Legal, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, HR Business Partners, and business leaders, this role ensures benefits programs are designed and administered consistently, equitably, competitively, and in compliance with local regulatory requirements across all countries in which Circana operates.

The role provides strategic and operational leadership over the global benefits portfolio, builds the governance model, operating model, and data foundation needed for scalable delivery, and leads a growing team of benefits professionals as the function centralizes. This is a unique opportunity to help build and modernize Circana's global benefits capability at a pivotal stage of growth. This role is best suited for a leader who has successfully built, transformed, or centralized benefits capabilities and can quickly establish credibility, influence, and results in a complex global environment.

This is an evolving role, built for how work should be organized in an AI-enabled function. The leader will architect a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, anchored on the organization's most important priorities (determined through our Business Strategy, HR Mission and Vision, and People Strategy), deliberately elevating team members to complex, judgment-driven, and people-centric work while putting automation and AI to work on repetitive, transactional tasks.

Job Responsibilities

Global Benefits Strategy Partnership

  • Partner with the Head of Total Rewards to shape and execute the global benefits strategy, ensuring programs remain market-competitive, cost-effective, and aligned to Circana’s Total Rewards philosophy and talent priorities.
  • Oversee execution of global benefit design, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns day-to-day design decisions across health & welfare, retirement/pension, wellbeing, and voluntary benefits.
  • Partner with Compensation on the broader Total Rewards Framework to ensure benefits are positioned consistently with pay philosophy and market positioning.

Transformation & M&A Integration

  • Oversee harmonization of benefits plan design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring outcomes align to enterprise strategy and budget.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for benefits due diligence and integration planning for future M&A activity, partnering with the Director, Benefit Design on design execution.
  • Approve new-country benefit program design led by the Director, Benefit Design, ensuring alignment to global strategy and budget.

Governance & Centralization

  • Build and lead the governance model, standards, decision rights, and operating framework needed to centralize benefits administration currently managed by regional HR Business Partners.
  • Establish and lead the transition plan, timeline, and change management approach for migrating benefits from HRBP teams to a centralized Benefit function.
  • Set the standards for global benefits policies, procedures, and documentation, and govern their consistent application across regions.

Vendor, Broker & Financial Management

  • Own broker, carrier, and third-party administrator relationships and contracts globally for material renewals, partnering with Procurement on RFP mechanics and formal vendor process, and using AI-assisted analysis for renewal-package review and first-pass prep.
  • Lead negotiation and final decisions on broker/carrier renewals and RFP outcomes for material renewals, ensuring service quality and cost discipline; routine renewal documentation and coordination is supported by the Benefits Vendor & Systems Coordinator.
  • Own the global benefits budget; monitor spending, forecast costs, and identify efficiency opportunities in partnership with Finance.

Compliance & Regulatory Governance

  • Ensure compliance with applicable benefits regulations across all countries of operation, including ERISA, ACA, and country-specific statutory requirements.
  • Partner with Legal and Total Rewards on regulatory readiness for initiatives such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive and country-specific benefits mandates (e.g., India).
  • Maintain audit readiness, required filings, and documentation for all benefits programs.

Administration, Systems & Data

  • Ensure end-to-end benefits administration — including enrollment, life events, leave of absence coordination, and escalations — is delivered effectively by the Manager, Benefits – Administration & Delivery, determining outsourcing/co-sourcing opportunities as needed.
  • Partner with HR Technology/EE&T on benefits system configuration, data integrity, and integration with the broader HR technology ecosystem, including the Job Architecture data foundation.
  • Establish benefits reporting and analytics that support decision-making — cost, utilization, and compliance data framed to inform plan renewal, vendor negotiation, and design choices, not just tracked for visibility.
  • Leverage AI and automation to redesign repetitive, transactional benefits processes — enrollment, eligibility, compliance monitoring, and reporting — freeing the team’s capacity for higher-judgment, people-centric work.

Employee Experience & Communication

  • Ensure employee sentiment on benefits satisfaction is monitored and incorporated into program design, led by the Director, Benefit Design.
  • Partner with the Director, Benefit Design, who owns the benefits journey map and end-to-end employee experience strategy, ensuring alignment with Circana’s talent strategy and HR Mission and Vision.
  • Provide executive sponsorship for employee communication, education, and enrollment campaigns led by the Director, Benefit Design, in partnership with HR Business Partners and Talent Management.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex benefits matters, partnering with HR Business Partners during the centralization transition.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Team Leadership

  • Partner with Compensation, Talent Management, Payroll, Legal, Finance, and HR Business Partners to ensure benefits programs support broader Total Rewards and talent strategy.
  • Build and evolve a global team, including virtual and flexible team members, structured around the organization’s most important priorities; deliberately allocating complex, people-centric work to team members and repetitive work to automation and AI as capabilities are built.
  • Partner with Procurement on vendor sourcing, contracting, and cost management strategy for benefits vendors, brokers, and carriers.
  • Leverage partners across the HR organization — including HR Business Partners, Talent Management, and HR Technology — to bring broader expertise and reach global benefits initiatives.
  • Represent Global Benefits in Total Rewards leadership discussions and HRLT initiatives as needed.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of progressive benefits experience, including demonstrated expertise in global benefits design, governance, vendor management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Strong global benefits and regulatory acumen, including deep knowledge of U.S. requirements (ERISA, ACA) and experience navigating multi-country frameworks such as the EU Pay Transparency Directive. Demonstrated experience leading benefits strategy, administration, or governance across multiple countries and regions is required.
  • Fluency in applying AI and automation to redesign operational and administrative processes, with a track record of shifting team capacity from transactional work toward higher-judgment, strategic, and people-centric priorities.
  • Demonstrated experience building, centralizing, harmonizing, or transforming benefits operations, ideally in a multi-country, multi-entity, or post-merger environment.
  • Proven vendor and broker management skills, including RFPs, contract negotiation, and performance governance.
  • Strong financial acumen, with experience owning and managing a global benefits budget.
  • Experience partnering with HR Technology teams on benefits systems, data integrity, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication, consultation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex benefits concepts for executive and employee audiences.
  • People leadership experience, with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams, including experience designing flexible, virtual, or hybrid team structures that flex with business priorities.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a track record of strengthening governance, controls, and scalable benefits solutions that support organizational growth.
  • Experience building new capabilities, operating models, governance structures, or shared-service approaches within a benefits or Total Rewards function.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making capabilities with experience leveraging technology and reporting to improve outcomes.

Circana Behaviors

Beyond technical skills, experience, and role-specific attributes, these shared behaviors are fundamental to our culture and success. We seek individuals who consistently demonstrate and champion these behaviors in their daily work:

  • Stay Curious: Being hungry to learn and grow, always asking the big questions.
  • Seek Clarity: Embracing complexity to create clarity and inspire action.
  • Own the Outcome: Being accountable for decisions and taking ownership of our choices.
  • Center on the Client: Relentlessly adding value for our customers.
  • Be a Challenger: Never complacent, always striving for continuous improvement.
  • Champion Inclusivity: Fostering trust in relationships engaging with empathy, respect, and integrity.
  • Commit to each other: Contributing to making Circana a great place to work for everyone.

Location: Remote, USA. Candidates must be comfortable supporting a global workforce and working across multiple time zones, including North America and Europe, as needed.

The below range reflects the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. An employee’s position within the salary range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, any collective bargaining agreements, and business or organizational needs. The salary range for this position begins at $200,000 USD and will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and overall alignment with the role. This position is also eligible for an annual bonus.

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

An offer of employment may be conditional upon successful completion of a background check in accordance with local legislation and our candidate privacy notice. Your current employer will not be contacted without your permission.

You can apply for this role through the Circana careers website or Intranet site for internal candidates. This role is subject to AI-assisted screening. Circana uses artificial intelligence (AI) to assess resumes for alignment with job requirements by helping locate details in resumes that relate to the job description.

This position is expected to remain open for approximately 30 days and may close earlier if sufficient qualified candidates are identified.

Optimum is a leading provider of Mobile, Broadband (DOCSIS, Fiber) and Video services in the United States. The Product Development organization is responsible for the technology enablement and development of these technologies for our customers along with the tools used by our teams to support them.

Reporting to the Engineering Manager, the SDE III will participate as part of a highly skilled software development team building Optimum's internal omni-channel API platform - the tools, services, and integration layers that enable broadband, video, mobile, and customer-support applications across the organization. title: SailPoint Systems Engineer Mid
description:
Description

SAIC seeks a SailPoint Systems Engineer Mid to support the Department of Transportation’s Cybersecurity mission by joining a dedicated team of cybersecurity professionals who collaborate, cooperate, and facilitate maintaining and enhancing the security posture of DOT information systems and infrastructure. These information systems and infrastructure support the DOT mission of managing and maintaining United States critical infrastructure (i.e. highways, bridges, roads, etc.).

As a Mid-Level SailPoint Systems Engineer, you will contribute significantly to our cybersecurity and identity management efforts under the guidance of senior engineers. You will assist in coordinating with external stakeholders, including DHS CISA integrators, to support the implementation of Identity Lifecycle Management (ILM)/Mandatory User Re-Authentication (MUR) solutions at the Department of Transportation (DOT). This includes helping integrate DOT's SailPoint infrastructure with the ServiceNow environment and supporting the maintenance of the ILM solution in development, testing, and production environments. Your role will involve aiding in the support of ILM workflows for Privileged Account Management (PAM) tools and Active Directory (AD), assisting in the building of new system connections, and contributing to the maintenance of Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) Dashboard integrations.

You will assist in deploying software updates, help report on SailPoint IdentityIQ operations, and play a supporting role in the identification and remediation of security vulnerabilities. This position includes providing support for on-call and after-hours troubleshooting, contributing to annual Disaster Recovery testing, assisting in documenting recovery plans, and supporting the senior engineer's efforts to recommend and implement improvements. You will help ensure adherence to DOT processes for change management and support the enhancement of reporting capabilities, contributing to the data integrity for CDM dashboard compliance as per DOT CISA requirements. Join our team to play a supportive role in advancing cybersecurity initiatives and promoting a secure, efficient IT infrastructure at the DOT.

Qualifications

Job Role Specific Requirements:

  • SailPoint Certification Requirement: SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer certification, demonstrating a high level of expertise and proficiency in the SailPoint IdentityIQ platform.
  • Experience in Integrated Lifecycle Management: One year of experience in designing and implementing integrated lifecycle management processes within an enterprise of the Department of Transportation's (DOT) scale, specifically supporting SailPoint initiatives. This experience should highlight the candidate's ability to manage identity solutions effectively in large, complex environments.
  • SailPoint System Administration Expertise: Three years of hands-on system administration experience with SailPoint, including the integration and configuration with Active Directory and HR systems within an enterprise comparable to the DOT. This experience is crucial for ensuring seamless identity management and security across the organization.
  • SailPoint System Administration and Integration Proficiency: Candidates should have a minimum of one year of experience in system administration with SailPoint, including hands-on integration and configuration with Active Directory and HR systems within an organization of the Department of Transportation's (DOT) scale. This expertise is vital for ensuring seamless identity management and operational efficiency.

title: Master Thesis: MCP as a Growth Lever for Industrial Software Platforms (all genders)
description:
ABOUT US

At ACCURE, we empower batteries and those who use them.

Batteries are a key element of our clean energy and mobility future. ACCURE makes batteries safe, reliable, and sustainable through the power of the cloud. Using our highly scalable monitoring and optimization platform, we turn operational data from large-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) into insights our customers act on – safety, performance, lifetime, and commercial value. This is why we are currently looking for a student to work on the following topic in form of a master thesis:

MCP as a Growth Lever for Industrial Software Platforms

Model Context Protocol (MCP) opens a new interface layer between AI assistants and industrial software platforms. The field is young and the patterns are still forming – a good moment to shape them. For a platform provider like us, the question is: where does this create product and market opportunities, and how big are they? This thesis is suitable for students of a business- or tech-related field with a genuine interest in MCP and where it might take an industrial software platform.

Your Role

and YOUR THESIS
You can shape the thesis along one of two lenses – or your own angle:
  • Commercial lens: Architect the value proposition and go-to-market for MCP-enabled platform offerings – who buys it, why, at what price, and through which channel.
  • Technical lens: Build a working MCP prototype on top of our platform, designed against real customer workflows and evaluated for security, latency, and scale.
  • Working with the platform: Get access to our platform, team, and customers, with close supervision and real stakes – your work feeds into live decisions.
  • Customer exposure: Where it helps, engage directly with customers and partners through calls, interviews, and workshops to ground your work in real-world needs.
  • Shaping the future: Help define an emerging interface layer for industrial software, contributing to how AI assistants and platforms work together.

Your Skills

  • Experience: Currently pursuing a master’s in a business- or tech-related field – less about the exact degree, more about your interest in MCP.
  • Analytical mindset: Self-directed and structured, curious about the intersection of product and market, able to extract meaningful conclusions.
  • Technical affinity: Interest in AI assistants, software products, and how industrial platforms are used in the field; hands-on prototyping experience is a plus for the technical lens.
  • Working style: You bring initiative, reliability, and strong organizational skills, manage tasks independently, and enjoy taking ownership.
  • Languages: Strong communication skills in English; the thesis is written in English. German is a plus.

Our Offer

  • Real stakes: Your work feeds into live decisions and helps shape product and market direction for an emerging technology.
  • Access and supervision: Close access to platform, team, and customers, with hands-on supervision throughout your thesis.
  • A day in the role: Deep work in the morning, sync with product, engineering, or commercial around midday, and customer or partner exposure in the afternoon where it helps.
  • Never stop learning: Learn all about batteries, industrial software, and MCP from your colleagues.
  • A job that shapes the future and turns our planet greener one battery at a time.
  • Office-based or remote: Join us in our lovely office in Aachen and feel the start-up spirit or work remotely.
  • 8 hours/week: We'd like to employ you with at least 8 hours per week (Minijob).

At ACCURE, we're committed to cultivating an environment that promotes equality, diversity, and inclusion. We believe our unique qualities must be celebrated as they are critical to our innovation. It's essential to us that you bring your authentic self to work every single day, no matter your age, ethnicity, religion, citizenship, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, neurodiversity, or otherwise. Inclusion isn't just an initiative at ACCURE. We strive to embed it not just into our core values but throughout our entire ecosystem.

title: Position Team Lead Engineering Commercial Pharma China Solutions
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job description


  • The China Solution Engineering Team Lead is accountable for the strategic direction, people leadership, engineering delivery, and operational performance of the China-specific digital and AI solution portfolio.

  • The role leads a consolidated, Shanghai-based engineering team and transforms Pharma China priorities into secure, scalable, and high-value technology capabilities.

  • You will connect China business needs with global RDT strategy while navigating a distinctive local technology ecosystem, regulatory environment, and geopolitical landscape.

  • This role requires a strong combination of engineering leadership, product thinking, business insight, and the ability to operate effectively across local and global organizations.

  • Your primary objective is to enable China Digital and AI capability delivery with speed and scale by leading multidisciplinary engineering and service teams that build and operate desirable, feasible, viable, secure, and sustainable solutions for Pharma China, while maintaining alignment with Roche standards and applicable China regulations.



What should you do


Strategy & Vision


Accountable for setting the direction of China Solution Engineering and ensuring that engineering priorities deliver measurable Pharma China outcomes and financial objectives. Translate the China business strategy and RDT priorities into an integrated technology roadmap across local solutions and relevant global products. Monitor China market, regulatory, geopolitical, and technology trends; proactively propose resilient solutions and embed fit-for-purpose AI capabilities. Define, track, and communicate KPIs that demonstrate delivery speed, solution value, reliability, compliance, and contribution to business strategy.


Customer-Centricity


Establish a clear and aspirational vision for the end-to-end experience of Pharma China users, customers, and delivery partners across digital touchpoints. Build a deep understanding of local workflows and the expectations of HCP and business stakeholders, including the role of WeChat and other China-specific channels. Use feedback, product data, and market signals to prioritize improvements, accelerate adoption, and continuously refine solutions.


Product Lifecycle & Portfolio Mgmt.


Own engineering delivery and operational performance across the China-specific solution portfolio, from technical discovery and design through build, launch, scaling, run, modernization, and retirement. Maintain application and capability transparency, manage technical debt and lifecycle risk, and shape rationalization and reuse decisions. Coordinate roadmap dependencies with Product Managers and Business Partners, and ensure China requirements and reusable innovations inform relevant global product strategies.


Stakeholder Collaboration


Orchestrate a broad ecosystem spanning Pharma China Business Partnering, global Product and Engineering teams, Marketing & Customer Engagement, Portfolio Management, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Privacy, Compliance, local cloud and SaaS providers, and strategic delivery partners. Act as a trusted bridge between China and global stakeholders, making local constraints and opportunities transparent, resolving cross-product dependencies, and influencing senior leaders toward timely, evidence-based decisions.


Team Leadership & Development


Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing, multidisciplinary China engineering team. Create clarity on roles, objectives, performance expectations, and decision rights; allocate talent fluidly across evolving portfolio priorities; and strengthen succession, technical depth, and knowledge continuity. Foster an inclusive culture of ownership, customer-centricity, engineering excellence, data-informed decision-making, and continuous learning, while enabling team members to contribute to relevant global product teams and communities.


Performance & Optimization


Own the long-term performance, resilience, security, and sustainability of the China solution landscape. Connect engineering outcomes to business impact and guide optimization across availability, delivery lead time, quality, cost, adoption, risk, and user satisfaction. Establish transparent operational reviews, address systemic issues, and ensure business continuity across local and cross-border dependencies.


Financial & Resource Mgmt.


Develop multi-year workforce, run-cost, and investment plans in partnership with China Portfolio Management, Business Partners, Operations, and Product Managers. Jointly govern the China engineering budget envelope and allocate people and funding across run, enhancement, carry-over, and new-capability priorities to maximize portfolio value. Provide transparent reporting from both geography-centric and global product-centric views, and actively manage vendor capacity, financial risk, and delivery trade-offs.


Qualifications


Education / Experience


  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution delivery, technology product management, or a similar role, with a proven track record of launching, scaling, and operating enterprise digital products

  • 2+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or regulated healthcare technology industry; experience in China healthcare or commercial technology is strongly preferred

  • 2+ years of experience in a leadership role managing multidisciplinary technical teams in a global, matrixed organization

Technical Skills


  • Strong understanding of product discovery, software delivery, DevSecOps, and application lifecycle management. Working knowledge of regulated healthcare technology and China cybersecurity, data-residency, privacy, and cross-border data requirements, including PIPL, DSL, CSL, and CBDT controls.

  • Deep understanding of modern software architecture, including APIs, integration platforms, cloud and SaaS, data platforms, cybersecurity, and resilient operations. Familiarity with China digital ecosystems such as WeChat, local cloud platforms, and the local AI/ML landscape is required; experience designing hybrid global/local architectures is strongly preferred.

Leadership skills (where applicable)


  • Ability to translate high-level business and scientific goals into an integrated engineering strategy, portfolio roadmap, and clear execution priorities.

  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, with the ability to align China and global executives, Business Partners, Product Managers, architects, engineers, compliance stakeholders, and external partners toward a common outcome.

  • Proven ability to lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary engineering team, including through organizational change and complex matrix relationships.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Senior Data Specialist (Field Based)
description:
ERM is seeking a Senior Data Specialist in the San Francisco Bay Area to support data engineering, analytics, and enterprise data management initiatives within our San Francisco Bay Area operations. This is a full‑time (40 hours/week), limited‑term (one‑year) position with the potential for renewal. The ideal candidate will possess strong technical capabilities in data engineering, cloud platforms, and database administration, and will operate effectively within a collaborative, multidisciplinary team environment.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design, maintenance, and governance of enterprise data models to ensure accuracy, integrity, and consistency across systems.
  • Develop, enhance, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines that integrate data from multiple sources while ensuring performance and reliability.
  • Create and sustain analytical datasets that support dashboards, reporting tools, and data products, and resolve associated data quality issues.
  • Write, review, and optimize complex SQL queries and transformation logic; maintain technical documentation and provide guidance to junior team members.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into technical data solutions and collaborate with cross‑functional teams to deliver effective analytics outputs.
  • Conduct data validation and QA/QC activities; identify and implement process improvements and automation opportunities to increase operational efficiency.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, information systems, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • 5+ years of relevant professional experience.
  • Proficiency in SQL, relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), and foundational data modeling principles.
  • Hands‑on experience developing or supporting ETL/ELT workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Python or R for data processing; familiarity with version control practices.
  • Working knowledge of Power Automate and Power Apps.
  • Experience preparing datasets for reporting and dashboards using Power BI or Tableau.
  • Exposure to cloud data environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, Snowflake) related to storage, pipelines, or analytics workloads.
  • Ability to perform data QA/QC activities and maintain documentation, metadata, and related governance artifacts.
  • Ability to design user‑focused dashboards and develop robust semantic data models in Power BI using Power Query and DAX.
  • Experience optimizing Power BI performance, managing workspace publishing and refresh schedules, and implementing role‑based security.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams and deliver high‑quality work within established timelines and budgets.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to learn new technologies quickly, work independently, and produce technical deliverables in a timely manner.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with environmental data or environmental information systems.
  • Advanced SQL expertise, including performance tuning, stored procedures, complex transformations, and optimization of large datasets.
  • Advanced proficiency in DAX and Power BI optimization (e.g., incremental refresh, composite models, deployment pipelines).
  • Experience with data cataloging and governance tools.
  • Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD workflows, Git branching strategies, and automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience contributing to or leading technical solution design and mentoring junior staff.
  • Knowledge of data security, privacy standards, and protection controls.

Pay Transparency:

For the Senior Data Specialist position, we anticipate the annual base pay of $104,572 - $144,560, $50.28 -$69.50/hr USD, limited-term, non-exempt. An employee’s pay position within this range will be based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, shift, travel requirements, sales or revenue-based metrics, and business or organizational needs. We also may have instances where employee’s fall outside of the range based on the factors noted above. This job may be eligible for bonus pay (casual and fixed term/Flexforce employees are NOT bonus eligible).

We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical, dental, vision, 401(k), life & disability insurance to benefits eligible* employees.

*Benefits Eligibility is limited to Regular employees regularly scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week. Fixed-Term employees (including Flexforce) who are regularly scheduled to work 20 hours a week or more are eligible for a limited benefits package. Casual employees are NOT benefits eligible. See your recruiter for more details.

You can apply for this role through or through the internal careers portal if you are a current employee.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, determinable, and payable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, or any other form of compensation that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

Who We Are:

As the largest global pure play sustainability consultancy, we partner with the world’s leading organizations, creating innovative solutions to sustainability challenges and unlocking commercial opportunities that meet the needs of today while preserving opportunity for future generations.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career. We also see our diversity as a strength that helps us create better solutions for our clients. Our diverse team of world-class experts supports clients across the breadth of their organizations to operationalize sustainability, underpinned by our deep technical expertise in addressing their environmental, health, safety, risk and social issues. We call this capability our “boots to boardroom” approach for its comprehensive service model that allows ERM to develop strategic and technical solutions that advance objectives on the ground or at the executive level.

ERM does not accept recruiting agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, ERM employees or any other company location. ERM is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Thank you for your interest in ERM!

title: PharmaDx Document Control Specialist
location: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
description:
Schedule:
Monday - Friday (40 hrs/wk)
8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Department: PharmaDx Quality 506

Primary Purpose:

Maintains and manages the update, review, release, and storage, of all controlled documents in the areas of their responsibility and including some non-controlled documents. Documents may include but are not limited to, policies, processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), forms, job aides, validations, and batch records to support compliance with ISO, FDA, IVDR, CAP/CLIA, and GMP requirements.

About ARUP:

ARUP Laboratories is a national clinical and anatomic pathology reference laboratory and an enterprise of the University of Utah and its Department of Pathology. Based in Salt Lake City, Utah.

ARUP proudly hires top talent to create a work environment of diversity, professional growth and continuous development. Our workforce is committed to the important service we provide to over one million patients each month. We always strive for excellence and have a strong desire to have involvement with the advances in medicine and the role laboratory services plays within each patient’s life. We never forget that there is a patient behind every specimen we receive.

We are looking for individuals who want to contribute to ARUP's culture of accountability, integrity, service, and excellence. Consider joining our dynamic team.

Essential Functions:

Maintains electronic format copies and/or hard copies of approved current revisions of procedures, forms, and supporting documentation for the PharmaDx department through use of MasterControl.

Provides training as needed in the use of MasterControl within the PharmaDx department.

Maintains and ensures that all controlled copies and forms are current in the PharmaDx department.

Performs document control audits as required or assigned.

Ensures that all controlled documents and test packet reviews are routed on a regular basis, and in accordance with corporate and department standards.

Manages workflows (collaboration, approvals, and reviews) in MasterControl to ensure appropriate personnel approve and review the documents, as well as monitor document tasks to ensure prompt completion of tasks.

Ensures documents are named, numbered, and formatted appropriately before uploading to MasterControl.

Ensures regulatory standards are maintained in the PharmaDx department as it pertains to document control.

Examines documentation regularly for inconsistencies, gaps, or errors. Collaborates with relevant personnel to ensure accuracy of any revisions. Ensures that any gaps are addressed and resolved.

Ensures department physical records are scanned and stored properly within their designated area and that records are correctly archived into off-site storage.

Assists the PharmaDx department quality team in preparation for audits and inspections.

Prints, prepares, and stores the PharmaDX department controlled batch records for use by the manufacturing team.

Participates in continuing education and attends the regularly scheduled Document Control Specialist staff meeting and PharmaDx department meetings.

Trains and mentors other PharmaDx Document Control Specialists as assigned.

Participates on PharmaDx department project/improvement teams as assigned.

Presents updates at the PharmaDx department level.

Participates in document writing as assigned.

Work with subject matter experts in a positive, collaborative manner to prepare controlled documents which conform to ARUP’s defined format.

Track, organize, and communicate the PharmaDx department DCS requests and the status of their completion.

Works independently to accomplish all job duties.

Other duties as assigned.

Physical and Other Requirements:

Stooping: Bending body downward and forward by bending spine at the waist.

Reaching: Extending hand(s) and arm(s) in any direction.

Mobility: The person in this position needs to occasionally move between work sites and inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc.

Communicate: Frequently and effectively communicate with others.

PPE: Biohazard laboratory environment that requires use of personal protective equipment in accordance with CDC and OSHA regulations and company policies.

ARUP Policies and Procedures: To conduct self in compliance with all ARUP Policies and Procedures.

Sedentary Work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body.

title: Invoice Approval Associate
description:
Midland Mortgage, a division of MidFirst Bank, is one of the most successful home mortgage servicers in the country. We focus on quality and creating winning teams to execute our mission to be the top performing financial institution in the markets we serve. We are looking for an individual that will share in our passion for this mission.

The Invoice Approval Department is primarily responsible for reviewing and decisioning invoices submitted for payment by vendors used in the course of servicing mortgage loans. The Department analyzes each expense to determine whether the item meets all required criteria for payment. From time to time, Invoice Approval associates may work with outside vendors including attorneys, utility companies, and municipalities. Associates in the Invoice Approval department learn about many different aspects of mortgage servicing and will also have opportunities to learn about processes in other default departments. Your work will help our team to execute the department mission to minimize losses by maximizing recoveries.

Responsibilities include:

• Review and Analyze submitted expenses for payment. This includes determining whether those payments can be assessed to loans.
• Gathering and evaluating whether supporting documentation is sufficient based on Insurer and Investor regulations or other applicable guidelines; this involves working and resolving various exceptions identified through the invoicing application
• Participating in annual systems testing to ensure all automated processes within the department function with new software releases
• Participating in ad hoc projects as required for maintaining and updating current processes
• Working with outside vendors to obtain supporting documentation for invoices, as needed.

Position Requirements

Candidates must possess experience in a related office environment, working with detailed documents, navigating multiple computer applications throughout the day, with demonstrated success meeting deadlines to be considered. Competency with MS Excel is also required.

Additionally, candidates must demonstrate:

  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills
  • Proficient math skills
  • Effective time management and ability to meet deadlines
  • Strong oral/written communication
  • Strong organization skills
  • Ability to work independently

Prior experience (home or work) working with multiple computer monitors is preferred, as the position requires navigating multiple monitors and applications.

title: Patent Agent, Software
description:
About Hark

Hark is an artificial intelligence company building advanced, personalized intelligence. One that is proactive, multimodal, and capable of interacting with the world through speech, text, vision, and persistent memory.

We're pairing that intelligence with next-generation hardware to create a universal interface between humans and machines. While today's AI largely operates through chat boxes and decade-old devices, Hark is focused on what comes next: agentic systems that interact naturally with people and the real world.

To get there, we're developing multimodal models and next-generation AI hardware together - designed from the ground up as a single, unified interface for a new era of intelligent systems.

About the Role

Hark is seeking a Patent Agent to build the software side of our patent portfolio from the ground up. This person will own drafting and prosecution across our models, inference systems, and platform software, and will shape how the company decides what to protect as its research moves from experiment to product.

This role sits inside Legal but lives with research and engineering. You will work alongside the people building our foundation models, on-device inference, agentic systems, and product software, finding the inventions before anyone has thought to write them down. Then you will go draft the applications yourself.

Software patents are won or lost on subject-matter eligibility, and the work of getting a claim allowed starts long before the first office action. It starts in the specification, and before that, in understanding the technical problem well enough to say precisely what the invention improves. This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who wants to author that strategy rather than inherit it.

Responsibilities

  • Build and execute the patent strategy for Hark's models, inference systems, and platform software, including portfolio architecture across foundation models, on-device deployment, agentic systems, and product software
  • Work directly with research scientists, machine learning engineers, and infrastructure, platform, and mobile engineers to identify patentable inventions
  • Draft and prosecute U.S. and international applications covering machine learning architectures, training and inference systems, and software platforms, with claim and specification strategy built to withstand subject-matter eligibility challenges under §101
  • Prepare office action responses and conduct examiner interviews, including on Alice rejections, and develop prosecution strategies aimed at commercially meaningful claim scope
  • Review research publications, technical blog posts, demos, and open source releases ahead of disclosure, managing bar dates and coordinating filings so that publishing does not cost the company coverage
  • Advise on patent versus trade secret versus defensive publication, particularly for training methods, data pipelines, and inference optimizations
  • Review and improve applications prepared by outside counsel, and work with international counsel on PCT and foreign prosecution strategy, including jurisdictions with stricter standards for computer-implemented inventions
  • Conduct patentability and prior art analyses, monitor competitive patent activity, and support freedom-to-operate work ahead of product milestones
  • Own inventorship determinations, assignment hygiene, and IDS practice across the portfolio

Requirements

  • Registered to practice before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office, with an active registration number
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a closely related technical discipline
  • 5+ years drafting and prosecuting software patent applications, at a firm, in-house, or both
  • Deep working knowledge of §101 subject matter eligibility and a record of getting software claims allowed — you can articulate why a claim recites a technical improvement rather than an abstract idea, and you draft specifications that support that argument from the start
  • Experience at an AI, software, or platform company — you know what happens to a filing plan when a research team wants to publish in three weeks
  • Comfortable building in ambiguity — you've stood up prosecution processes from scratch, not just inherited them
  • Hands-on by default; you're drafting, not just managing outside counsel
  • Excellent written communication and exceptional attention to technical detail

Bonus Qualifications

  • Prosecution experience in machine learning, neural network architectures, distributed systems, or compiler and runtime optimization
  • Experience with patent provisions in open source licenses and with defensive patent arrangements
  • Experience managing substantial international portfolios across multiple jurisdictions
  • Software engineering or machine learning research experience prior to entering patent practice, or an advanced technical degree

Compensation

The US base salary range for this full-time position is between $150,000 – $220,000 annually.

The pay offered for this position may vary based on several individual factors, including job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package may also include additional components/benefits depending on the specific role. This information will be shared if an employment offer is extended. (edited)

title: AZ Wealth Planner
description:
MidFirst Bank is seeking an experienced, highly motivated Wealth Planner to join our Private Wealth team.

Role Summary:

The Wealth Planner is a key member of the Private Wealth team responsible for delivering high-quality, comprehensive financial planning to our affluent clients. This role partners closely with Wealth Advisors, Trust Advisors and Portfolio Managers to provide sophisticated planning strategies that support complex client goals. The Wealth Planner will spend the majority of their time deepening client relationships by designing and presenting financial plans to support exceptional client service.

Responsibilities:

  • Create comprehensive financial plans using cash flow planning software, integrating cash‑flow modeling, Monte Carlo simulations, retirement income strategies, and multi‑scenario stress testing.
  • Enter, validate, and maintain client data within financial planning applications; ensure accuracy of assumptions and outputs.
  • Draft planning summaries, recommendations, and client-ready deliverables with limited oversight
  • Support estate planning by preparing net-worth statements, trust projections, liquidity analyses, and wealth-transfer scenarios.
  • Create modular analyses (retirement, tax, estate, insurance, education, business succession, philanthropic) to support client conversations.
  • Conduct scenario modeling and projections to evaluate planning alternatives and trade-offs.

  • Distill complex planning concepts into clear, actionable guidance tailored to sophisticated clients.
  • Serve as an ongoing resource to client-facing Wealth Advisors, Trust Advisors and Portfolio Managers.
  • Create wealth planning collateral and resources related to retirement, education, insurance, estate planning, business succession, philanthropic and other planning-related material to support clients and internal partners.
  • Support business development by preparing pre-meeting planning insights for prospective clients.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of planning processes, tools, workflows and client experience standards.

Education/Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Financial Planning, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or related field
  • 3–5+ years of experience drafting and presenting financial plans to clients and prospects
  • Proficiency with eMoney or other cash flow financial planning software applications (required)
  • CFP® designation or advanced credentials (CPA, JD, LL.M.) required.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop comprehensive financial plans including retirement, tax, estate, insurance, and risk management strategies
  • Experience working with HNW/UHNW clients, business owners, and multi-generational families.
  • Expert understanding of business succession, estate, philanthropic, insurance, education, and financial planning concepts, including applicable legal, tax, and regulatory requirements
  • Specialization in tax or business succession planning a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and quantitative skills
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex concepts to sophisticated clients
  • High attention to detail; ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines
  • Client-service orientation with ability to work collaboratively across teams
  • Travel Required up to 40%

location: Gramercy Park and Murray Hill, Manhattan
description:
About Us:

NYSTEC is a nonprofit technology consulting company, advising agencies, organizations, institutions, and businesses since 1996. We’re independent and vendor-neutral, so we have our clients’ best interests at heart. At NYSTEC, we know that we succeed when individuals and teams flourish personally and professionally, so our benefits and perks support that mindset.

About the Role:

As a business intelligence (BI) developer in the Business Intelligence department, you will collaborate with team members to create and refine datasets, dashboards, and reports that support decision-making across the organization.

Serving as a BI developer, your day-to-day role will include managing data pipelines, validating data accuracy, and resolving issues that arise within the BI ecosystem. You will collaborate closely with analysts, finance, IT, and other teams to translate needs into technical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize datasets, data models, and reports to support organizational decision-making.
  • Build and manage extract, transform, and load/extract, load, and transform (ETL/ELT) processes to ensure reliable data ingestion, transformation, and delivery across systems.
  • Validate data accuracy and troubleshoot issues with pipelines, models, and reports to maintain a high-quality BI environment.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and deliver user-friendly dashboards.
  • Monitor BI system performance, implement enhancements, and ensure adherence to data governance and security standards.
  • Document processes, data definitions, and system changes to support long-term sustainability and team knowledge sharing.
  • Provide ongoing support for existing reports and datasets, including maintenance, updates, and performance tuning.
  • Partner with analysts and other teams to enable consistent, accurate, and accessible reporting across the organization.

About you:

Required Qualifications

  • Expertise with reporting tools, software, and other applications.
  • Established experience as a BI developer, creating interactive reports, visualizations, and data modeling.
  • Advanced Query Languages: Structured Query Language (SQL), Data Analysis Expressions (DAX), and Power Query M.
  • Python Proficiency: Ability to write clean, efficient Python for data transformation, validation, and automation, including using libraries such as pandas, Python Apache Arrow (PyArrow), or Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse Application Programming Interfaces (APIs).
  • Spark/Notebooks: Experience using Python Apache Spark (PySpark) and Microsoft Fabric/Spark notebooks to manipulate large datasets, create transformation pipelines, and support more scalable data engineering tasks.
  • Experience building and maintaining fabric data pipelines, dataflows Gen2, notebooks, and lakehouse tables.
  • Understanding of delta tables, medallion architecture, incremental refresh, and performance tuning.
  • Ability to troubleshoot data pipeline failures, refresh issues, schema changes, and data mismatches across multiple layers.
  • Excellent analytical reasoning skills to translate operational and financial processes into scalable, accurate data models.
  • Equivalent experience with Google Cloud, Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Microsoft Azure is also acceptable.

Preferred/Desired Qualifications

  • Advanced Microsoft Fabric experience.
  • Kusto Query Language (KQL) for fabric real-time intelligence and telemetry analysis.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure services, such as Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, or Data Lake Storage.
  • Understanding of security models, such as role-based access control (RBAC), data governance, and compliance frameworks.
  • Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer certification, in progress or completed.

Education and Experience

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology/systems, finance/accounting, math/statistics, or a similar discipline, and five years of related experience, including experience with writing reports and analyzing technical requirement modes.
  • An equivalent combination of advanced education, training, and experience will be considered.

title: Supervisor of Technicians- 12:00pm-12:00am
description:
Overall Summary

The Supervisor of Technicians is a working technical supervisor responsible for the day-to-day leadership of the equipment technician team, with a primary focus on industrial control systems, electronics, and motion control equipment. This role combines hands-on technical troubleshooting with leadership, and scheduling responsibilities, which include preventive maintenance planning and personnel oversight. This position requires a high level of technical expertise and active involvement in diagnosing and repairing complex control systems while ensuring maintenance activities are properly scheduled, documented, and executed in accordance with operational priorities.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Oversee a team of equipment technicians and team leads (if applicable).

  • Establish standards of performance and accountability; provide constructive and timely evaluations.

  • Conduct annual reviews and progress plans to foster individual and team growth.
  • Perform payroll functions for employees, including paid time off management and timecard corrections.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities:

Equipment & Production Support

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and repair complex industrial control systems including control boards, electronics, servo motors, servo drives, power supplies, I/O modules, and feedback devices.
  • Supervise the operation, setup, repair, and maintenance of production equipment technical support staff.
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting to ensure uptime, production volume, and quality goals are achieved.
  • Develop and manage preventive maintenance, and equipment rebuild schedules.
  • Lead technician scheduling to ensure the operation, set-up, repair and maintenance of all production equipment in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Develop and implement metrics and reporting to track excessive machine downtime, issues and actions in collaboration with Operations leaders to drive prompt remediation.
  • Manage all equipment parts, consumables and supplies used across the operation; collaborate with Purchasing to drive Just-in-Time supply, parts costs, and utilization.
  • Lead equipment technician cross training to support their efforts to progress, which allows the team to more fully support production.
  • Partner with Engineering (R&D) and vendors on machine hardening, contracted services, and new equipment purchases.

Administrative & Leadership

  • Develop and maintain procedures for machine inspections and safety compliance
  • Support Operations leaders on expense tracking for equipment; identify opportunities to reduce operational costs.
  • Coordinate efforts with Purchasing and Operations leaders on purchase orders; order maintenance supplies, parts, and equipment.
  • Utilize maintenance management software (MMS/Megamation) for work orders and scheduling.
  • Uphold company HR policies and practices; liaise with HR for employee relations, performance management and staffing.
  • Perform other duties as applicable or as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities/Competencies:

  • Technical skills with industrial control systems, electronics and motion control systems
  • Able to interpret schematics, wiring diagrams and control documentation
  • Strong leadership and team development skills.
  • Thorough understanding of applicable codes and safety regulations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions in a timely manner
  • Strong organizational and project management skills; ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Coordinate with OEM’s and vendors on advanced technical issues and part specifications
  • Proficiency in MS Office and maintenance software (Word, Excel, Visio, Megamation, AutoCAD).

Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; two-year degree in mechanical, electrical, or facilities management preferred.
  • 7+ years of hands-on experience in industrial equipment or control systems repair and maintenance.
  • Experience in a lean manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Previous participation on a safety team and/or safety training a plus.

Physical Requirements:

  • Must maintain active presence on production floor.
  • Standard climate-controlled production environment; exposure to loud noise (PPE provided).
  • Ability to lift, carry and push/pull up to 50 pounds.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, twist, pivot, crouch, squat, kneel, and stoop for 8-12 or more hours.
  • Upper extremity motion requirements: fine motor movements, pushing/pulling with arms, grasping and pinching.
  • Lower extremity motion requirements: reaching.
  • Ability to provide after-hours support as needed.

15
