title: HW-Sous
description:
At Haywire, we're in the business of creating unforgettable experiences for our Guests and Team Members. We lead with a "Posse Over Person" mentality, recognizing that our success depends on every member of the team performing at their best.

Haywire sits at the intersection of simple and sophisticated, taking guests on a curated journey through Texas-inspired hospitality. The space blends Texas comfort with an urban, contemporary feel.

A love of Texas-inspired food, genuine hospitality, and a passion for creating unforgettable guest experiences is a must.

JOB SUMMARY

We are seeking an experienced Sous Chef to support the daily leadership of Haywire’s culinary operations. In this role, you will partner closely with the Chef de Cuisine to lead successful shifts, coach culinary Team Members and ensure every dish meets our standards for quality, consistency and presentation.

Our ideal Sous Chef knows how to bring out the best in the team, coordinate action toward shared goals and remain calm and collected in a fast-paced environment. You will help create memorable everyday dining, private events and special culinary experiences while maintaining a clean, safe and organized kitchen.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary Range: $65,000–$80,000 per year, plus bonus

BENEFITS: THE GOOD STUFF

  • Competitive salary

  • Medical, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid Time Off

  • 401(k)

  • Growth and development pathways

EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of 2 years of high-volume restaurant experience, with high-end casual or fine-dining experience preferred

  • Previous culinary supervisory or kitchen leadership experience preferred

  • Strong knowledge of food preparation, recipe execution, portion control and presentation standards

  • Ability to lead shifts, coach culinary Team Members and coordinate kitchen execution

  • Strong understanding of food safety, sanitation, workplace safety and accident-prevention practices

  • Genuine enthusiasm for farm-to-fork cuisine and creating Texas-sized culinary experiences

  • Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving and decision-making skills

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and move with a sense of urgency

  • Ability to remain cool, calm and collected under pressure

  • Ability to communicate effectively in English; bilingual English and Spanish skills are preferred

  • Current Food Handler certification and ability to obtain or maintain any additional required food-safety certifications

  • Ability to stand for extended periods and lift up to 50 pounds

  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including days, evenings, weekends and holidays as business needs require

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

CULINARY EXECUTION

  • Support the Chef de Cuisine in leading all aspects of daily kitchen operations

  • Maintain an active, hands-on presence during preparation and service

  • Ensure recipes, preparation methods, portion specifications and presentation standards are executed consistently

  • Monitor food quality and presentation throughout each shift and correct issues before items reach our Guests

  • Coordinate the culinary team to support efficient ticket times and a smooth flow of service

  • Ensure the kitchen is properly prepared, stocked and organized before each shift

  • Assist with the development and execution of menus for private events and special culinary experiences

  • Protect the quality and integrity of our farm-to-fork, chef-driven culinary program

PEOPLE CHAMPION

  • Lead culinary Team Members with a “Posse Over Person” mentality centered on teamwork and shared success

  • Train, coach and develop Team Members to meet our expectations for quality, productivity, cleanliness and execution

  • Assign responsibilities clearly and coordinate the team’s actions to achieve shift goals

  • Ensure Team Members have the knowledge, tools and resources necessary to succeed

  • Celebrate team wins and address performance opportunities through fair, timely and consistent feedback

  • Support the onboarding and training of new culinary Team Members

  • Identify Team Members with leadership potential and support their continued professional development

  • Communicate Team Member concerns and performance issues to the Chef de Cuisine promptly

  • Foster productive communication and collaboration between the culinary and front-of-house teams

BUSINESS AND SHIFT LEADERSHIP

  • Lead successful kitchen shifts and provide clear direction during changing business conditions

  • Support culinary scheduling, labor management and staffing adjustments as assigned

  • Assist with food inventory, ordering, receiving, storage and product rotation

  • Monitor portioning, waste and product usage to support established food-cost goals

  • Maintain accountability for completing opening, closing and shift-change responsibilities

  • Communicate operational concerns, product needs and equipment issues to the Chef de Cuisine promptly

  • Support the responsible use and care of kitchen equipment, smallwares and supplies

  • Identify opportunities to improve kitchen efficiency without compromising quality or the Guest experience

  • Complete assigned administrative responsibilities accurately and on time

QUALITY AND SAFETY

  • Evaluate ingredients and finished products to ensure they consistently meet our quality standards

  • Ensure food is received, stored, labeled, rotated, prepared and served safely

  • Maintain a clean, organized and sanitary kitchen throughout every shift

  • Enforce proper food-handling, hygiene and workplace safety practices

  • Ensure compliance with all company policies and applicable food safety, health, sanitation and workplace safety requirements

  • Conduct regular kitchen walkthroughs and promptly correct quality, cleanliness, maintenance or safety concerns

  • Document and report accidents, injuries, equipment concerns and significant operational issues

  • Maintain all required certifications and culinary documentation

A SUCCESSFUL SOUS CHEF AT HAYWIRE

  • Is passionate about creating unique, Texas-sized culinary experiences for our Guests

  • Personally embraces and demonstrates an understanding of Haywire’s Brand DNA

  • Partners effectively with the Chef de Cuisine to ensure flawless execution from preparation through service

  • Knows how to bring out the best in the team and coordinate action toward shared goals

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and moves with an appropriate sense of urgency

  • Remains cool, calm and collected under pressure

  • Balances attention to detail with the broader needs of the restaurant

  • Celebrates wins, addresses opportunities and continually works to improve the Team Member and Guest experience

  • Leads by example and takes ownership of the kitchen’s performance

If you are passionate about developing culinary talent, delivering uncompromising quality and creating Texas-sized dining experiences, we invite you to apply.

Purpose

The Savinov lab at UT Austin () is pursuing multiple projects centered around discovering and designing protein fragments as universal regulators of protein interactions in health and disease – including in the contexts of antibiotic resistance, cell migration, neurodegeneration, and cancer. The lab seeks a highly motivated, curious, and organized individual to join the team and contribute to multiple research projects, working both individually and as part of a group. The candidate will set up and perform computational predictions and develop novel computational approaches supporting research efforts in the lab, and also be involved in training new lab members in these techniques. Computational approaches will include AI/ML approaches, protein design methods, bioinformatics, and data science methods to handle large experimental and computational datasets. The candidate should have experience with working on high-performance computing systems. Additional experience in experimental biology is favorable, but not required.

Responsibilities

  • Computational research and research support.
    Support and perform computational research to discover and design protein fragments as regulators of cellular protein interactions, both individually under the guidance of the PI and as part of a group. Computational approaches will include AI/ML-based structure prediction, protein design, and bioinformatics approaches, as well as data science to handle and extract insights from large experimental datasets. Perform routine computational experiments and develop novel approaches to address research problems. Maintain the lab’s computational infrastructure. Maintain careful records.

  • Training and general lab support.

  • Experience with Python, BASH, and high-performance computing systems.

  • Experience with data science and working with large experimental and computational datasets.

  • Experience with AI dev tools. Experience with learning new computational and AI/ML techniques and a strong desire to continue to do so.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct onsite clinical interviews with prospective clients and families and assess for clinical appropriateness for BrightQuest, including identifying relevant clinical, safety, behavioral, treatment, or other barriers to admission, and communicate findings and recommendations to the appropriate Admissions, Clinical, Medical, and Program staff.
  • Complete the clinical components of the Biopsychosocial Assessment, excluding medical portions, in accordance with policy standards, and document assessments and findings accurately and timely in KIPU and other applicable systems.
  • Serve as the primary clinical point of contact for clients and families between assessment and admission when clinically indicated, maintaining engagement and addressing questions, concerns, or barriers that may impact a successful transition to treatment.
  • Provide clinical support and continuity for the client and family throughout the admission-day experience, including responding to emerging clinical, emotional, or transitional needs and coordinating appropriate support.
  • Complete designated admission-day responsibilities, including staff communication and KIPU enrollment, and communicate relevant clinical information to the receiving treatment team to ensure the team is prepared for the client’s arrival.
  • Coordinate with the Admissions Advisor to ensure a seamless admissions experience.
  • Support client onboarding and address immediate client, family, and referent needs during the initial days following admission, facilitating communication with the appropriate members of the treatment team.
  • Collaborate with Clinical and Admissions teams to ensure continuity of information and care from the admissions process into the treatment experience.
  • Carry a clinical caseload as determined by the Leadership Team, when assigned.
  • Provide direct clinical services, including individual, family/couple, and group psychotherapy, as assigned.
  • Participate in clinical meetings, trainings, supervision, outreach, public-speaking events, and staff meetings as assigned.
  • Communicate with referents and clients’ outside treatment providers as clinically appropriate and/or directed by the Clinical Outreach team.
  • Attend weekly individual supervision as directed by licensure status or Executive Director.
  • Maintain timely and accurate clinical record documentation, including progress notes, admission and discharge documentation, treatment plan updates, and other required clinical documentation.
  • Participate in treatment planning and develop and carry out comprehensive treatment plans drawing on available clinical data.
  • Provide clinical support and coverage as needed to address client clinical needs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • At least 18 years of age.
  • License eligible PhD, PsyD, MFT, ASW/CSW, PCCI/APC/APCC, LPC-MHSP, or MHC. Must actively be pursuing licensure within the criteria set by state guidelines.
  • Specific, required, current, and active licensure, registration, and/or certification must be maintained in good standing.
  • Two years of clinical experience required; residential behavioral health experience preferred.
  • Behavioral health treatment experience required.
  • Experience conducting clinical assessments and Biopsychosocial Assessments.
  • Experience working with complex mental illness and co-occurring disorders, preferably within a residential setting.
  • Experience working with family members and referents of identified clients.
  • Sound understanding of mental illness, co-occurring disorders, milieu therapy, mental health treatment, and levels of care based on individual client needs.
  • Ability to synthesize information obtained from clients, family members, referral sources, previous treatment providers, and other collateral sources to support clinical assessment and admission decisions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with clients, families, referral sources, and multidisciplinary treatment teams.
  • Ability to exercise sound clinical judgment and identify clinical, safety, and treatment-related concerns that may impact admission or successful transition to treatment.
  • Comprehensive treatment planning and clinical case conceptualization skills.
  • Embraces and champions a client-centered care focus.
  • Proficient computer skills and ability to use various software programs, including KIPU and other electronic documentation systems.
  • First Aid/CPR certified.
  • Have a valid driver’s license in good standing and auto insurance.
  • Successfully complete comprehensive background check (including criminal record clearance), MVR screen, and drug screen.
  • Successfully complete required health screening, including a current and valid TB clearance.
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Flexibility to work evenings, nights, and weekends, and adapt schedule as needed.

Benefits Designed for You and Yours

Sero Mental Health and its subsidiary companies are proud to offer full-time employees and their dependents enrollment in multi-level medical, dental, and vision health benefits with substantial employer premium contributions. Additionally, the company offers employer paid Life Insurance and AD&D, Long Term Disability, Paid Parental Leave, and Employee Assistance Plans. Employees can choose from a variety of voluntary benefits including Medical and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Short Term Disability Coverage, Hospital Indemnity and Accident Plans, Critical Illness Coverage, and Legal Assistance. Furthermore, the company offers generous Paid Time Off and Holiday Pay.

Both full and part-time employees have the opportunity to enroll in the company’s 401(K) Retirement Plans with company match of 100% of the first 3% contributed and 50% of the next 2% contributed per paycheck. Employees contributing to their 401K plan are 100% vested immediately upon becoming eligible for the company match.

All benefits are effective the 1st of the month following 30 days of hire.

title: Director of Event Technology (SNE) - Cliff House Maine
description:
Position Overview

The Director, Event Technology (SNE) is responsible for achieving the revenue and profitability goals of an assigned location(s). This position ensures the team delivers World-Class service while cultivating and maintaining relationships with key venue personnel to enhance the overall business relationship with the venue. The DET promotes high performance, accountability and continuous improvement in the team and fosters a collaborative environment that values learning and a commitment to quality. This role will manage less than two Full-time team members, venue revenue between $450k - $900k and report to an Area Director, Venues, Regional Director, Venues or RVP, Venues.

Key Job Responsibilities

Venue Partner Relationships

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients at all levels of their organization and provide outstanding customer service while focusing on customer retention.

• Services events and act as a point of escalation when needed.

• Identify key issues and decision makers that will influence the contract renewal and leverage all available internal resources to facilitate the planning effort for renewing existing business.

• Consults with Venue Sales Leadership on sales strategies

• Participates in business review presentations.

Financial Management & Reporting

• Drive Results by managing an efficient and profitable operation with a focused approach on revenue maximization and profitability using cost control measures in accordance with the company’s standard operating procedures.

• Achieve Encore’s financial goals for the location(s) by effectively managing labor, equipment sub-rentals and other costs.

• Understand and utilize operational and financial reports and completes standard and ad hoc reports accurately and on time.

• Utilize the Company billing system to coordinate invoicing activities and makes certain that billing is reviewed and approved by clients.

• See the Big Picture by completing the sales forecast at home location, ensuring they are accurate and submitted timely.

• Participate in business review presentations as needed, in collaboration with regional management.

• Manage location P & L and develop action plans to address deficiencies/grow the business.

• Confirms venue partners process all payments to Encore in a timely basis.

Operations Management

• Perform and directs daily floor operations including scheduling and equipment setups, operation, and strikes.

• Anticipate equipment challenges and changes in a timely and professional manner.

• Use inventory control procedures to maintain proper inventory levels while also maintaining safety, security, and quality assurance of equipment.

• See the Big Picture by efficiently sharing labor and equipment within the local market.

• Attend all operational venue meetings such as daily stand up meetings with venue operations staff.

Technical Ability

• Understand the technical aspects of the job and applies basic to advanced troubleshooting and problem solving skills to resolve equipment and software issues in a timely and professional manner.

• Effectively utilizes applicable company computer systems.

Sales Management

• Create effective strategies to maximize revenue per-event for assigned customers including upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

• Exceed the expectations and needs of internal and external customers.

• Meet with guests on site to ensure that their needs are met and the equipment setup is accurate and working properly.

• Value People by promoting a culture of high performance, accountability and continuous improvement that values learning and a commitment to quality.

title: Quality Control Inspector – Precision Engineering
description:
Quality Control Inspector – Precision Engineering

Working Hours:
Monday to Friday: 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM
Saturday: 8:30 AM – 12:30 PM

Working Days: 5.5 days per week

Working Location:
Buroh Street, Singapore

Industry:
Precision Engineering / Manufacturing

Experience Required:
Minimum 2 years in a machine shop / precision engineering environment

Key Skill:
CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) experience will be an advantage.

We are a Singapore-based precision engineering and manufacturing company committed to delivering high-quality engineered components and reliable manufacturing solutions. We are looking for an experienced Quality Control Inspector to join our team and ensure that products consistently meet customer and engineering specifications.

The Role

As a Quality Control Inspector, you will be responsible for conducting inspections throughout the manufacturing process, from First Article and incoming inspection to in-process and final outgoing inspection. You will work closely with production and engineering teams to maintain quality standards and ensure accurate inspection records.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform dimensional and functional inspections on First Article (FA), incoming, in-process, and outgoing parts according to work instructions and specifications.

  • Inspect components using appropriate precision measuring instruments and inspection equipment.

  • Operate CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) for dimensional inspection where required.

  • Ensure inspection equipment and measuring tools are properly maintained and comply with calibration and preventive maintenance requirements.

  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and GD&T requirements.

  • Maintain proper control of the manufacturing environment and carry out gowning procedures where required.

  • Record and maintain accurate inspection, monitoring, and quality data in accordance with document and records control procedures.

  • Identify non-conformances and escalate quality issues to the relevant supervisor or department.

  • Work closely with production and other teams to support quality improvement and resolve inspection-related issues.

  • Perform other quality-related duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Requirements

  • 2 years of experience as a Quality Inspector in a machine shop / precision engineering environment.

  • Experience in precision engineering or manufacturing is required.

  • Proficient in using common precision measuring instruments.

  • Familiarity with CMM (Coordinate Measuring Machine) is highly advantageous.

  • Able to read and interpret engineering drawings and GD&T.

  • Willing to work in a 5.5-day manufacturing environment.

title: Quantitative Developer
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

At ARRAY, we’re not just another software services company – we’re a team of dreamers, innovators, and trailblazers! From startup grit to big-tech aspirations, we’re on a mission to redefine technology, put Bahrain on the global tech map, and grow into a powerhouse that inspires. If you’re ready to be part of an exciting journey, we want you on our team!

THE TEAM

Quant Dev combines mathematical rigour and engineering excellence. The team builds great products at enterprise scale, using AI to turn multi-modal data into impactful decisions. We come largely from banks, asset managers and applied science backgrounds, and we work where research meets production: applied, deployed and in the hands of clients across finance and heavy industry.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a strong software engineer - not merely a coder - whose mathematical and statistical foundations are first-rate, and who has real experience building AI/ML-based products. You’ll work independently on challenging problems, but as part of a close team that ships products. This is an applied role: working closely with R&D, but measured by what reaches production and what clients use.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Product Engineering: Design, build, deploy and operate production-grade software at enterprise scale, owning features end to end.
  • Applied AI/ML: Own the full machine learning life cycle - data exploration and preprocessing, model selection and training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring and optimisation - inside deployed products, not research notebooks.
  • Data at Scale: Build pipelines and platforms that turn large, multi-modal data (videos, documents, time series) into decision-ready outputs.
  • Analytics Design: Propose and build data analytics that drive decision-making for clients and products.
  • Product Ideation: Contribute to the ideation and shaping of AI-powered products.
  • Engineering Standards: Raise the bar through code review, testing, sound design and expert use of AI coding agents - help the team build faster and safer.

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

  • Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence or a related quantitative field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience building and deploying software products, with substantial experience developing and deploying AI/ML models in production.
  • Software engineering excellence: system design, testing, version control, code review and CI/CD - beyond modelling code.
  • Strong mathematical and statistical foundations (probability, statistics, linear algebra, optimisation) - able to reason about model behaviour, not just invoke libraries.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL.
  • Proficient in AI and machine learning libraries and frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, scikit-learn) and modern AI tooling.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) for deploying AI and machine learning applications.
  • Independent problem-solver and genuine team player, with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

NICE-TO-HAVE SKILLS

  • Background in financial services - banks, asset managers, or fintech.
  • Experience working with large-scale data and intelligence platforms.
  • Applied generative AI experience: LLM-powered features, retrieval, agents or fine-tuning in production.
  • Cloud certifications demonstrating expertise in cloud-based AI and ML.
  • Exposure to client-facing roles and understanding client needs in the context of AI and ML solutions.
  • Experience with startup culture - adaptability to a fast-paced, ever-changing environment.

title: Silicon Photonics Quality & Reliability Engineer
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Why Intel Foundry

At Intel Foundry, you will help develop and qualify next-generation silicon photonics technologies that enable AI, cloud infrastructure, high-performance computing, and advanced networking solutions. Working alongside world-class scientists and engineers, you will gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge photonic devices while contributing to innovative technologies that power the future of data communications.

This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in reliability engineering, device characterization, qualification methodologies, and semiconductor technology development within one of the industry's leading Silicon Photonics organizations.

About the Role

Intel's Silicon Photonics Quality & Reliability team is seeking a Silicon Photonics Quality & Reliability Engineer to support reliability assessments, qualification activities, and technology development for advanced photonic devices and photonic integrated circuits (PICs).

In this role, you will work closely with process integration, technology development, design, manufacturing, and quality teams to evaluate device reliability, analyze data, investigate failures, and support the development of robust qualification methodologies. This position provides an excellent opportunity for engineers who are passionate about photonics, semiconductor technology, reliability engineering, and continuous learning.

What You’ll Do

Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:

  • Support reliability characterization and qualification activities for silicon photonic devices and technologies.
  • Analyze reliability, characterization, and manufacturing data to identify trends, opportunities, and potential risks.
  • Execute Design of Experiments (DOE) and statistical analyses to evaluate device performance and reliability.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to support technology development and process certification activities.
  • Assist with root cause investigations and failure analysis efforts using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Develop technical reports and communicate findings to engineering teams.
  • Support qualification testing activities including environmental, electrical, and reliability stress testing.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, reliability, and manufacturing maturity.
  • Utilize data analysis tools to drive engineering decisions and improve process understanding.
  • Support the transfer of new technologies into manufacturing environments.

The ideal candidate should exhibit the following behavioral traits:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and engineering methodologies.
  • Ability to work effectively in a highly collaborative and cross-functional environment.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to technical excellence.
  • Effective prioritization and organizational skills.
  • A proactive approach to identifying issues and driving solutions.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and evolving development environment.
  • Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills.
  • Passion for quality, reliability, and innovation.

    • Silicon Photonics TD / Manufacturing experience.
    • Data extraction and analysis skills (JMP/ILM/REL/PCS/SQL Scripting).

title: Inventory Technician
description:
At Stoke, we believe a thriving space economy will enable a vibrant, sustainable, and equitable future here on Earth. That is why we’re building Nova, our fully and rapidly reusable launch vehicle. Designed for daily flight, Nova tackles the core challenges of space transportation by reducing cost, increasing availability, and improving reliability. By radically lowering launch costs and increasing flight cadence, we’re helping create a truly scalable space industry.

Our team is mission-driven, collaborative, and empowered to take ownership of their work. If you want to work alongside some of the most dedicated and talented people on Earth, we’d love to have you join us.

Description
Reusable systems are the key to seamlessly connecting Earth and space. As an Inventory & Logistics Technician at our Moses Lake test site, you will be responsible for performing various tasks that help us move more efficiently and test faster and safer. You will manage test stand inventory, perform shipping and receiving tasks, and help with various administrative and technician tasks across the site. You must be ready to stay focused, move fast, self-direct, and learn on the fly.
Responsibilities
  • Set up new inventory locations by assembling racks, labelling bins, maintaining stock

  • Work closely with engineers to keep inventory organized and ensure critical items are on hand
  • Work with vendors to place orders to keep inventory stocked
  • Prepare shipments and receive deliveries
  • Pick up items around Moses Lake when necessary
  • Perform administrative tasks on site
  • Support Test Engineers and technicians with whatever tasks required to test quicker, safer, and more efficiently
  • Safely operate forklift

  • High school diploma or equivalent certificate
  • 2+ years of experience in warehouse or inventory role
  • 2+ years operating a forklift
  • Proficient with safely operating a variety of hand and power tools
  • Excellent computer skills
  • Able to use their own car to pick up items around Moses Lake when necessary (mileage will be reimbursed)
  • Willing to work outdoors for long periods of time
  • Able to stoop, bend, crawl, and lift up to 40 lbs. unassisted
  • Rigorous attention to detail
  • Highest levels of organization
  • Unbeatable drive and ownership
  • Ability to lead
  • Ability to follow
  • Passion for building something with high quality, willing to attend work with a positive and humble attitude, and willing to take ownership of large and small tasks to help the team be successful

Job title: Finance Business Partner – Tours Site

About the job


As Finance Business Partner for Tours Site within our Manufacturing & Supply Finance team, you'll deliver strategic financial insights and partner with operational leaders to drive performance at one of Sanofi's key manufacturing sites. Ready to get started?


Built in 1967, our Tours pharmaceutical production facility is one of the leading industrial enterprises in Indre-et-Loire. With over 300 employees, each year, Tours produces over 3.5 billion tablets and capsules for France and the world, serving cardiovascular disease, central nervous system disorders, and hypercholesterolemia. With 93% of production destined for international export (Europe, United States, Japan, Australia), Tours is at the heart of France's pharmaceutical sovereignty and innovation.


About Sanofi:

We're an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people's lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people's lives.


Main responsibilities:

  • Provide accurate and timely financial analysis and reporting, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives and Group standards.
  • Serve as a trusted business partner to operational management, delivering financial insights and challenging assumptions to drive optimal decision-making.

  • Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities in accordance with established timelines.
  • Oversee reporting, accounting, financial systems, treasury, and tax functions, optimizing resources while minimizing risk exposure.

What we offer you:


  • A fixed salary over 12 months, supplemented by a short-term incentive, as well as a collective variable compensation based on Sanofi Group results.
  • Because taking care of our employees is also our mission: 31 days of paid leave + RTT depending on your status, remote work up to 2 days/week, quality health insurance, public transport coverage up to 80%, extended maternity/parental leave (18/14 weeks), Group Savings Plan & PERCOL with employer matching, PERO, numerous CSE benefits, internal and international mobility opportunities, learning & development opportunities, and many other benefits to discover here.

About you


Experience:

  • Proven track record in finance roles such as controlling, financial analysis, or business partnering
  • Experience in manufacturing environments is a strong advantage
  • Knowledge of international accounting standards and regulatory requirements

Soft and technical skills:

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities,
  • excellent communication and stakeholder management skills,
  • ability to challenge and influence operational leaders

Education:

  • Advanced degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field

Languages:

  • Fluent in English and French

Why choose us?

  • Shape the future of medicine delivery with cutting-edge technology, ensuring seamless operations and a resilient global supply.
  • Power industry-leading performance by leveraging digital, data, and AI-driven innovation – at speed and scale.
  • Transform lives worldwide by supporting the delivery of life-changing treatments to over 20 countries across Europe, Asia, and beyond.
  • Support a site investing in innovation: in 2023, we invested €15 million to launch production of a hypercholesterolemia treatment with a capacity of 700 million tablets annually.

GENERAL NOTES

Dell Medical School is seeking a Healthcare Contracts Specialist.

This is a state-funded position with an end date of 8/31/2027 that is renewable for another year.

JOB SUMMARY

The Healthcare Contracts Specialist provides essential administrative and clerical support to the Contracts function and is responsible for organizing, tracking, and maintaining contract documentation, coordinating contract workflows, and ensuring timely processing of agreements. Reporting to the Contracts Manager, the Healthcare Contracts Specialist works closely with legal staff, supply chain, finance, compliance, and clinical departments. The position requires strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment. The Healthcare Contracts Specialist plays a key role in supporting the contract lifecycle process, ensuring compliance with internal policies and external regulations, and facilitating communication between departments and external vendors.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

Contract Lifecycle Management

  • Prepares, formats, and edits contract documents under the direction of legal or contracts staff for clarity and consistency.

  • Tracks contract status and deadlines using contract management software or spreadsheets.

  • Maintains organized digital and physical contract files in accordance with institutional policies.

  • Assists with routing contracts for review, approval, and signature.

  • Ensures executed contracts are properly archived and accessible.

  • Prepares summaries and reports on contract status.

  • Reviews contracts for formatting, completeness, and compliance with templates.

Internal and External Communication

  • Communicates with internal stakeholders to gather required documentation or approvals.

  • Responds to inquiries from vendors, legal counsel, and department staff regarding contract status.

  • Schedules meetings and maintains calendars for contract-related discussions.

  • Drafts professional emails, memos and routine correspondence and contract-related memos to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Escalates issues or delays to appropriate personnel.

  • Responds promptly to inquiries from departments and vendors.

  • Meets the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers, building rapport with stakeholders to facilitate smooth communication.

  • Provides clear guidance on contract processes and requirements.

Contract Databases and Logs

  • Enters contract data into tracking systems or databases, ensuring accuracy.

  • Identifies discrepancies or missing documentation in contract data.

  • Updates contract logs with key dates, terms, and renewal information.

  • Generates standard reports on contract activity and status.

  • Assists with data validation and cleanup to ensure accuracy.

  • Supports audits by retrieving and organizing requested contract records.

  • Maintains logs and databases current accessible.

Compliance and Policy Adherence

  • Verifies that contracts meet institutional formatting and policy requirements.

  • Flags missing or incomplete documentation for review.

  • Supports compliance with HIPAA, Stark Law, Anti-Kickback Statute, and other applicable regulations.

  • Participates in training on contract compliance and confidentiality.

  • Maintains confidentiality of sensitive contract information.

General Administrative Support

  • Orders office supplies and manages department filing systems.

  • Prepares agendas, takes meeting minutes, and distributes follow-up items.

  • Assists with onboarding of new staff or contractors.

  • Supports special projects and process improvement initiatives.

Contracts Renewals and Expirations

  • Monitors upcoming contract expirations and alerts responsible parties.

  • Prepares renewal templates and assists with drafting updated terms.

  • Coordinates with departments to confirm continued need for services.

  • Tracks renewal approvals and ensures timely execution.

  • Archives expired contracts per retention policies.

Other duties as identified by department

MARGINAL OR PERIODIC FUNCTIONS:

  • Assists with contract audits by compiling documentation and responding to audit requests from internal or external reviewers.

  • Supports contract template updates by formatting new versions and distributing them to stakeholders.

  • Participates in process improvement initiatives related to contract workflow efficiency or document management.

  • Coordinates logistics for contract-related training sessions, including scheduling, materials preparation, and attendance tracking.

  • Provides backup support to other administrative staff during absences or peak workload periods.

  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency while supporting department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization.

  • Adheres to internal controls and reporting structure.

  • Performs related duties as required.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • Ability to use time effectively and efficiently; must possess strong prioritization skills to spend time on what’s important; can quickly zero-in on the critical few and puts the trivial many aside.

  • Must possess excellent organization skills to support contract tasks by urgency and deadlines to avoid delays, flagging time-sensitive agreements for expedited processing.

  • Ability to manage multiple requests without compromising accuracy.

  • Ability to maintain accurate calendars and reminders for contract renewals and expirations.

  • Ability to allocate time appropriately for data entry, document review, and stakeholder follow-up.

  • Ability to avoid bottlenecks by proactively managing workload.

  • Demonstrated attention to detail, being thorough in accomplishing tasks through concern for all areas involved, no matter how small.

  • Ability to marshal resources (people, funding, material, support) to get things done; ability to orchestrate multiple activities at once.

  • Ability to maintain well-structured digital and physical filing systems.

  • Ability to coordinate contract routing and approval workflows efficiently.

  • Must possess strong written and interpersonal communication skills along with the ability to communicate with all levels of the organization.

  • Ability to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

  • Capable of working independently.

  • Must work with integrity and professionalism.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Requires a Associate's Degree in Business Administration, Legal Studies, or a related field of study with at least 2 year(s) of experience in administrative work experience, including at least 1 year supporting contract management, legal procurement, or compliance functions in a healthcare, legal, or corporate setting. Relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Legal Studies, Healthcare Administration, or a related field of study with at least 3 year(s) of experience in healthcare or legal administrative support role, with direct exposure to contract lifecycle processes, document management systems, and regulatory compliance.

LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS OR CERTIFICATIONS REQUIRED:

  • None specified.

PREFERRED:

  • Certified Administrative Professional (CAP) offered by the International Association of Administrative Professionals (IAAP); demonstrates advanced administrative knowledge and skills.

Dell Medical School is seeking a Research Associate I

This is a state-funded position with an end date of 8/31/2027 that is renewable for another year.

JOB SUMMARY

The Senior Clinical Research Coordinator (Senior CRC) independently coordinates complex interventional trials and multi‑site studies under a Principal Investigator (PI) and/or Research Operations leader, ensuring protocol fidelity, participant safety, regulatory compliance (ICH‑GCP; FDA 21 CFR 50/56), HIPAA adherence, high‑quality data, and monitoring/audit readiness. The Senior CRC leads screening and informed consent; plans and conducts study visits; manages investigational product and specimen workflows; performs AE/SAE reporting; and maintains IRB submissions, continuing reviews, and amendments. Senior CRCs also mentor junior coordinators and contribute to feasibility, budgets, and enrollment strategies.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

• Perform laboratory experiments under the guidance of senior researchers.

• Collect and analyze data through clinical interviews, behavioral measures, and other techniques.

• Maintain accurate records of experimental procedures and results.

• Data Analysis

• Analyze research data using statistical software and tools.

• Interpret results and prepare reports for review by senior researchers.

• Assist in the preparation of research publications and presentations.

• Assist with manuscripts and publications by drafting sections, reviewing content, and ensuring adherence to publication guidelines.

• Laboratory Maintenance

• Maintain and calibrate laboratory equipment.

• Ensure the laboratory is clean, organized, and stocked with necessary supplies.

• Follow safety protocols and procedures.

• Collaboration and Communication

• Work closely with other research staff to coordinate experiments and share findings.

• Participate in team meetings and provide updates on research progress.

• Communicate effectively with external collaborators and stakeholders.

• Protocol Development

• Assist in the development and optimization of research protocols.

• Review and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) as needed.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and ethical guidelines.

• Assist with IRB submission and management by preparing necessary documentation, coordinating with IRB representatives, and ensuring timely submission and approval.

Other duties as identified by department

Literature Review

• Summarize findings and present them to the research team.

Training and Mentorship

• Assist in the onboarding process for new team members.

Grant Writing Support

• Assist in the preparation of grant proposals and funding applications.

• Provide data and information to support grant submissions.

• Adheres to internal controls and reporting structure.

• Performs related duties as required.

KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES

• Addressing individuals and health-related information with a high degree of sensitivity and confidentiality in various delicate, formal or urgent situations.

• Outstanding organizational and time-management skills.

• Interpreting experimental results, identifying trends in data, troubleshooting experimental issues.

Requires a Bachelor's Degree in psychology, social work, neuroscience, engineering, computer science, or another STEM-related field with relevant research experience.

description:

The Hospital Facilitator serves as an integral part of the CAS Operations Team and is responsible for ensuring that each patient receives the appropriate level of care (ALS, BLS, Chair Car) response, and on time arrival to the patient. Requirements:

title: Admissions Counselor I - Office of Admissions
description:

Admissions Counselor I - Office of Admissions

Office of Admissions and Orientation

Job Details:

General Notes

Must be eligible to work in the United States on a full-time basis for any employer. Position is located in Houston, TX.

Purpose

The Admissions Counselor I serves as a primary university contact for prospective students, applicants, admitted students, families, counselors, and community partners within an assigned territory. The position provides timely guidance throughout the college-selection, admission, and enrollment process; represents The University of Texas at Austin through in-person and virtual recruitment activities; and uses data, relationship-building, and responsive service to advance institutional enrollment goals.

The role works with Recruitment supporting Pathways, Partnerships and Pipelines; Orientation; First-Year Experience; academic units; and other campus partners to provide accurate information, strengthen referrals and handoffs, support student transitions, and create a more coherent experience from initial engagement through enrollment and entry into the university community.

Responsibilities

  • Advise prospective students, applicants, admitted students, and families throughout the college-selection, admission, and enrollment process. Respond to questions through phone, email, virtual engagement, and in-person meetings; provide individualized guidance; and connect students and families with appropriate university resources.
  • Use territory data, engagement indicators, institutional priorities, and assessment findings to plan, implement, and evaluate recruitment activities. Represent the university at high school, community college, regional, community-based, and on-campus recruitment programs and events. Support Longhorn Orientation and First-Year Experience, Pathways, Partnerships and Pipelines programs and events as assigned. Travel frequently throughout the assigned territory and other areas as assigned, and operate a personal, rental, or university vehicle as needed.
  • Present clear and accurate information about the undergraduate experience, academic opportunities, educational value, admission and enrollment processes, available pathways, orientation, and the transition to the first year. Tailor presentations and outreach to the needs of students, families, counselors, and community partners.
  • Build and sustain relationships with high schools, school districts, community colleges, alumni, community-based organizations, businesses, and educational or pathway partners. Maintain regular communication, learn partner priorities, identify opportunities for collaboration, and share relevant feedback with the Senior Program Coordinator.
  • Promote awareness of available admission pathways and identify students who may benefit from pathway opportunities. Support pathway outreach, recruitment, referrals, and transition activities.
  • Maintain timely and accurate records of student interactions and outcomes in Slate. Review admission applications and meet established productivity, quality, timeliness, and confidentiality expectations. Participate in scholarship review and related processes as assigned.
  • Perform other related functions as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Experience providing customer service and assisting, advising, or counseling students.
  • Experience preparing and delivering presentations to varied audiences.
  • Strong interpersonal, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills and a professional demeanor.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, projects, priorities, deadlines, and travel commitments in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, customer databases, or customer relationship management systems.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to meet applicable university driving requirements.
  • Relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish.
  • More than two years of customer service, admissions, recruitment, advising, or student-support experience.
  • Experience working with students on a college or university campus as an orientation or peer advisor, resident assistant, student ambassador, or in another student service-oriented role.
  • Experience with The University of Texas at Austin policies, procedures, academic offerings, programs, and student life.
  • Experience working for a competitive or highly selective institution and communicating professionally and empathetically with students and families.

Driving Required

This job requires a class "C" operator's driver's license. The applicant selected must provide a current three year driving record from the current state of residence. If not currently a Texas resident, a Texas driver's license must be obtained within 30 days of becoming a Texas resident. Employees who are required to have a CDL are subject to drug and alcohol testing (pre-employment, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, random, return-to-duty, and follow-up drug and alcohol testing).


Salary Range

$43,000

Working Conditions

  • May work in extreme temperatures
  • May work around standard office conditions
  • Repetitive use of a keyboard at a workstation
  • Use of manual dexterity
  • Lifting and moving


Required Materials

  • Resume/CV
  • 3 work references with their contact information; at least one reference should be from a supervisor
  • Letter of interest

Important for applicants who are NOT current university employees or contingent workers: You will be prompted to submit your resume the first time you apply, then you will be provided an option to upload a new Resume for subsequent applications. Any additional Required Materials (letter of interest, references, etc.) will be uploaded in the Application Questions section; you will be able to multi-select additional files. Before submitting your online job application, ensure that ALL Required Materials have been uploaded. Once your job application has been submitted, you cannot make changes.

Important for Current university employees and contingent workers: As a current university employee or contingent worker, you MUST apply within Workday by searching for Find UT Jobs. If you are a current University employee, log-in to Workday, navigate to your Worker Profile, click the Career link in the left hand navigation menu and then update the sections in your Professional Profile before you apply. This information will be pulled in to your application. The application is one page and you will be prompted to upload your resume. In addition, you must respond to the application questions presented to upload any additional Required Materials (letter of interest, references, etc.) that were noted above.

Regular staff who have been employed in their current position for the last six continuous months are eligible for openings being recruited for through University-Wide or Open Recruiting, to include both promotional opportunities and lateral transfers. Staff who are promotion/transfer eligible may apply for positions without supervisor approval.

title: Senior Business Systems Analyst
description:

At Justrite Safety Group, we're more than just a collection of industrial safety companies; we're a dynamic organization dedicated to protecting people, property, and the planet.   • Build reporting with Dataviews and Mongoose reporting.
  • Maintain SyteLine planning (APS/MRP) setup and parameters.
  • Support Factory Track, barcode scanning, BarTender, and Doc-Trak.
  • Administer SyteLine security groups and form-level permissions.
  • Support site rollouts and upgrades from requirements to go-live.
  • Support EDI transactions and interfaces to other applications.
  • Write functional specs, test plans, work instructions, and SOPs.
  • Train and support users in their functional processes.

  • 5+ years as a techno-functional ERP analyst, SyteLine preferred.
  • Deep SyteLine/ERP knowledge across discrete manufacturing and warehousing.
  • Understanding of SyteLine planning (APS/MRP) setup and toolset.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

  • Infor Syteline 9.x–10.x, Factory Track, Doc-Trak.
  • Experience with EDI integrations and PO automation platforms
  • Integration experience using middleware such as Boomi
  • Experience working with cross functional teams across multiple time zones

Compensation:

The position offers a competitive base salary ranging from $130,000to $145,000.

Actual base salaries will vary and may be above or below the recommended pay range based on factors such as but not limited to location, relevant experience and performance. Additionally, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan to enhance their overall total compensation package when Justrite Safety Group and their business units achieve annual business and financial targets.

Our benefits package at Justrite Safety Group is designed to be the best in the industry, offering everything you need to support your career and personal well-being. You’ll receive a competitive salary paired with an extensive benefits package that includes comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage. We provide flexible hours and alternative work arrangements designed to support a healthy work-life balance. These options vary depending on the specific roles and business needs.

Your financial future is secure with our 401K plan, complete with a company match, and you’re protected with company-paid short and long-term disability insurance. To ensure you’re at your best, we also offer generous paid time off, personal days, and a robust employee wellness program that supports your overall health and happiness. At Justrite, our benefits package is designed to help you thrive both in and out of the workplace.

Why Choose Justrite Safety Group?

As a leading name in the safety industry, Justrite provides a platform where you can collaborate with some of the best professionals in the field, learning from experts and contributing to cutting-edge solutions. The company's commitment to excellence and innovation ensures that you’ll be part of a team that is making a real impact. With a strong focus on career advancement, Justrite empowers its employees to thrive both personally and professionally, making it an ideal workplace for those looking to grow their careers in a meaningful and rewarding environment.

Join us and be part of a team dedicated to product excellence and making a positive impact in our company, and in our community!

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Position Summary: The Sr. Business Analyst is a senior contributor on the product management team, providing analytical leadership across multiple product areas and translating complex or ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable requirements that drive product development in a fast-paced environment. This role works closely with the Director of Product Management, engineering leadership, and business stakeholders — setting standards for requirements practice, mentoring less experienced analysts, and contributing to product strategy discussions. This role operates in a Microsoft-based development environment, collaborating closely with engineering teams using Azure DevOps, SQL Server, and modern .NET-based solutions.

Supervisory Responsibilities: None

Essential Tasks:

Requirements & Analysis

  • Set direction for requirements discovery across multiple product areas or complex, cross-functional initiatives
  • Translate ambiguous or competing business objectives into structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, resolving conflicts among stakeholder groups
  • Identify systemic gaps and inefficiencies across products and workflows, and recommend solutions that inform product strategy
  • Serve as the escalation point for requirements or scope conflicts between business stakeholders and engineering teams
  • Establish and maintain requirements-gathering standards and best practices for the Business Analyst team

Product Support

  • Guide backlog strategy and prioritization across multiple product areas, advising the Director of Product Management on trade-offs
  • Oversee backlog grooming, and release activities across the analyst team, stepping in directly on the most complex or highest-risk releases
  • Establish standards for acceptance criteria and validation practices used across the Business Analyst team
  • Audit work item quality (epics, features, user stories, defects) in Azure DevOps and coach others on maintaining consistency

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain relationships with senior business stakeholders and engineering leadership, representing the analyst function in cross-functional and strategic conversations
  • Facilitate complex or high-stakes requirements reviews and sign-off sessions, including those involving competing stakeholder priorities
  • Advise the Director of Product Management on requirements-related risk and provide input into product roadmap decisions

Documentation & Reporting

  • Establish documentation standards (BRDs, process maps, data flow diagrams) used across the Business Analyst team and audit adherence to them
  • Consolidate and report on backlog health and requirement completion trends across multiple product areas for leadership visibility
  • Advise on data and reporting considerations for complex, cross-system requirements

Core Competencies:

  • Ability to Analyze and Solve Problems: Skill in recognizing challenges, exploring options, and implementing effective solutions in a timely manner
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on completing tasks and projects accurately and thoroughly
  • Communication Skills: Capable of expressing ideas clearly in both verbal and written forms and engaging with various audiences
  • Timely Task Completion: Ability to finish tasks and projects efficiently, managing resources and priorities effectively
  • Team Collaboration: Willingness to work together with others, promoting teamwork and supporting shared goals
  • Client Focus: Dedication to understanding and addressing the needs of clients and stakeholders to ensure their satisfaction
  • Dependability: Acknowledgment of the importance of being present and punctual.
  • Creative Thinking: Openness to suggesting new ideas and methods to improve processes and outcomes
  • Organizational Skills: Capability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Adaptability: Willingness to adjust to changing situations and priorities, showing resilience in a dynamic work environment
  • Mentorship & Coaching: Ability to develop the skills of less experienced analysts through coaching, feedback, and modeling of best practice

Experience & Education

  • 8+ years of experience in a business analyst or similar role within a technology-focused organization
  • Demonstrated ability to lead requirements discovery and analysis across multiple product areas or complex, cross-functional initiatives
  • Track record of mentoring or developing less experienced analysts
  • Strong ability to translate ambiguous, competing, or undefined business needs into structured, actionable requirements
  • Agile/Scrum experience – including facilitating or advising on ceremonies across multiple teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience engaging senior stakeholders and engineering leadership
  • Proficient in SQL and familiar with database server concepts (tables, relationships, data validation)

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with AI
  • Experience in product analytics, customer journey mapping, or UX research
  • Background in the insurance or financial services industry
  • Experience working in a DevOps environment at scale (boards, backlogs, and reporting across multiple teams)
  • Experience contributing to product roadmap or strategy discussions

Physical Requirements:

  • Ability to lift 25 pounds
  • Repeated use of sight to read documents and computer screens
  • Repeated use of hearing and speech to communicate on telephone and in person
  • Repetitive hand movements, such as keyboarding, writing, 10-key
  • Walking, bending, sitting, reaching and stretching in all directions

Benefits & Compensation:

  • Higginbotham offers medical, dental, vision, prescription drug coverage, 401K, equity incentive plan as well as multiple supplemental benefits for physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing.
  • Employee Wellness Program
  • Company paid holidays, plus PTO

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Higginbotham Insurance Agency, Inc., and our partners, will not accept unsolicited potential placements from any source other than directly from the candidate or a vendor partner under MSA with Higginbotham. Please do not contact or send unsolicited potential placements to our team members.

*Applications will be accepted until the position is filled

title: Director, Enterprise Cell Therapy Corporate Affairs
description:
We are building something special in cell therapy. Be the voice that helps shape it.


Director, Enterprise Cell Therapy Corporate Affairs


Amsterdam | office 3 days per week


12 month Fixed Term Contract (fulltime)


Occasional travel to the UK


About the Role

AstraZeneca is advancing cell therapy at scale, investing in state-of-the-art platforms, building global capabilities and pushing the boundaries of science. The field is moving at pace — and the opportunity to make a meaningful difference for patients is growing just as quickly.


As we build our new Enterprise Cell Therapy organisation, we are looking for a Director of Corporate Affairs to shape and execute communication strategies that align with our organisational priorities. This is a rare opportunity to join a newly formed enterprise team and help define how we communicate internally and externally as we grow.


Your key priorities

This role balances strategic communications with hands-on delivery — approximately 40% strategic shaping and 60% execution. You will:


  • Develop and execute comprehensive communication strategies that support the Global Corporate Affairs and Cell Therapy objectives
  • Advise and counsel senior leaders on communication approaches for internal and external audiences
  • Lead execution of internal communications activities including town halls, functional events, change communications and leader communications
  • Support key policy and advocacy priorities, including event organisation, stakeholder management and roundtables (approx. 20% of role)
  • Prepare content for senior leaders' external presentations and engagements, ensuring alignment and approvals
  • Measure effectiveness of communication approaches, provide analysis and make recommendations for continuous improvement
  • Build relationships quickly across a global, matrixed organisation and partner effectively with senior scientific and business leaders

About You

You are a self-sufficient, strategic communicator who is equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves to create content and execute plans. You thrive in fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environments and enjoy the energy of a start-up culture within a global pharma organisation.


Essential Experience

  • Strong biotechnology and/or pharmaceutical industry experience — you understand how pharma works and what cell therapy is (no PhD required)
  • Proven track record in strategic communications and internal communications at a senior level
  • Experience advising and coaching executives and senior leaders on communication matters
  • Excellent writing, project management and multi-channel communications skills — particularly digital
  • Sound scientific background with the ability to understand, interpret and translate complex science for different audiences
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to push back and prioritise strategically
  • Experience working across multiple competing priorities and juggling effectively in a global, virtual team environment
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written)

Desirable Experience

  • Agency experience
  • Policy and advocacy experience
  • Experience in start-up or rapidly scaling organisations
  • Local or global pharma market experience

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to shape a brand-new function within a high-growth area of AstraZeneca. You will work closely with Enterprise Cell Therapy leaders, and the broader Global Corporate Affairs team. The team is global — spanning Amsterdam, Cambridge, Shanghai, Boston and Gaithersburg — and everyone owns their priorities. You will be based at our One Helix site in Amsterdam, a key Cell Therapy hub, with occasional travel to Cambridge (UK).

While this is initially a 12-month fixed-term contract there might be potential for longer-term opportunities in the UK as the organisation evolves (no guarantees).


Your effort is rewarded

You can expect much in return for your dedication. In addition to a competitive salary, you will enjoy:


  • A 13th-month salary on top of your monthly pay.
  • Access to internal training and development programs.
  • 27 vacation days, plus additional leave (such as your birthday, Good Friday, and the period between Christmas and New Year’s Eve).
  • Flexible and progressive employment benefits allowing you to tailor them to your needs (e.g., a wellness budget and the choice of a holiday calendar based on different religious beliefs).
  • A pension plan.

Making a difference together with AstraZeneca

Are you driven by innovation and eager to make a real impact? At AstraZeneca’s Cell Therapy facility in Amsterdam, we are developing next-generation TCR therapies targeting neoantigens in solid tumors. With a team of approximately 75 scientists, we are advancing shared neoantigen-targeting treatments to transform patient outcomes.


We recently moved into One Helix, our brand-new, high-tech research facility in Amsterdam Zuid, located near the Amsterdam UMC. This state-of-the-art space is designed to accelerate breakthroughs in cell therapy. Join our team and help shape the future of cancer treatment.


Ready to grow your career in a driven, innovative environment? Apply today!

If you have any questions about this vacancy, our Recruitment Team, Karin Raadschelders / Caroline van Oppen, is happy to answer your questions.

Contact: info@werkenbijastrazeneca.nl or by phone on +31(0)85 - 047 0244.


We don’t work with a fixed closing date; the vacancy will close as soon once we’ve found the right candidates. Feel free to apply right away – we will start the selection process immediately.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Lexington, MAResearch & Development – SW Platform Dev - 3050 /FTE Exempt - REG /HybridWinning the race to bring new healthcare products safely to a waiting world drives Rapid Micro Biosystems (RMB) to combine today’s innovative technologies as never before. Your career at RMB puts you at the center of diverse global teams that span robotics, AI, Machine Learning, imaging, microbiology, and more, re-shaping how urgently needed pharmaceuticals are made, tested, and released for decades to come. The sky’s the limit.Careers at RMB are fast-moving, with the high growth you’d expect from a world leader in microbiology automation. Advancement at RMB affords an opportunity to achieve your personal goals and develop your passions, in an inclusive environment where every employee has the resources and opportunities to hone their skills. You’ll do more, learn more, and have the ability to make a profound impact on our business.

The Staff Software Engineer reports to the Development Manager within the R&D organization. This role is a key member of a highly collaborative Software Engineering team.

The ideal candidate is a self-motivated, full-stack software engineer who is capable of independently designing, developing, testing, and deploying high-quality software. As the secondary technical leader of the development team, this individual will serve as the primary backup to the Software Architect, contributing to technical design decisions, maintaining architectural consistency, and ensuring continuity of development efforts.

This position requires a strong background in modern software engineering practices, front-end and back-end development, cloud and on-premises deployments, CI/CD automation, and Agile development methodologies. Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering, scientific and product management teams are essential.

Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack software solutions for commercial products.
  • Independently deliver features from concept through deployment with minimal supervision.
  • Serve as the technical backup to the Software Architect, participating in architectural planning, technology selection, and design reviews.
  • Contribute to software architecture and ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, secure, and performant.
  • Develop front-end applications, back-end services, business logic, and database components.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and services
  • Collaborate with Product Management and stakeholders to define requirements and ensure customer needs are met.
  • Develop and maintain Software Design Requirements (SDRs) and technical documentation.
  • Participate in code reviews and promote software engineering best practices across the team.
  • Build and maintain automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment processes.
  • Support both cloud and on-premises deployment environments.
  • Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, retrospectives, and sprint demonstrations.
  • Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams including software engineers, scientists, and product managers.
Required Technical Qualifications

Candidates should demonstrate strong experience in most of the following areas:

  • Modern software architecture and design patterns
  • Full-stack application development
  • C# and .NET Core/.NET
  • Angular and TypeScript
  • SQL Server and relational database design
  • Entity Framework or equivalent ORM technologies
  • Authentication and Authorization (OAuth, OpenID Connect, JWT, Identity, etc.)
  • Asynchronous programming using Tasks, async/await, multithreading, and concurrent programming techniques
  • RESTful API development and service-oriented architecture
  • Modern UI development practices
  • Automated unit and integration testing using frameworks such as xUnit or NUnit
  • Docker containerization
  • CI/CD pipeline implementation and DevOps practices
  • Git source control and collaborative development workflows
  • Networking fundamentals and distributed applications
  • Cloud platforms (Azure preferred) and on-premises deployments
  • Demonstrated experience developing production-quality software across the full technology stack.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as an integral part of the software development workflow to accelerate development, automate engineering tasks, refine prompts, and improve code quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI-assisted and emerging agentic development workflows to enhance engineering productivity while exercising sound technical judgment and maintaining high standards for software quality, security, and maintainability.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a small, highly collaborative engineering team.
  • Ability to balance feature delivery with software quality, maintainability, and long-term architecture.
  • Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies. Linux OS knowledge a plus
Required Qualifications
  • BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, including leading complex technical initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience developing production-quality software across the full technology stack.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
  • Proven ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a highly collaborative engineering team.
Working Conditions
  • Hybrid work environment with a required on-site presence of three (3) days per week. This is a mandatory requirement for the position.
  • Work is performed in both an office environment and laboratory settings.
  • Occasional flexibility to work on additional on-site days may be required to support project milestones, testing, or product releases.
$129,000 - $172,500 a year

Rapid Micro Biosystems is proud to offer a competitive total compensation package designed to attract, inspire and retain the best talent in our industry. In addition to base pay, our full-time regular employees are eligible for an attractive benefits package, cash incentive opportunities, and an equity grant.

The base annual salary hiring range for this position is $129,000-$172,500.

Starting salaries are determined based on skills, experience, budget and other job-related factors. More information about our total compensation package will be shared with candidates during the recruitment process.

Working closely with members, staff, and the Wellness Director, this hands-on role keeps the fitness center clean, safe, and welcoming while upholding TPC’s service and professional standards.

Fitness Desk Operations (approximately 75%)

  • Provide front-line customer service, including greeting members, answering questions, and resolving member concerns

  • Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills

description:
18th September, 2026

Why work for Brennan?

At Brennan, we aim to lead, not follow. One of the ways we do this is through an open diverse culture that values performance, where anyone in the team can bring new ideas to the table and see them thrive. Our people are empowered, considerate, supportive, trusting and accepting, they are the cornerstone of the business. THE ROLE :

The Senior Infrastructure Consultant is a key member of the Cloud Practice, with a primary focus on Microsoft 365, tenant-to-tenant migrations and modern workplace transformation. This position can work from Sydney or Melbourne or any of Brennan's Australian offices.

The role is responsible for designing and delivering Microsoft 365 solutions across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive and Microsoft Entra ID, working closely with customers, architects and project teams from discovery and assessment through to migration, cutover, validation and operational handover.

The role also provides broader infrastructure expertise across VMware, Windows Server, Active Directory, Azure and hybrid environments, including the design and implementation of virtualisation platforms and supporting infrastructure. The Senior Consultant is expected to provide technical leadership, own delivery workstreams, engage directly with customers and ensure solutions are secure, scalable, operationally ready and aligned with business requirements

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES :

  • Participating in change management, release planning, testing, production cutovers and post-implementation validation.
