title: EMEA Partner Lead, Data Foundations for AI, EMEA Partner Specialist team
description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a world class partner strategy leader to join the EMEA Partner Specialist team to lead the partner strategy for Data — the database, analytics, and data services that form the foundation of the AI stack. As an EMEA Partner Lead, Data Foundations for AI, you will have an exciting opportunity to deliver on our strategy to accelerate adoption of the AWS data layer within partners of all types. You will help them identify and create data use cases and capabilities across the value chain — from getting data onto AWS and modernising it onto purpose-built engines, to unifying it in an Iceberg-native lakehouse, governing it for AI, and consuming it through AI-powered analytics — developing and executing go-to-market and enablement plans that lead to a healthy business pipeline, joint customer wins and market success.
Where a customer’s data lives determines where their AI runs. In this role, you will work with partners to help them establish AWS databases and analytics as the persistence and intelligence layer for every AI and agentic workload, building growth-oriented and strategically focused offerings that deliver on these customer and market expectations. In this endeavor, you will collaborate with a number of AWS internal teams including partner managers, solution architects, sales, BD, marketing, and solution teams to position and deliver these capabilities internally and to customers. The AWS Partner organization will look to you as the expert on the data domain, partner types, use cases, and how to drive AWS market success through partners. You will also act as a mentor to regional Data and Analytics experts, bringing your substantial experience in coaching and guiding the team into delivering customer and partner success.

Focus Areas
The EMEA Data Foundations for AI Partner Lead will focus on the following actions to address the data partner needs in the EMEA territory:
1. Identify industry-specific and horizontal data use cases and solution offerings across the six pillars — database migration and modernisation, Iceberg-native lakehouse, vector and agent-memory workloads, data governance, and AI-powered analytics — in the EMEA region;
2. Actively engage with mature and emerging Data & Analytics partners whose offerings align to these use cases (e.g. lakehouse and analytics ISVs such as ClickHouse, Snowflake, Neo4j and SAS positioning AWS-native alternatives against Databricks Unity Catalog and Snowflake-mediated Iceberg);
3. Identify and recruit horizontal or niche data partners we need in the ecosystem;
4. Lead enablement of our partner ecosystem (ISVs, SIs and GSIs) on native AWS data offerings including Amazon Aurora and Aurora DSQL, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Redshift, Amazon S3 Tables / Iceberg REST, AWS Lake Formation, and AWS Glue, and drive attainment of the new AWS Data Competency (launching at Partner Equip London, Sep–Oct 2026);
5. Enablement of the ASP organization on AWS and technology-partner data services and solutions. Success will be measured by # net new “must win” partners building Data Foundations for AI practices, # partner practitioners enabled on Data in EMEA (via PDM/PSA or PDS), # partners solutions launched, # customer references / case studies , # thought leadership (tech content, public speaking), # AO + PO Launched $ARR.

Role could be based in other EMEA AWS offices.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop and lead the partner strategy and execution plan to grow the AWS-based Data partner community in EMEA
• Drive AWS Data Competency attainment — guiding DB SDP partners, existing Data & Analytics competency partners, and high-propensity AI-only partners through cross-skill validation
• Collaborate with AWS teams and with partners to bring data solutions to market to meet customer needs, with measurable ROI results
• Prioritise AWS engagement with partners who focus on the data domain, including leading startups, consulting companies, and established ISV technology vendors
• Build C-level relationships with our top data partners
• Work with cross-functional groups in AWS to deliver training, enablement and go-to-market programs that scale the partner business across the data domain


About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job
description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or
includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered
cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500
companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is
why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home,
there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and
empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative
teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to
everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find
endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-
rounded professional.

title: Product Manager II
description:
Product Manager II

Our Company

Elsevier is a global information analytics company that helps institutions and professionals progress science, advance healthcare and improve performance for the benefit of humanity. We serve the research, academic and clinical communities through the application of technology and analytics to content. In this way, we empower those communities to contribute to social progress, to enhance human well-being and to share and expand the breadth of human knowledge.

Job Summary

The Product Manager II, Apply Portfolio will own one or more product features or defined workstreams within Elsevier Healthcare Education's Apply Portfolio, leading execution from discovery through delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement across products including Shadow Health, SimChart, and other current and future Apply Portfolio offerings.

The Apply Portfolio supports healthcare learners and educators through digital products that deliver immersive, practical, and outcomes-focused learning experiences. This role works closely with engineering, design, clinical experts, data and analytics teams, customer success, sales, marketing, implementation partners, and academic customers to understand market needs and deliver valuable solutions across the portfolio.

This is a hands-on product role that combines customer engagement, product discovery, delivery leadership, data analysis, technical collaboration, and go-to-market support. The Product Manager II is a key liaison between customers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional delivery teams — developing a firsthand understanding of customer needs, translating those needs into clear product requirements, and helping prioritize work that addresses meaningful customer, learner, faculty, and business needs. The successful candidate will be curious about data and AI, comfortable working with analytics, reporting, and AI-enabled tools, and motivated to turn product data into actionable insights.

AI is a growing part of this role — both as a capability to build into the product strategy for owned features and workstreams, and as a tool that helps product managers work faster. This role calls for practical fluency with both, alongside the core product skill set above.

Responsibilities

Own the Product Workstream

  • Own one or more Apply Portfolio product features or defined workstreams, including product development plans, requirements, priorities, delivery coordination, and success measures.
  • Manage assigned portions of the product lifecycle, including discovery, planning, development, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
  • Contribute to feature-level vision and priorities, shaping and championing future product direction within the broader Apply Portfolio strategy.
  • Prioritize and communicate production customer issues, defects, and enhancement requests using relevant data and customer impact to support timely resolution.

Understand Customer & Market Needs

  • Interact frequently with customers, faculty, students, sales, customer success, implementation teams, and internal stakeholders to understand goals, workflows, pain points, and unmet needs.
  • Generate and prioritize customer requirements based on firsthand insight, product data, business objectives, and commercial viability.
  • Translate customer and business needs into clear, actionable, and testable requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, prototypes, and supporting documentation.

Drive Data, Analytics & AI Strategy

  • Analyze product usage, customer feedback, adoption trends, operational information, and other data sources to identify insights and inform product decisions.
  • Define product hypotheses and evaluate them quantitatively where appropriate through usage analysis, usability testing, experimentation, and other measurement approaches.
  • Identify the analytics and reporting needed to measure feature adoption, customer value, operational performance, learner and faculty engagement, and business outcomes.
  • Incorporate AI-driven capabilities into the product strategy and roadmap for owned features or workstreams, identifying where AI can meaningfully improve outcomes for learners, faculty, and the business.
  • Apply AI tools and AI-assisted workflows to day-to-day product work — including data synthesis, analysis, requirements drafting, and reporting — to work more efficiently.

Support Go-to-Market & Enablement

  • Lead product demonstrations and milestone reviews for customers, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional partners.
  • Support launch planning and coordinated delivery with marketing, sales, customer success, implementation, and other customer-facing teams.
  • Provide product input into Train-the-Trainer sessions, customer enablement, onboarding, and market rollout activities.
  • Own or contribute to product-specific content used for sales demonstrations, customer events, training, release communications, and other customer activities.
  • Answer questions from sales and customers regarding feature functionality, value proposition, competitive position, and planned enhancements.

What We're Looking For

  • 3–5 years of experience in product management, business analysis, implementation, customer success, or a related role.
  • Experience working with software products, SaaS platforms, data products, or technology-enabled services.
  • Comfort working with technical concepts such as APIs, data structures, analytics, integrations, and software development workflows.
  • Experience creating product documentation, requirements, user stories, process flows, or other artifacts that support delivery and adoption.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across engineering, design, sales, customer success, and external customer teams.
  • Comfort operating in an environment where priorities may evolve and problems may not have clearly defined solutions.
  • Experience or strong interest in building AI-driven capabilities into product strategy and requirements, along with comfort using AI tools to support day-to-day product work such as requirements drafting, data analysis, and reporting.
  • Experience in healthcare, nursing education, higher education, clinical simulation, or learning technology is a plus but not required.

About the Level

This is a Product Manager II role — an individual-contributor position for product managers ready to own a defined feature or workstream end-to-end, from discovery through delivery, adoption, and iteration. It carries direct accountability for customer, learner, and business outcomes within a bounded scope, with close collaboration across engineering, data, and go-to-market teams. It's a strong fit for someone building depth in customer-facing product work and data-informed decision-making, with room to grow into ownership of larger, more strategic pieces of the Apply Portfolio over time.



U.S. National Base Pay Range: $95,300 - $158,800. Geographic differentials may apply in some locations to better reflect local market rates.



This job is eligible for an annual incentive bonus.

title: System Integration and Test Engineer - 2nd Shift
description:
Introduction to the job

ASML is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of lithography systems that help enable Moore’s Law and the creation of increasingly powerful and capable electronic devices. Our San Diego-based light source division, Cymer, is renowned for developing both deep ultraviolet (DUV) lithography light sources and next generation extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light sources. We are a multinational company with over 70 locations in 16 countries, headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.

If you have a passion for technology and innovation you’ll want to check us out. Be a part of ASML. Be a part of progress.

One Company, One Goal, Limitless Innovation. It's our people that make the difference.

Role and responsibilities

We are seeking Test Engineers to join our EUV System Test and Integration group. You will be part of an interdisciplinary team that tests and integrates our EUV systems for Development and Engineering. Our EUV light source consists of an intricate network of process gases, high power lasers, optics, electronics, mechatronics, and control systems. In this hands-on position you will have the opportunity work with all of these components and become a system expert. You will be the key to building a better product though testing, issue identification and resolution, and finding potential improvements.

  • Performs tests, integration, R&D, upgrades, and qualification of EUV systems and their components.

  • Aligns and maintains sensitive optics and high power lasers.

  • Uses advanced HW and SW to operate, diagnose, and characterize functionality and performance.

  • Gathers, correlates, interprets, and presents data.

  • Solves problems through troubleshooting and leveraging available resources.

  • Captures and drives the resolution of issues to ensure a quality product.

  • Drives the improvement of procedures and processes.

  • Works with stakeholders from different departments and builds a strong communication network.

  • Responsible for maintaining a safe work environment.

  • Travel to customer sites as required to support product introduction or support local sites

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Working hours:

Education and experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Physics.
  • 0–2 years of relevant experience. Exceptional recent college graduates considered.
  • Strong engineering, technical, and physics fundamentals.

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.
To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:

  • Strong problem solving and troubleshooting skills.

  • Self-motivated, inquisitive, and resourceful.

  • Ability to multitask and prioritize, while staying organized and detailed oriented.

title: Senior Director, Talent Development Operations
description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most by challenging norms and fixing the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7/365, and created an ER experience that focuses on what our pets and pet parents really need. We’ve done the same for our people (VEGgies), finding a way to say YES so they are empowered to achieve great things, grow in unexpected ways, and find a place where they truly belong.

We’re rethinking emergency care from every angle—from how we run our hospitals to how we support the people working inside them. That’s where our headquarters team comes in. Whether building technology to make our hospitals more efficient, recruiting and growing incredible VEGgies, or bringing our brand to life through marketing, our VQ (VEG Headquarters) team makes it all possible—ensuring our hospitals and people have everything they need to help pets and their families.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

At VEG we find a way to say YES—and this role brings that mindset to turning learning into capability across VEG, so VEGquarters (VQ) can equip our hospitals and frontline VEGgies to grow, perform, and deliver the VEG experience consistently as we grow.

As Senior Director, Talent Development Operations, you’ll lead the people and systems that turn Talent Development strategy into scalable development across VEG—connecting our programs, trainers, technology, training environments, and field partners so learning reaches hospitals consistently and effectively.

You’ll build the bridge between VQ and the frontline, shaping what should be built centrally, what should be enabled closer to hospitals, and how the two work together so VEGgies can learn, practice, and grow in the flow of their work. The result is stronger teams, more consistent capability across hospitals, and a development model that can scale with VEG.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Talent Development Operations: Lead and develop the managers and directors responsible for delivering the people, programs, systems, and infrastructure that help learning scale across VEG.
  • Frontline Training Strategy: Develop how training moves from curriculum into real-world learning, practice, and reinforcement across our hospitals.
  • Field Enablement: Equip trainers, facilitators, leaders, and subject-matter experts with the tools, standards, and support to build capability closer to the work.
  • VQ + Field Partnership: Partner across Talent Development, Operations, and other teams to clarify what should be built centrally, what should live closer to hospitals, and how the pieces work together.
  • Learning Infrastructure: Build and strengthen the technology, data, training environments, vendors, processes, and operating rhythms that allow learning to scale reliably.
  • Talent Development Insights and Metrics: Use demand, capacity, quality, reach, and outcome data to surface gaps, guide investment, and continuously improve how VEG develops its people

WHAT YOU NEED

  • 10+ years of experience leading managers and/or directors accountable for meaningful teams, capabilities, or outcomes.
  • Experience building or materially transforming a learning, training, enablement, or workforce-development system—not only operating established programs.
  • Experience delivering training or capability development across a distributed, multi-site, field, or frontline organization.
  • Experience balancing enterprise consistency with the realities of different markets, locations, leaders, and teams.
  • Strong business judgment, including making tradeoffs across people, capacity, technology, resources, and investment.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships and influence senior leaders and cross-functional partners through growth, ambiguity, and change.
  • 4 days in office required; HQ located in White Plains, NY.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives
  • Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments
  • Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results
  • Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

  • Competitive Compensation Including ($180,000 - $230,000) + bonus + benefits.
  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits that start on day one, and access to free therapy or counseling
  • Paid parental leave, up to 12 weeks at 100% of regular salary, and offering inclusive fertility and family-building care for all types of families
  • Unlimited PTO to use for vacation or sick days—however you need it!
  • Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people.
  • And the little (big) things, like casual office attire, ability to bring your fur baby to work, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry and free lunches twice a week!!
  • Company laptop and a monthly cell phone reimbursement

BETTER TOGETHER: WHY IN-PERSON MATTERS AT VEG HQ

Our hospitals thrive on in-person collaboration, and VQ is no different. Time in the office sparks stronger connections, meaningful conversations, and better results—all bringing our core values to life. We prioritize being present because our values are best achieved side by side. Plus, we make getting here easy with free parking and a shuttle from the White Plains Metro-North station.

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

title: (Junior) projectleider architectuur
description:
De toekomst vraagt om creatieve breinen en slimme oplossingen

“Architectuur gaat voor mij over meer dan een goed ontwerp. Het gaat over samenwerken, keuzes maken en zorgen dat een idee uiteindelijk ook echt gerealiseerd kan worden. Als projectleider verbind je ontwerp, techniek en opdrachtgever en geef je samen met je team richting aan het proces. Juist die combinatie maakt deze rol interessant.”

- Emiel Hengst – business unit manager Architectuur

Werken bij Sweco betekent dat je onderdeel wordt van het grootste architecten- en ingenieursnetwerk van Europa. Je hebt de kennis van ruim 24.000 collega’s met één druk op de knop binnen handbereik. Onze business unit Architectuur in Nederland bestaat uit 75 collega’s, verspreid over Maastricht, Eindhoven en Utrecht. Samen werken we aan een bijzondere mix van projecten: van woningbouw en zorg tot complexe opgaven binnen de hightech maakindustrie en leisure. Juist die grote variatie maakt het werk interessant, want het ene moment werk je aan een gebouw voor de zorg, het volgende aan een complexe hightech omgeving waarin techniek, architectuur en functionaliteit nauw samenkomen. Als junior projectleider beweeg je je daardoor steeds tussen verschillende vraagstukken, opdrachtgevers en disciplines en werk je samen met architecten, engineers, BIM-specialisten en andere experts aan gebouwen die écht ergens over gaan.

Als junior projectleider architectuur groei je uit tot de verbindende schakel tussen opdrachtgever, architecten, engineers en andere betrokken disciplines. Je ondersteunt bij het bewaken van de voortgang en kwaliteit van projecten, houdt samen met het team de communicatielijnen helder en werkt mee aan de coördinatie van de engineering. Je hebt contact met opdrachtgevers en denkt mee over inhoudelijke en financiële vraagstukken. Daarbij leer je steeds beter overzicht te houden over het proces en zorg je er samen met ervaren collega’s voor dat ontwerp en engineering goed op elkaar aansluiten. BIM speelt hierin een belangrijke rol: we werken voortdurend aan het verder verhogen van de kwaliteit van onze ontwerpen en processen. Heb je al enige ervaring met projectleiding, dan krijg je volop ruimte om hierin verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Heb je vooral ervaring binnen architectuur en wil je de stap maken richting projectleiding? Ook dan nodigen we je nadrukkelijk uit om te solliciteren. We kijken niet alleen naar wat je al kunt, maar ook naar de stap die je wilt maken.

Je krijgt bij Sweco de ruimte om je verder te ontwikkelen, zowel als projectleider als binnen de architectuur. Je werkt aan projecten met verschillende schaalgroottes en opdrachtgevers en kunt samenwerken met specialisten vanuit allerlei disciplines. Daarnaast is er ruimte om je verder te verdiepen in BIM, projectmanagement of juist een andere richting binnen het vak. We zoeken iemand die verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen, graag samenwerkt en energie krijgt van het realiseren van goede ontwerpen. Met ongeveer twee jaar ervaring ben je toe aan een volgende stap in je ontwikkeling en krijg je bij ons de ruimte om die stap te zetten. Samen kijken we naar wat jij al kunt bijdragen én waar jij naartoe wilt groeien.


[sweco-recruitee-vacancy-summary]

Dit is wat we jou bieden

Bij Sweco zit je goed. Dit mag je verwachten van een werkgever met het World-class Workplace label. Om te beginnen ontvang je een goed salaris en maar liefst 32 vakantiedagen. Daarnaast bieden we een thuiswerkvergoeding, vakantietoeslag, een circulaire thuiswerkplek en een uitstekende pensioenregeling waar Sweco 85% van de maandelijkse inleg betaalt.

Daarnaast krijg je bij Sweco veel regie, vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Over hoeveel je werkt, waar je werkt, hoe je werkt en wanneer je werkt. En heb je binnen ons arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket de keuze om te kiezen op welke manier jij reist. We stimuleren duurzame en actieve keuzes en belonen deze extra. Ook krijg je direct toegang tot de Sweco Academy voor zeer ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden en tot ons vitaliteitsprogramma gericht op leefstijl en sport.


Naast uitdagend werk, support en middelen pakken we bij Sweco ook graag uit als het gaat om ontspanning en lol. We willen graag dat je met veel plezier naar je werk gaat. Denk aan de dagelijkse Fika’s op kantoor, events op jouw vestiging, en activiteiten vanuit Jong Sweco en de lokale personeelsverenigingen.

Solliciteer op deze functie

Enthousiast geworden? Solliciteer dan direct via de button ‘solliciteren’. We kijken uit naar je cv en motivatie!

Neem bij vragen of interesse in Sweco contact op met Lindsay van Heugten via, recruitment business partner, via +31 6 23 91 53 17
of lindsay.vanheugten@sweco.nl.

  • Een afgeronde bachelor- of masteropleiding in de richting van Architectuur, Bouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring binnen de bouwbranche;

  • Affiniteit met BIM en digitale ontwerp- en werkprocessen; kennis van Revit is een pre;

title: Tax Director - LATAM
description:
Job Summary:

WHO ARE WE?

Live Nation Entertainment is the world’s leading live entertainment company, comprised of global market leaders: Ticketmaster, Live Nation Concerts, and Live Nation Media & Sponsorship. Ticketmaster is the global leader in event ticketing with over 620 million tickets sold annually and approximately 10,000 clients worldwide. Live Nation Concerts is the largest provider of live entertainment in the world promoting more than 50,000 events annually for nearly 7,000 artists in 40+ countries. These businesses allow Live Nation Media & Sponsorship to create strategic music marketing programs that connect more than 1,200 sponsors with the 145 million fans that attend Live Nation Entertainment events each year. For additional information, visit .

WHO ARE YOU?

Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!

THE ROLE

The LATAM Tax Director owns the tax function for Live Nation Entertainment’s Latin American operations (including Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico and Peru). This individual contributor sets the regional tax strategy, makes and recommends the tax decisions affecting the region, and is accountable for the accuracy, efficiency and risk posture of direct tax, indirect tax, transfer pricing and global minimum tax matters across all LATAM jurisdictions.


Operating with a high degree of independence, the Director defines how the region responds to a rapidly evolving Latin American tax landscape, determines the positions the company takes on complex and often unprecedented technical matters, and serves as the authoritative tax voice to regional and corporate leadership. Fluency in Spanish is required.

WHAT THIS ROLE WILL DO


Regional Tax Strategy & Governance

  • • Own the LATAM tax strategy, including the annual and multi-year regional tax plan, and align it with corporate tax, finance and business objectives.

  • • Establish the governance framework, policies and controls under which tax is managed across LATAM jurisdictions, and hold the region accountable to them.

  • • Determine and document the company’s technical tax positions for the region, exercising independent judgment on complex, ambiguous and precedent-setting matters.

  • • Own the regional tax risk profile: identify, quantify, prioritize and mitigate exposures, and escalate material matters with a clear recommended course of action.

  • • Anticipate and interpret regulatory change (SAT in Mexico, AFIP in Argentina, Receita Federal in Brazil and other comparable authorities), assess business impact, and direct the company’s response.


Tax Provision, Compliance & Reporting

  • • Oversee LATAM direct and indirect tax compliance — income tax, VAT/IVA and withholding taxes — and ensure appropriate governance and consistency across jurisdictions.

  • • Own the tax provision and reporting for LATAM entities under US GAAP and IFRS, including the judgments underlying uncertain tax positions, valuation allowances and effective tax rate drivers.

  • • Lead LATAM implementation of and compliance with Pillar Two and Country-by-Country Reporting, including data readiness, modeling of outcomes and the region’s filing strategy.

  • • Direct the regional tax calendar and set the standard for quality, timeliness and audit-readiness of all filings and disclosures.

  • • Serve as the region’s decision-maker and technical authority in partnership with the U.S. and global tax teams on matters affecting LATAM.

  • Transfer Pricing & Intercompany

  • • Own the tax implications of intercompany transactions across the region and the design and defense of regional transfer-pricing positions.

  • • Direct the preparation and maintenance of transfer pricing documentation, local files and intercompany agreements, and approve the methodologies applied.

  • • Assess the regional impact of changes to the intercompany operating model and recommend structural adjustments to leadership.

  • Audit & Controversy

  • • Lead LATAM tax audits and controversy end to end, including strategy, negotiation posture, settlement recommendations and coordination of consistent positions across countries.

  • • Own root-cause analysis of audit findings and drive the process, documentation and control changes required to eliminate recurring exposures.

  • • Manage regional tax advisor and external auditor relationships, including selection, scope, budget, performance and resolution of tax matters.


Transactions & Structuring

  • • Lead and advise on LATAM tax planning for cross-border transactions, repatriations and cash-movement strategies, and recommend the approach the company adopts.

  • • Own tax due diligence for regional M&A and joint ventures, evaluate identified exposures, and advise deal teams and senior leadership on materiality and mitigation.

  • • Determine the optimal structure for new entities, joint ventures and market entries, and direct implementation.

  • • Evaluate the existing regional structure for tax inefficiencies and lead the design and execution of optimization initiatives.

  • • Negotiate tax provisions, permanent establishment protections, and indirect and withholding tax terms in transaction documents, in partnership with Legal.

  • Process, Systems & Controls

  • • Lead the tax workstream for the Cumulus SAP rollout across LATAM, setting the standard processes, procedures and best practices for the region.

  • • Identify and drive process improvement and automation opportunities enabled by expanded data and ERP functionality.

  • • Own the design and operating effectiveness of tax-related internal controls for LATAM, including Sarbanes-Oxley documentation, and guide local teams through financial audit requirements.


Stakeholder Leadership & Influence

  • • Act as the senior tax business partner for LATAM, advising regional and corporate leadership on the tax consequences of business decisions and influencing outcomes accordingly.

  • • Partner with Finance, Legal, Treasury and Human Resources on payroll tax, permanent establishment, employment structuring and other cross-functional tax matters.

  • • Represent the company with tax authorities, external advisors and industry groups on LATAM tax matters.

  • • Build regional tax capability by mentoring and developing finance and accounting colleagues across LATAM, and by delegating and reviewing the work of advisors and junior professionals.

Scope & Decision Authority

  • Individual contributor with no direct reports; leads through influence, delegation to external advisors, and direction of in-country finance teams.

  • Sets policy and strategy for the LATAM tax function with a one- to three-year horizon.

  • Operates with minimal supervision; work is reviewed for strategic alignment rather than technical accuracy.

  • Regularly communicates and negotiates with executive leadership, external advisors and tax authorities on matters of material financial consequence

WHAT THIS PERSON WILL BRING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law or a related field; CPA, Contador Público, tax law qualification or Master’s in Taxation strongly preferred.

  • Minimum 12 years of progressive international tax experience, including substantial LATAM multi-jurisdiction responsibility gained in a multinational corporate tax department, Big 4, or comparable professional services environment.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a regional or multi-country tax function, including accountability for technical positions, risk and audit outcomes

  • Deep technical command of LATAM direct and indirect tax regimes, transfer pricing, tax treaties, permanent establishment risk and cross-border structuring.

  • Working knowledge of Pillar Two / OECD BEPS 2.0 and Country-by-Country Reporting, with practical implementation experience preferred.

  • Strong US GAAP and IFRS tax accounting and provision expertise (ASC 740 / IAS 12).

  • • Proven ability to influence senior and executive stakeholders and to translate complex technical matters into clear business recommendations

  • Experience leading tax workstreams within an ERP implementation (SAP preferred)

  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English required; Portuguese strongly preferred.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Our motto is ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ through 6 pillars of benefits:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)

  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days

  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program

  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave and baby bonuses, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support

  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment

  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.


Live Nation strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act and consistent with other similar and / or applicable laws in other areas.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Live Nation will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Live Nation also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. Applicants are invited to identify reasonable accommodations that can be made to assist them to perform the essential functions of the position they seek. Any applicant who requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job should contact a Human Resources Representative to request the opportunity to participate in a timely interactive process. Live Nation will also provide reasonable religious accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

HIRING PRACTICES
The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Live Nation recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Live Nation may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms.

title: Senior Product Designer, Enterprise
description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.

We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.

Summary:

We're seeking a Senior Product Designer to join our Enterprise team focused on strategic initiatives to verticalize Clio’s enterprise products into specialized domains. Our Enterprise offerings cover Vincent, Clio's AI-powered legal intelligence platform, and Operate, our enterprise-grade practice and matter management platform. As part of Clio's Enterprise division, this role sits at the heart of our most ambitious growth story. Clio Operate and Vincent together form a category-defining product suite enabling untethered growth for legal clients worldwide. Operate grew revenue by ~100% in 2025, and Vincent is accelerating fast.

This role is available to candidates in Canada (excluding Quebec) and the US, with a strong preference for candidates based on the East Coast. If you are located near our Toronto or NYC hub, you will be expected to work in the office a minimum of twice per week on our designated Anchor Days.

What your team does

Design plays an integral role at Clio, making up one of the three pillars of our Research and Development organization alongside Product Management and Engineering. Product designers directly engage in researching the behaviors and needs of our users. They act as user experience champions as we work to transform the way that lawyers and their staff provide services to their clients. We empower Product Designers to shape how lawyers serve their clients. If you are passionate about user-centered design, mission-driven companies, and transforming how lawyers and their staff deliver exceptional client services, join us!

What you'll work on

  • Design specialized, AI-driven workflows for distinct legal domains, including Finance, IP, Employment/Labour Law and Insurance Defense, translating deep domain nuance like case types, risk profiles, regulatory context into product decisions.

  • Partner closely with legal architects, subject-matter experts, and legal-industry stakeholders to validate that workflows and output reflect how practitioners in each domain actually work

  • Take early, high-ownership design leadership by helping shape problem definition, prioritization, and product direction in partnership with cross-functional stakeholders

  • Evaluate Operate's existing capabilities and design patterns, and determine which should be adapted or rebuilt into Vincent to give these verticals a stronger foundation, rather than starting from scratch.

  • Concept, prototype, and deliver design solutions for a corporate/in-house counsel audience alongside our traditional law-firm base, understanding how their workflows, risk tolerance, and priorities differ.

  • Conduct user research interviews, usability testing, and analysis specific to employment and insurance practitioners.

  • Leverage metrics to drive product design decisions and measure product success.

  • Contribute to design critiques and share thoughtful feedback with the broader team.

  • Help evolve design patterns and systems that support complex information architecture at scale.

  • Demonstrate a keen interest in improving your craft using AI.

  • Break down complex legal concepts into smaller, more manageable design problems.

  • Additional duties as required.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of experience in product design. SaaS or enterprise experience is preferred.

  • Experience designing for complex, information-dense environments including knowledge management, research, or discovery products.

  • A track record of shipping products that solve research or information workflow challenges and move company metrics.

  • Proficiency in user research methodologies and the ability to translate findings into actionable design insights.

  • Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, usability, and accessibility.

  • Experience with modern design tools (Figma, Figma Make) and willingness to adopt new tools as needed.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and presentation skills.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile product development environment.

  • Experience working on complex systems with large datasets, structured content, or AI-generated outputs.

  • A keen interest in improving your craft using AI.

    Bonus if you have...

    • Familiarity with legal workflows, legal technology platforms, or enterprise SaaS ecosystems.

    • Experience designing for regulated, high-stakes, or compliance-sensitive domains.

    • Experience designing for in-house/corporate legal teams specifically, as distinct from law-firm users.

    #LI-Remote

    This is a new role.

    What you will find here:

    Compensation is one of the main components of Clio’s Total Rewards Program. We have developed a series of programs and processes to ensure we are creating fair and competitive pay practices that form the foundation of our human and high-performing culture.

    Some highlights of our Total Rewards program include:

    • Competitive, equitable salary with top-tier health benefits, dental, and vision insurance

    • Hybrid work environment, with expectation for local Clions (Vancouver, Calgary, Toronto, Dublin, London, New York City and Sydney) to be in office min. twice per week.

    • Flexible time off policy, with an encouraged 20 days off per year.

    • $2000 annual counseling benefit

    • RRSP matching and RESP contribution

    • Clioversary recognition program with special acknowledgement at 3, 5, 7, and 10 years

    The expected salary range for this role is $131,600 to $178,000 CAD. Initial placement within the range is informed by geographic region, experience, and skillset, with room to progress as impact and tenure grow. Final offer amounts will vary based on candidate profile.

    Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity (DIBE) & Accessibility

    Our team shows up as their authentic selves, and are united by our mission. We are dedicated to diversity, equity and inclusion. We pride ourselves in building and fostering an environment where our teams feel included, valued, and enabled to do the best work of their careers, wherever they choose to log in from. We believe that different perspectives, skills, backgrounds, and experiences result in higher-performing teams and better innovation. We are committed to equal employment and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

    Clio provides accessibility accommodations during the recruitment process. Should you require any accommodation, please let us know and we will work with you to meet your needs.

    Learn more about our culture at clio.com/careers

    We're a Human and High Performing AI company, meaning we use artificial intelligence to improve all of our operations. In recruitment, AI helps us streamline the process for greater efficiency. However, we've built our systems to ensure that a human always reviews AI-generated output, and we never make automated hiring decisions.

description:
Dev Ops Lead – Virtual Assistant and Automation

Position: Dev Ops Lead – Virtual Assistant and Automation

FULL JOB DESCRIPTION

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner.

Role Purpose

  • Lead the technical design, development and deployment of enterprise AI-enabled solutions aligned to People & Culture priorities
  • Own service integrity, operational excellence, and governance across AI and digital people platforms
  • Handle and partner with external vendors / configuration centres to deliver scalable, compliant solutions globally
  • Act as a link between engineering, product, data science ensuring solutions move beyond prototypes into sustainable production

AI & Engineering Leadership

  • Design, develop and maintain production-grade AI applications and services using modern engineering practices (cloud-native design, CI/CD, testing, observability).
  • Define and implement reusable AI platforms and capabilities (e.g. conversational assistants, AI search, unstructured data processing, GenAI solutions).
  • Lead architectural decisions, ensuring responsible AI, explain ability, security, and operational robustness are embedded by design.
  • Evaluate and integrate LLMs, vector databases, RAG patterns, agent-based frameworks, and AI APIs into enterprise-ready solutions.
  • Champion automation across the AI lifecycle from data ingestion to deployment and run.

Service, Delivery & Governance Ownership

  • Be the point of accountability for system and solution integrity, ensuring incidents, risks and issues are led clearly and effectively.
  • Define and maintain service catalogues, clarifying scope, ownership, and delivery expectations.
  • Ensure solutions meet bp standards, compliance requirements (incl. SoX), and global consistency needs.
  • Chair regular governance, operational risk, and retrospective sessions with partners and vendors.
  • Ensure smooth transition of new solutions, enhancements, and AI capabilities into run-state operations.
  • Lead external vendors / configuration centres, ensuring capacity, capability, and delivery quality align with demand.
  • Act as a key partner to Global Solution Owners, P&C leadership, technology teams, and business customers.

Inspiring change from incremental improvements through to transformations

Thought leadership in AI, VA and automation solutions

Building partnerships

  • Securing alignment on priorities and leading their requirements / expectations on projects
  • Building strategic relationships / partnerships with external partners where appropriate
  • Assisting I&E in the operational oversight of our vendors / partners

Building a high-performing team

  • Inspiring and motivating a permanent team, and third-party project resources, to deliver great results
  • Develop a safe, inclusive, high-performance environment where teams can innovate and deliver at pace.

  • Presents the highest level of professional individual contribution and imparts technical expertise to lower level team members;
  • Advises and directs subordinates and project resources to help accomplish assignments using established guidelines, procedures and policies;
  • Reviews and evaluates team members’ performance.

Essential Experience and Job Requirements:

Actively working to develop capability in line with the P&C Capability Framework, with an equal blend of EQ, IQ and drive.

Technical Capability

  • Confirmed experience in multiple organisational change management roles, including demonstrated skills in leadership alignment, partner identification and analysis
  • Shown experience delivering enterprise-scale systems and AI-enabled solutions in production
  • Strong programming skills (Python preferred; Java or similar acceptable)
  • Solid experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and modern DevOps practices
  • Experience integrating machine learning / GenAI models into real-world systems
  • Experience with LLMs, RAG, vector search, conversational AI, or unstructured data pipelines
  • Familiarity with AI tooling/frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, Hugging Face, CrewAI)
  • Experience leading SaaS / cloud-based HR or enterprise platforms
  • Skilled at using data and analytics to identify outcomes and improve decision making; e.g. process improvements and candidate experience improvements

Business Capability

  • Customer focus – all decisions clearly aligned to customer strategy.
  • Drives value-adding solutions – deeply integrated to ultimately improve business performance and disrupt, where necessary. Consistent track record of improving/adding customer value and taking things to the next level
  • Externally orientated – aware of protocol and actively shares with, and learns from others
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced global environments

Leadership & EQ Capability

  • Cultural fluency – ability to operate successfully across cultural boundaries with sensitivity
  • Project management experience using both Agile and Waterfall methodologies
  • Sound understanding of trends in the relevant process / technology areas

Job Details:

General Notes

Remote work allowed. Remote work for individuals who reside outside Texas but within the United States and its territories will be considered and requires Central Office approval.

The threat landscape we operate in requires a team to respond appropriately; therefore, please apply even if you are unsure if your experience is relevant. The most important ingredients for success on this team are a strong ability to think creatively about problems, very strong communication skills, and a passion to learn and share knowledge.

You will get to work with a very intelligent and dedicated team to address enterprise cybersecurity challenges through novel approaches in an office that highly values work-life balance, the freedom to explore out of the box ideas, and serving others.


Most importantly, you will help take our tools and ideas to the next level. What starts here changes the world!

Your skills will make a difference.

You’ll be working for a university that is internationally recognized for our academic programs and research. Your work will contribute to operational excellence and enhance the student experience. If you’re the type of person that wants to know your work has meaning and impact, you’ll like working in our department and for UT Austin. UT Austin provides an outstanding benefits package including but not limited to:

  • Competitive health benefits (employee premiums covered at 100%, family premiums at 50%)
  • Voluntary Vision, Dental, Life, and Disability insurance options
  • Generous paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
  • Teachers Retirement System of Texas, a defined benefit retirement plan, with employer matching funds
  • Additional Voluntary Retirement Programs: Tax Sheltered Annuity 403(b) and a Deferred Compensation program 457(b)
  • Flexible spending account options for medical and childcare expenses
  • Robust free training access through LinkedIn Learning plus professional conference opportunities
  • Tuition Assistance
  • Expansive employee discount program including athletic tickets
  • Free access to UT Austin's libraries and museums with staff ID card
  • Free rides on all UT Shuttle and Austin CapMetro buses with staff ID card

For more details, please see: and .


This position requires you to maintain Internet service and a mobile phone with voice and data plans to be used when required for work.

Must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis for any employer without sponsorship.

Purpose

The Cybersecurity Threat and Vulnerability Analyst will collaborate with a small team of risk management engineers to evaluate daily threats relative to vulnerabilities present on campus and will develop response protocols and reports to effectively reduce risk and manage threats.

Responsibilities

  • Discover and investigate security vulnerabilities including zero days.

title: Postdoc, Adaptive Barrier Performance & Visible Health (2-year Fixed Term)
company: PROCTER & GAMBLE INTERNATIONAL OPERATIONS SA SINGAPORE BRANCH
description:
Overview of role

What if your science could improve the lives of billions of people, every day, across every stage of life? Skin and scalp biology is one of humanity's most universal and enduring dimensions of health and wellbeing. It accompanies us from infancy through adolescence, adulthood, and healthy aging, shaping how we protect and care for ourselves and our loved ones.

The scientific challenges are equally diverse and compelling: supporting skin barrier health in early life, understanding the biological transitions of puberty, enabling superior shaving, grooming, and body care experiences, addressing lifelong scalp disorders such as dandruff, combating hair loss, understanding the biological impacts of menopause, and ultimately unlocking healthier skin and scalp aging throughout longer lifespans. New interventions such as GLP-1 therapies, regenerative medicine approaches, and hair transplantation are further transforming consumer needs and creating unprecedented opportunities for scientific discovery and innovation.

The launch of the Skin Bioscience Discovery Accelerator (SBDA) at the P&G Singapore Innovation Center represents a bold commitment to seize this opportunity and shape the future of skin and scalp science. Combining world-class bioscience, advanced experimental systems, multimodal data, computational biology, and AI-enabled discovery, the Accelerator aims to create a fundamentally new engine for innovation in skin and scalp health.

This is an invitation to ambitious scientists who want their work to matter beyond the laboratory. You will join a global ecosystem of scientific excellence and work closely with P&G Research Fellows, senior technical leaders, and internationally recognized experts located in Singapore and across P&G's worldwide R&D network. Through mentorship, collaboration, and exposure to some of the company's most accomplished innovators, you will tackle frontier scientific challenges while developing the skills and perspective needed to lead the next generation of discovery. If you are driven by scientific excellence, inspired by large-scale impact, and motivated to tackle some of the most important unanswered questions in human biology, we invite you to help shape the future of skin and scalp health for billions around the world.

This 2-year Postdoc position will explore how skin and scalp function as adaptive biological systems that maintain health, resilience, and visible performance throughout life. By combining advanced biology and AI-enabled discovery, the program seeks to uncover the fundamental mechanisms that govern how these systems evolve from infancy through healthy aging. This is a unique opportunity to pioneer a new understanding of skin and scalp across the human healthspan.

Key Responsibilities

Pioneer new scientific frameworks and discovery approaches to advance understanding of biological performance, resilience, regeneration, and health across the lifespan.

Design and execute high-impact research programs leveraging advanced biology, human-relevant experimental systems, multimodal data, and AI-enabled discovery.

Work alongside P&G Research Fellows and global scientific leaders to shape scientific strategy and accelerate breakthrough discovery.

Operate within a Design-Build-Test-Learn discovery environment, integrating experiments, computational approaches, and emerging technologies to drive continuous learning.

Translate breakthrough discoveries into publications, intellectual property, external collaborations, and technology opportunities with global consumer impact.

Qualifications
-PhD in Skin Biology, Systems Biology, Dermatology, Cell Biology, Regenerative Medicine, Biomedical Sciences, Computational Biology, or a related discipline.

-Scientists currently completing, or having recently completed, a postdoctoral appointment in a relevant field are also encouraged to apply.

-Demonstrated research excellence through high-quality publications in peer-reviewed scientific journals.

-Strong expertise in one or more relevant biological domains, including: -Skin biology, biochemistry, and physiology, -Barrier biology, -Epithelial tissue biology, -Inflammation and immune regulation, -Aging biology and longevity, -Wound healing and tissue repair, -Extracellular matrix and dermal biology and/or -Regenerative medicine

-Hands-on experience with advanced experimental techniques and biological model systems.

-Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills.

-Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex scientific concepts to multidisciplinary audiences.

-Self driven with demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

-Experience with advanced imaging technologies and image analysis.

-Experience generating and interpreting multi-omics datasets.

-Familiarity with computational biology, bioinformatics, statistics, machine learning, or AI-enabled biological discovery.

-Experience working with complex biological systems and systems-level approaches to understanding health and disease.

-Experience developing, applying, or interpreting advanced in vitro, ex vivo, or engineered tissue biological models.

-Experience integrating biological, imaging, and computational datasets to generate mechanistic insights powered by AI.

-Knowledge of skin aging, barrier dysfunction, inflammation, or visible skin health.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in scientists who:

-Are motivated by solving bold, high-impact scientific challenges rather than incremental research questions.

-Thrive in highly interdisciplinary environments spanning biology, data science, engineering, and artificial intelligence.

-Are intellectually curious and energized by complexity.

-Demonstrate creativity in connecting ideas across scientific disciplines.

-Are passionate about translating biological discoveries into meaningful consumer impact.

-Aspire to build new scientific frameworks rather than operate solely within established paradigms.

-Are excited by the opportunity to shape the future of skin and scalp science and improve the lives of billions of consumers worldwide.

What Will Make You Stand Out

-A track record of pioneering new methodologies, models, or scientific concepts.

-Experience working at the interface of biology and data science.

-A desire to help define the next generation of AI-enabled bioscience discovery.

-Evidence of scientific leadership, innovation, and independent thinking.

-Demonstrated ability to translate complex biological observations into actionable hypotheses.

-A strong interest in adaptive biological systems, resilience, aging, and biological performance.

About us

We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.

Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.

Our consumers are diverse and our talents - internally - mirror this diversity to best serve it. That is why we’re committed to building a winning culture based on Inclusion and our ideal candidate is passionate about the same principle: you will join our daily effort of being “in touch” so we craft brands and products to improve the lives of the world’s consumers now and in the future. We want you to inspire us with your unrivaled ideas.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, veteran status, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor.

Maybe it’s our focus on employee development, maybe it’s the generous time off, or just that we are an Employees First company altogether (check it out), but there’s a reason why you’ll find most of our employees have made Inpro their career, not just a job.

Job Summary

The Sample Fulfillment Associate is responsible for accurately picking, preparing, packaging, and shipping customer sample requests. This role helps ensure customers receive high-quality samples, literature, binders, color chain sets, and related materials in a timely and accurate manner while supporting inventory control, quality standards, and department communication.

Duties and Responsibilities

Essential Functions (the primary duties this position exists to perform; reasonable accommodation will be considered for these duties as required by law):

  1. Pick sample orders accurately according to request details, product type, quantity, and shipping instructions.
  2. Pack samples, literature, binders, color rings, and related materials to protect product quality during shipment.
  3. Prepare sample shipments as requested by Sales and other internal teams.
  4. Monitor sample inventory and notify the team leader when materials fall below established stocking levels.
  5. Maintain communication with the Sample Department and other departments to support accurate and timely sample fulfillment.

Marginal / Secondary Functions (performed periodically; not the primary reason the position exists):

  • Assist with organizing, replenishing, and maintaining sample materials and work areas.
  • Help train new sample department employees as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned, at any time with or without notice.

Key Responsibilities and Abilities

The Sample Fulfillment Associate is expected to consistently demonstrate the ability to:

  • Ship high-quality sample materials that meet customer expectations.
  • Work efficiently while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Communicate clearly with team members, Sales, and other departments, in person, by phone, and by email.
  • Support department goals for customer satisfaction, quality, safety, and on-time fulfillment.

  • Distinguish colors accurately – this is required to visually match and verify color chain sets and color-coded samples against customer specifications, an essential function of the role.

  • Follow company policies, procedures, quality standards, and safety requirements.

Education and Experience

Reporting Relationship

Physical Requirements

title: Digital Data and Technology Apprentice
description:
The Welsh Government operates name-free recruitment. The recruiting panel will not see personal information such as a candidate’s name and address during the sifting process. This policy is in line with our commitment to end bias and promote equality and diversity.

Digital Data and Technology Apprentice

28/09/2026, 16:00

Advertising basis Apprenticeship

Salary range or pay band Team Support £27,302 to £29,291

Work pattern Full time (applications are welcome from people who work part time, as part of a job share or who work full time)

Duration These posts are for 2 years with the potential to convert to a permanent contract upon successful completion of Apprenticeship, their performance and the availability of suitable vacancies.

Group Welsh Government (Corporate Scheme Only)

Location (s) Pan Wales

‘Pan Wales’ means the post holder can be based in any Welsh Government office, subject to business needs. Roles based outside Wales, including London, are not available unless explicitly stated in the advert.

A list of the Welsh Government’s offices can be found on www.gov.wales/welsh-government-offices . Please note it may not always be possible to accommodate a preference for a specific office location.

The post holder’s travel from their home to their assigned Welsh Government office is considered their ‘ordinary commute’ and must be done in their own time and at their own cost.

About the Opportunity

Are you curious about technology and how it can be used to improve people's lives? Do you enjoy solving problems, learning new things and working with others to make a difference?

If so, the Welsh Government's Digital, Data and Technology (DDaT) Apprenticeship could be the perfect place to start your career.

You’ll earn while you learn, gaining recognised qualifications, hands‑on experience and the opportunity to work on projects that help improve public services across Wales. From health and education to the environment and tourism, you’ll contribute to work that has a real impact on people's everyday lives.

As part of the apprenticeship, you’ll undertake up to three placements across different DDaT teams, giving you the opportunity to explore a variety of career paths and develop valuable skills in areas such as digital development, user research, data, cyber security, communication and problem solving.

No previous experience is needed! We're looking for people who are enthusiastic, motivated and eager to learn. If you have an interest in technology and a desire to develop new skills, we'll provide the training, support and opportunities you need to build a successful career in Digital, Data and Technology. All you need to bring is curiosity, commitment and a willingness to learn.

Key activities

As a DDaT Apprentice, no two days will be the same. Depending on your placement, you could be:

  • Working with colleagues and users to understand problems and identify opportunities for improvement
  • Supporting user research activities to help design services that meet people's needs
  • Taking part in testing digital services and websites to help make them easier and more accessible to use
  • Contributing to digital projects, researching issues and helping to develop solutions
  • Working with data to identify trends, support decision-making and improve services
  • Collaborating with a range of specialists, including developers, business analysts, user researchers and cyber security professionals
  • Creating presentations, reports and other communications to share insights and recommendations
  • Supporting day‑to‑day team activities, including organising meetings, managing information and responding to enquiries
  • Learning about new technologies, tools and ways of working through your placements and apprenticeship studies

We're looking for people who are:

  • Interested in digital, data and technology
  • Curious and motivated to learn new skills
  • Enthusiastic about solving problems and improving services
  • Comfortable working with others and sharing ideas
  • Open to new ways of working and adapting to change
  • Able to research information and think critically
  • Organised and able to manage their time effectively
  • Keen to balance work and study as part of their apprenticeship

No previous DDaT experience is required. We're interested in your enthusiasm, potential and willingness to learn. We'll provide the training and support you need to succeed.

About the qualification

What qualification and training will I receive?

As part of the scheme, you'll work towards a Level 3 Apprenticeship in ICT, Software, Web and Telecoms while gaining valuable hands‑on experience in a range of DDaT roles across Welsh Government.

You’ll be supported throughout your apprenticeship by experienced colleagues and a dedicated training provider, who will help you develop the knowledge, skills and confidence needed to succeed.

The apprenticeship typically lasts around 18 months, with:

  • 80% of your time spent learning through practical experience in the workplace
  • 20% of your time dedicated to structured learning, including classroom sessions, online learning, self‑study and assignments

Alongside your apprenticeship qualification, you'll receive additional learning and development opportunities through both the DDaT profession and Welsh Government's wider training programme.

To successfully complete the apprenticeship you will need to have:

  • Passed your probation period
  • Achieved your Certificate in ICT, Software, Web and Telecoms
  • Demonstrated the skills and experience required by the DDaT profession apprenticeship framework

By the end of the programme, you'll have gained a recognised qualification, valuable workplace experience and a strong foundation for a career in Digital, Data and Technology.

Am I eligible?

To apply for the DDaT Apprentice Scheme, you will need to:

  • Meet the Civil Service Nationality requirements
  • Be at least 16 years of age by 1st September 2026. There is no upper age limit
  • Not be in full-time education when you start in March 2027

You do not need any previous experience or specific qualifications to apply. We're looking for people who are motivated to learn and have an interest in digital, data and technology.

If you already hold a Level 3 qualification or above in ICT, Software, Web and Telecoms (or a closely related subject), you may not be eligible for this apprenticeship.

If you are unsure whether your qualifications affect your eligibility, please contact DDaT.Apprenticeship@gov.wales for advice.

As part of the apprenticeship, you will also need to complete the Wales Essential Skills Toolkit (WEST) assessment. This online assessment helps evaluate your literacy, numeracy and digital skills and identifies whether any additional support or development may be beneficial when undertaking your apprenticeship.

As a DDaT Apprentice, you'll have access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities designed to help you grow both professionally and personally.

You’ll gain hands‑on experience working on meaningful projects that support public services across Wales, while collaborating with colleagues from across the Digital, Data and Technology profession and wider Welsh Government.

We’ll support you every step of the way through a combination of workplace learning, formal training and development opportunities, including:

  • A recognised apprenticeship qualification
  • Mentoring, coaching and wellbeing support
  • Online and classroom‑based learning
  • Opportunities to build your professional network
  • Experience working across different teams and projects
  • Access to further learning and development opportunities as your career progresses
  • Support to develop your Welsh language skills in a bilingual workplace

By the end of the scheme, you’ll have developed valuable skills, gained practical experience and built a strong foundation for a successful career in Digital, Data and Technology.

Other vacancy related information

Work Pattern

Full time (applications are welcome from people who work part time, as part of a job share or who work full time)

37 hours per week. Applications from those wishing to work part‑time are welcome, but you will need to be able to work at least 21 hours per week to give sufficient time to complete the apprenticeship

Open Days & Virtual Events

You can learn more about the benefits of working for the Welsh Government by exploring our Employee Benefits Pack.

If you would like to find out more about this opportunity, we’re excited to invite you to a variety of events including open days and virtual webinars, all tailored to support you with your application

Come along and meet the team. We will be discussing the DDaT apprenticeship scheme in and you’ll get a chance to hear from some of our ex‑apprentices who have previously completed the scheme.

Virtual Webinars

English Language sessions
