  • 03/09/2026 - 6pm – 7pm Microsoft Teams Link
  • 15/09/2026 - 6pm – 7pm Microsoft Teams Link

Welsh Language sessions

  • 25/08/2026 - 2pm – 3pm Microsoft Teams Link

Open Days in September

There will be two sessions per day, one at 11am – 2pm and the other at 3.30pm - 6pm.

  • Merthyr Tydfil - 09/09/2026
  • Cathays Park - 10/09/2026
  • Llandudno Junction -16/09/2026
  • Aberystwyth - 22/09/2026

Hear from our apprentices

Our past apprentices have written blogs about their experience during the scheme. You can read all the latest apprentice blogs on the digital and data blog.

Some of our apprentices have filmed case study videos talking about their experience – these can be found on the Welsh Government apprenticeship website.

For support with your application, check out our Application Tips video for insightful information and step‑by‑step guidance on the process. After watching the Application Tips video, remember to review our candidate guidance pack https://www.gov.wales/sites/default/files/inline-documents/2026-08/apprenticeship-2026-candidate-guidance.pdf. This document outlines the recruitment process and provides detailed instructions on completing the application form and navigating the jobs site.

Assessment Process

Stage 1 – Application

After submitting your application, you can expect to receive an email containing a link to complete an eligibility check with our Apprenticeship Training Provider. It is essential that you complete this check, as we will be unable to progress your application without it.

As part of the eligibility checks, the training provider may ask to see copies of your educational certificates, either during the initial eligibility check or as part of the pre‑employment checks process.

During this stage, we will also be assessing the evidence provided in your application form (sift).

In the event of a large number of applications, we may increase the minimum score required to pass the sift.

If you successfully pass both the eligibility checks and the sift, then you will be invited to attend an interview.

All applicants will be notified of their outcome.

Stage 2 – Interview

Interviews are expected to take place during November and will be conducted online via Microsoft Teams. All candidates will be notified of the outcome of their interview.

Stage 3 – Offer

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment process will receive a conditional offer of an apprenticeship with the Welsh Government. Once you accept the conditional offer, we will begin the pre‑employment checks process, which typically takes between 6 and 8 weeks to complete.

During this stage you will also need to undertake the WEST test mentioned above.

Reserve List

A reserve list may be held for this opportunity. Any candidate who is successful in being offered a reserve status, will remain on the reserve list for 12 months. If suitable roles become available during this time, we may contact you.

Induction and Training

Once all your pre‑employment checks are complete and your start date has been confirmed, you'll take part in an induction and training programme with the rest of your apprenticeship cohort.

We want to make your learning experience as engaging and supportive as possible. Some training sessions may take place at our Cathays Park office in Cardiff, giving you the opportunity to learn alongside other apprentices, build your network and get to know colleagues from across the organisation.

We'll do our best to keep travel to a minimum and make any visits worthwhile by providing additional learning and development opportunities. Wherever possible, training will be delivered virtually.

Over the course of your apprenticeship, we expect that time spent training in Cardiff will be no more than four weeks in total. These sessions are likely to be arranged as one‑week "boot camps" spread throughout the programme. Any travel costs associated with attending apprenticeship training can be claimed and reimbursed.

Location

During the interview stage, you will be asked to indicate their preferred location(s). We will make every effort to offer a role in your preferred location; however, this cannot be guaranteed.

The DDaT Apprentices are based at the following office locations:

  • Cardiff
  • Merthyr
  • Aberystwyth
  • Llandudno

We will consider requests to work in specific locations based on personal circumstances like caring responsibilities or an impairment or health condition.

Office attendance

We support Smart Working: a flexible, inclusive and safe approach that balances organisational needs with individual wellbeing.

Most colleagues are expected to spend at least 40% of their working time in the office (around two days a week, pro rata for part‑time colleagues) to support collaboration, connection and delivery. The remainder of the week may be spent working from home or other locations, although some roles may require more office‑based attendance to meet business needs.

Smart Working is supported through regular conversations with managers, Team Charters and agreed working arrangements that help teams work effectively across office, remote and blended environments.

Vetting level Basic

Number of posts 6

Contact point for further information regarding the post DDaT.apprenticeship@gov.wales

Selection Process and Stages

Welsh Government, like all other Government Departments use Success Profiles when we recruit. For each role we consider what you will need to demonstrate to be successful. The selection process and stages are:

2 stage process

Stage 2 Interview

Experience of working with others

This will be tested at Stage 1: Application Form

Technical 1

Think about an example of technology that has improved an aspect of everyday life (for example, an app, device, website, or digital service).

In no more than 250 words, explain:

  • How this technology has improved daily life.
  • The benefits and positive impact it has had.
  • Any drawbacks, limitations, or potential negative consequences.

We are interested in your personal views and reflections, so please demonstrate enthusiasm and curiosity about the role technology can play in improving people's lives. Consider both the opportunities and challenges presented by your chosen example.

Nationality requirements

This job is broadly open to the following groups:

  • UK nationals
  • nationals of the Republic of Ireland
  • nationals of Commonwealth countries who have the right to work in the UK
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities with settled or pre‑settled status under the European Union Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • nationals of the EU, Switzerland, Norway, Iceland or Liechtenstein and family members of those nationalities who have made a valid application for settled or pre‑settled status under the EU Settlement Scheme (EUSS)
  • individuals with limited leave to remain or indefinite leave to remain who were eligible to apply for EUSS on or before 31 December 2020
  • Turkish nationals, and certain family members of Turkish nationals, who have accrued the right to work in the Civil Service

Social Model of Disability

Welsh Government has adopted the social model of disability, which recognises that barriers in society act to disable people who have impairments, or health conditions, who are neuro‑divergent or who use British Sign Language.

We are committed to removing barriers in the recruitment process so that all (or potential new) staff can perform at their best.

Recruitment adjustments can be made at any part of the recruitment process for candidates with an impairment or health condition, who are neuro‑divergent or who use British Sign Language.

We are committed to inclusive recruitment and offer interviews to eligible candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role through the following schemes:

Disability Confident

The Welsh Government is a Disability Confident Leader. As part of our commitment to this scheme we interview any candidate with an impairment, health condition, who is neuro‑divergent or who uses British Sign Language if they meet the minimum criteria for the post.

A Great Place to Work for Veterans

The Welsh Government operates the Great Place to Work for Veterans Initiative. As part of our commitment to this scheme we interview any eligible candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the post.

Redeployment Interview Scheme

Civil Service employers can offer an interview to a fair and proportionate number of civil servants who are at risk of redundancy and who meet the minimum criteria for the post.

Social Partnership

In Welsh Government, the relationship between the employer and trade unions is based on social partnership. We believe our goals can best be achieved by management and trade unions working together.

Our 3 recognised trade unions are:

  • PCS
  • Prospect
  • FDA

This relationship is underpinned by a partnership agreement. This sets out how our unions work with Welsh Government on issues such as:

  • Pay
  • Terms and conditions
  • HR Strategy, policies and procedures

Our Welsh Government trade union colleagues work together to give their members a real say in the workplace. They make sure that the interests of their members are promoted and protected. They also help reduce inequalities and improve terms and conditions.

We support you to join a recognised trade union, to ensure your voice is heard in the workplace.
We encourage you to learn more about our trade unions …

The Opportunity

As a Digital Manufacturing Consultant (MES, Digital Automation, Digital Twin) Senior Associate, you will engage with clients to transform their manufacturing operations through digital solutions. Within our Operations practice, you will leverage your skills to analyze complex problems and deliver impactful solutions that enhance product development and manufacturing processes. This role involves working closely with clients to understand their needs and develop tailored strategies that drive efficiency and innovation.

As a Senior Associate, you will focus on building meaningful client relationships and developing a deeper understanding of the business context. You will guide and mentor junior team members, helping them navigate complex situations and grow their personal brand. title: Senior Software Engineer (Full stack)
description:
About HUB24


At HUB24, we’re rethinking the way wealth management works, combining platform, technology and data to create better outcomes for financial professionals and their clients.

Our purpose is simple: Empower better financial futures, together.

What sets us apart is how we work. We back bold thinking, move with pace, and turn ideas into action. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact across your team, the business, and for the clients we support every day.

HUB24 Limited is an ASX-listed company (ASX: HUB) and part of the ASX100. We have over 1,100 employees across Australia, with offices in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth and the Gold Coast.


Why you’ll enjoy working here


We create an environment where you can do your best work and see the impact of it.

  • Work with smart, collaborative people who get things done.
  • Your ideas won’t sit in a backlog, they’ll be heard, tested and actioned.
  • Grow your career your way, with support to learn, stretch and explore new opportunities.

We also offer benefits to support you inside and outside of work:

  • Genuinely flexible and hybrid ways of working.
  • Employee Share Scheme.
  • Additional leave and wellbeing support.
  • Enhanced parental leave and support through different life stages.
  • Everyday benefits, including discounts and financial wellbeing support.


Why this is an exciting opportunity


At HUB24, we're building innovative platforms that empower financial advisers to deliver better client outcomes at scale. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, building and evolving the myhub platform, delivering scalable, secure and high-performing solutions used by thousands of advisers nationwide.

Working closely with Product, Architecture and Engineering leaders, you'll influence technical direction, contribute to architectural decisions, and solve complex engineering challenges across customer-facing applications, integrations and backend services. This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who enjoys taking ownership, mentoring others, and leveraging modern technologies, including AI-assisted development, to build impactful products.

What you’ll be doing


  • Design, build and maintain scalable web applications, APIs and microservices.
  • Develop clean, secure, testable and maintainable code.
  • Create modern, intuitive and engaging digital experiences using contemporary front-end technologies.
  • Collaborate with Product, Architecture and Engineering teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architectural decisions.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve engineering efficiency and outcomes.
  • Build scalable and resilient solutions that support high transaction volumes.
  • Implement caching, optimisation and performance improvement strategies.
  • Optimise database queries and data access patterns to maximise application performance.
  • Ensure the security, reliability and resilience of systems and services.
  • Conduct peer code reviews and promote engineering best practices.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, coding standards and development guidelines.
  • Champion automated testing and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Proactively identify, manage and remediate technical debt to ensure long-term platform sustainability.
  • Mentor, coach and support engineers across the team.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation and continuous learning.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies and contribute to successful delivery outcomes.
  • Partner with Product, DevOps, Cyber Security, Architecture and Support teams to achieve business objectives.
  • Provide support for production systems, including troubleshooting and issue resolution.
  • Contribute to platform stability, monitoring and ongoing service continuity.
  • Participate in occasional after-hours support activities as required.


What you bring


You don’t need to tick every box, but experience in the below will set you up for success.


Experience & Skills


  • Minimum 7+ years' experience in Software Engineering or a related senior technical role.
  • Experience designing and building enterprise-grade software applications.
  • Strong experience with Node.js (NestJS highly regarded).
  • Advanced proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML and CSS.
  • Experience with modern web application frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of relational databases (SQL Server or similar).
  • Experience developing and consuming APIs and microservices.
  • Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines and Agile delivery practices.
  • Experience with automated testing, debugging, performance tuning and optimisation.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
  • Knowledge of caching technologies and performance engineering.
  • Exposure to Microsoft .NET (C# .NET Core).
  • Experience within financial services, wealth management or fintech environments.
  • Experience building or integrating AI-enabled solutions.


Our process


We aim to keep the process simple and respectful of your time:

  • You’ll receive an acknowledgement after applying.
  • Our Talent team will review your application and keep you updated.
  • If shortlisted, we’ll connect to learn more about you.
  • Interviews may be virtual or in person.
  • You’ll receive an outcome and feedback.

If you need any adjustments, please let us know - we’re here to support you.


Our commitment

We’re committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and supported to do their best work. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences.

Agencies, we work with a panel of preferred suppliers and are not accepting any unsolicited CVs.

title: Infor M3/Infor OS (ION) Integration Expert
description:
Overview:

Mr. Greens has proudly grown into one of the largest privately-owned produce distributors in Georgia, Texas and Florida. With deliveries 365-days a year, 7-days a week and multiple runs per day, Mr. Greens has set the gold standard for service. Mr. Greens serves a large variety of clients, including restaurants, hotels, country clubs, caterers, grocery stores and retail outlets.

We are seeking an experienced Infor M3- Infor OS (ION) Integration Expert to serve as a technical integration specialist supporting the implementation and ongoing operation of Infor M3.

The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting integrations between Infor M3 CloudSuite and internal and external business applications.

This is a hands-on technical position requiring strong experience with Infor OS, ION, M3 APIs-MI transactions, API Gateway, Data Lake, BODs, integration workflows, and modern REST-based integration technologies.

The role will work closely with IT, business stakeholders, Infor functional consultants, implementation partners, and third-party vendors to ensure integrations are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned with business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop integrations between Infor M3 and third-party systems.
  • Develop and maintain integrations using Infor OS and ION.
  • Configure ION Desk, including document flows, connection points, mappings, workflows, and monitoring.
  • Develop and consume M3 APIs and MI transactions through Infor API Gateway.
  • Design integrations using REST APIs, JSON, XML, BODs, and event-driven integration patterns.
  • Determine the appropriate integration method, including M3 APIs, ION/BODs, Data Lake, or other supported Infor integration mechanisms.
  • Design both real-time and asynchronous integrations.
  • Integrate M3 with external systems including POS, EDI, WMS, transportation, financial, CRM, e-commerce, data warehouse, and analytics platforms.
  • Implement secure API authentication and authorization mechanisms.
  • Develop integration monitoring, logging, exception handling, retry, and reconciliation processes.
  • Troubleshoot production integration failures across M3, ION, API Gateway, and external applications.
  • Support data conversion, migration, synchronization, and validation activities.
  • Participate in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), cutover, go-live, and post-production stabilization.
  • Work with functional SMEs to translate business requirements into technical integration specifications.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, including interface specifications, data mappings, architecture diagrams, dependencies, and operational support procedures.
  • Establish development, testing, deployment, security, and production-support standards for M3 integrations.
  • Provide knowledge transfer and technical guidance to internal IT resources.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience with Infor M3, preferably including Infor M3 CloudSuite.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience developing production integrations using Infor OS / ION.
  • Advanced experience with ION Desk, Document Flows, Connection Points, and mappings.
  • Advanced experience with M3 APIs and MI transactions.
  • Strong experience with Infor API Gateway.
  • Experience implementing and troubleshooting BOD-based integrations.
  • Experience working with Infor Data Lake.
  • Strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, XML, and web-service integration.
  • Understanding of OAuth and API authentication/authorization.
  • Strong knowledge of synchronous and asynchronous integration architectures.
  • Experience implementing integration monitoring, exception handling, retry, reconciliation, and alerting.
  • Strong SQL and data-analysis skills.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex integrations across multiple systems.
  • Experience participating in an Infor M3 implementation, migration, upgrade, or major transformation project.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within distribution, wholesale, food distribution, supply chain, warehouse, or high-volume order-processing environments is strongly preferred.
  • Experience integrating M3 across business processes such as:
  • Customer & Pricing - Order Management - Inventory - Purchasing - Receiving - Warehouse - Transportation/Delivery - Invoicing -Financials
  • Experience with EDI, POS systems, WMS/TMS platforms, Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and enterprise data platforms is also preferred.

Critical Experience Requirement

  • This is not a general Infor M3 functional consultant or M3 support position.
  • Candidates must demonstrate hands-on technical experience personally designing, developing, deploying, and troubleshooting production integrations using Infor OS/ION, M3 APIs/MI transactions, and API Gateway.
  • Candidates whose experience is primarily functional configuration, project management, or M3 end-user support without hands-on integration development will not meet the technical requirements of this position.

Key Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong integration architecture, technical problem-solving, root-cause analysis, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

The candidate must also be capable of independently analyzing an integration requirement, selecting the appropriate Infor integration technology, developing the solution, testing it, deploying it, and supporting it in a production environment.

Physical Demands/ Work Environment

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • This position works in an office environment with low to moderate noise levels.
  • Individual sits for long periods of time while operating a keyboard and communicating via telephone.
  • May involve standing/walking as needed primarily on a level surface throughout the day.
  • May include lifting things up to 15 pounds, on occasion.

  • Vision
  • Dental

  • 401K

title: Senior Real Estate & Facilities Data Analyst
company: American Bankers Insurance Company of Florida
description:
Overview of Position

The Senior Real Estate & Facilities Analyst supports the Global Corporate Real Estate organization by transforming complex portfolio, financial, occupancy, lease, project, facilities, workplace, sustainability, and employee data into accurate reporting, actionable insights, and decision-support materials.

This role combines advanced analytics, data governance, business intelligence, technology enablement, and practical artificial intelligence capabilities with strong corporate real estate knowledge. The analyst develops dashboards, scorecards, forecasts, scenario models, business cases, and executive presentations that support portfolio optimization, workplace strategy, capital investment, lease decisions, operational improvement, and long-term planning.

The successful candidate is detail-oriented, technically capable, and able to communicate complex findings clearly to executive, financial, operational, and technical audiences while partnering effectively across functions and with external service providers.

What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?

Data Analytics, Governance & Portfolio Analysis (25%)

  • Collect, cleanse, reconcile, validate, manipulate, and analyze structured and unstructured data from multiple internal and external systems.

  • Maintain data standards, definitions, ownership, validation procedures, business rules, quality controls, and documentation across Corporate Real Estate data sources.

  • Monitor data quality, identify discrepancies and root causes, and coordinate remediation with internal teams and external service providers.

  • Analyze occupancy cost, utilization, lease activity, facilities operations, capital projects, sustainability, workplace experience, employee work arrangements, and portfolio risk.

  • Develop key performance indicators, benchmarks, forecasts, trends, scenario models, and ad hoc analyses to support portfolio optimization, site consolidation, workplace strategy, lease decisions, and capital investment.

Business Intelligence, Reporting & Technology (25%)

  • Build, manage, and continuously enhance centralized dashboards, scorecards, reporting tools, and analytical platforms for site-level and consolidated portfolio reporting.

  • Translate business requirements into scalable data, reporting, visualization, and technology solutions using advanced Excel and business-intelligence tools.

  • Automate recurring data collection, validation, analysis, and reporting to reduce manual effort and improve the speed, consistency, and reliability of insights.

  • Support system integrations, data pipelines, interfaces, data warehousing, application programming interfaces, and connections between source systems and reporting platforms.

  • Maintain recurring Real Estate & Facilities metrics, balanced scorecards, capital budgeting, fixed-asset reporting, and operational reporting as required.

Artificial Intelligence & Innovation (20%)

  • Serve as a Corporate Real Estate resource for artificial intelligence, generative AI, intelligent automation, and emerging analytical technologies.

  • Identify, prioritize, test, and implement practical AI use cases for document analysis, lease abstraction, portfolio research, forecasting, data-quality monitoring, executive reporting, and employee-service delivery.

  • Partner with Technology, Information Security, Legal, Risk, and Data Governance teams to support responsible and policy-compliant AI adoption.

  • Develop user guidance, demonstrations, training materials, and adoption support while maintaining awareness of developments in AI, analytics, commercial real estate technology, and workplace intelligence.

Executive Reporting & Decision Support (20%)

  • Convert complex data and analysis into clear, concise business recommendations, dashboards, scorecards, business cases, and executive presentations.

  • Communicate portfolio performance, risks, trends, opportunities, business impact, and recommended actions through effective data visualization and storytelling.

  • Tailor reporting for executive, operational, financial, and technical audiences and support annual planning, quarterly reviews, leadership meetings, and strategic initiatives.

Stakeholder & Program Support (10%)

  • Partner with Real Estate, Facilities, Finance, Procurement, Human Resources, Technology, Risk, Sustainability, Security, and regional teams to define business questions, reporting requirements, and priorities.

  • Coordinate cross-functional analytics and technology initiatives, including plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, deliverables, adoption, and performance measures.

  • Maintain productive relationships with service providers, technology vendors, consultants, and data partners; support continuous improvement and other analyses identified by leadership.

What are the requirements needed for this position?

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business analytics, information systems, computer science, finance, real estate, business administration, engineering, or a related field.

Professional Experience

  • Five or more years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data governance, technology, corporate real estate, finance, or a related discipline.

  • Experience developing complex analyses, dashboards, reports, data-quality processes, or technology-enabled solutions using information from multiple systems.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, PivotTables, Power Query, data modeling, scenario analysis, charts, and large-dataset manipulation.

  • Experience developing dashboards and visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable business-intelligence platform.

  • Understanding of data governance, data quality, master data, business definitions, controls, validation, and ownership.

  • Professional experience using artificial intelligence or generative AI tools and an understanding of responsible-use considerations.

  • Strong analytical, organizational, project-management, problem-solving, written, verbal, presentation, and executive-communication skills.

  • Ability to translate technical or analytical findings into clear business recommendations, manage multiple priorities independently, and collaborate across functions and organizational levels.

What other skills/experience would be helpful to have?

  • Masters degree in a relevant field.

Professional Experience

  • Experience supporting a geographically dispersed corporate real estate portfolio or working within a Fortune 500 company.

  • Knowledge of portfolio strategy, transactions, lease administration, occupancy planning, facilities management, capital projects, workplace experience, sustainability, financial modeling, forecasting, benchmarking, and scenario planning.

  • Experience with integrated workplace management systems, lease-administration platforms, facility-management systems, occupancy technologies, or corporate real estate databases.

  • Experience working with outsourced service providers, technology vendors, consultants, and cross-functional global teams.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, DAX, data warehouses, cloud platforms, application programming interfaces, or data-integration tools.

  • Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, or Copilot.

  • Experience implementing AI-enabled workflows, large language models, intelligent automation, or predictive analytics.

  • Intermediate or advanced Microsoft PowerPoint skills and strong data-visualization and storytelling capabilities.

  • Relevant certification in analytics, data governance, artificial intelligence, project management, Power BI, or commercial real estate.

description:
Job Summary:

The Director of Storage Tank Compliance Services leads all aspects of aboveground storage tank (“AST”) and underground storage tank (“UST”) compliance management services at the national level. This position is responsible for the strategic, technical, operational, and financial performance of a multidisciplinary environmental compliance practice.The Director oversees regulatory consulting, permitting, testing management, inspection services, spill response, release detection, remote monitoring, and related environmental management services. The role ensures that all work is performed in accordance with applicable federal and state regulations and company quality standards.

At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

The Global Spirit is how we work to fuel that long term commitment to success. As a Fortune 500 company with 90+ years of experience, we’re proud to fuel communities—responsibly and sustainably. We show up every day with grit, passion, and purpose—anticipating needs, building lasting relationships, and creating shared value.

Job Description:

  • Coordinate testing, inspections, maintenance activities, system upgrades, monitoring services, and compliance schedules.
  • Manage remote monitoring and release-detection programs for storage tank systems.
  • Evaluate operational risks and implement corrective measures to improve service quality and regulatory performance.
  • Maintain consistency in project execution and regulatory interpretation across Company portfolio.
  • Support the development and implementation of technology, systems, and processes that improve compliance tracking, data management, reporting, and service delivery.
  • Project Management
  • Develop strong, long-term relationships with regulatory agencies, contractors, consultants, and business partners.
  • Develop practical, cost-effective environmental compliance solutions.
  • Prepare scopes of work, proposals, budgets, schedules, staffing plans, and project-delivery strategies.
  • Monitor project performance, deliverables, budgets and schedules.

  • Ensure company commitment standards for quality, safety, ethics, and profitability are met.
  • Business Development and Strategic Growth

  • Prepare and review proposals, qualifications packages, presentations, and contract documents.
  • Participate in client meetings, interviews, conferences, and industry events.
  • Maintain awareness of market trends and regulatory developments.
  • Support corporate strategic planning, acquisitions, integrations, and service-line expansion, as applicable.

  • Develop annual budgets, staffing plans, and financial targets.
  • Review project financial performance and implement corrective actions when necessary.
  • Provide management with regular financial, operational, and development reports.
  • Team Leadership and Development
  • Recruit, lead, mentor, and develop environmental vendors and internal staff.
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, performance standards, and professional-development goals.
  • Provide technical guidance, coaching, and performance feedback.
  • Support employee retention, career progression, professional certifications, and continuing education.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, integrity, safety and regulatory excellence.
  • Ensure that staff members possess the training, certifications, and resources necessary to perform assigned work.
  • Quality, Risk, and Corporate Compliance
  • Ensure services comply with applicable laws, regulations, contracts, permits, Company policies, and professional standards.
  • Oversee technical quality assurance and quality-control procedures.
  • Identify and manage technical, regulatory, contractual, financial, and reputational risks.
  • Support internal and external audits and respond to findings or corrective-action requirements.
  • Promote safe work practices during inspections, testing, spill response, and field activities.
  • Maintain accurate and complete project, regulatory, financial, and client records.
  • Ensure sensitive Company information is handled appropriately.

  • Bachelor of Science in Environmental Studies, Sciences, Compliance or similar degree.
  • At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in environmental compliance.
  • Extensive experience leading AST and UST compliance management services.
  • Demonstrated responsibility for regulatory strategy, client management, project delivery, financial performance and team leadership.

title: Coding Specialist II
description:
Work Location

Virtual/Remote ONLY for living in the following states: TX, FL, AR, WI

Primary Purpose

The primary purpose of the Coding Specialist II is to code and verify charge data necessary to ensure correct coding, abstracting and billing on emergency department (ED), same day surgery (SDS), outpatient clinic (OPC),observation (OBS), specialty clinics and/or inpatient OB/newborn encounters. This role is also responsible for charge review on clinic and hospital visits to ensure accurate professional charging and billing. This position requires the coder to be highly proficient in the proper assignment of ICD-10 CM, PCS, CPT, HCPCS, HCC, HEDIS CAT II, E/M and modifier codes. Demonstrates the ability to provide direction to coding staff as it relates to coding integrity, established coding guidelines and Parkland’s policies to ensure accuracy of recorded patient medical information and appropriate reimbursement for services rendered.

Education

•High school diploma required.

•Must have successfully completed an approved coding program.

•OR Must be a graduate of a health Information Management program.

•Must have strong knowledge of Anatomy and Physiology and possess strong application skills.

•OR Must be CCS Certified

Experience

•Must have two (2) years of coding experience in an acute care setting or diverse clinical specialties.

•Physician office coding, charging, and billing experience preferred.

Equivalent Education and/or Experience

•May have an equivalent combination of education and/or experience in lieu of specific education and/or experience as stated above.

Certification/Registration/Licensure

•Because of the lag in SCCE, HCCA, NCRA, and AHIMA updating the status of certifications, current employees whose certification is granted through one of these associations are allowed up to seven (7) calendar days, after expiration, to provide proof of renewal. Although an additional seven (7) calendar days is allowed to provide proof of renewal, there cannot be a lapse in the certification’s “active” status.

•Must be certified through the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) as one of the following:

•Registered Health Information Management Technician (RHIT)

•Registered Health Information Management Administrator (RHIA)

•Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)

•Certified Coding Specialist – Physician Based (CCS-P)

•Certified Coding Associate (CCA) certification

•OR Must be certified through the American Association of Procedural Coders (AAPC) as one of the following:

•Certified Professional Coder (CPC)

•Certified Professional Coder-Hospital (CPC-H)

•Certified Outpatient Coder (COC)

Required Tests for Placement

•Score a minimum of 80% on a pre-employment inpatient/outpatient coding test. Contract coders with a proven coding accuracy rate of 95% at Parkland Health and Hospital System are exempt from this requirement.

Skills or Special Abilities

•Advance coding and charge review skills understanding the utilization of modifiers and other coding, charging and billing rules to include AMA and other state and federal organizations.

•Advanced knowledge of ICD-9/ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT-4/HCPCS, HCC and HEDIS CAT II, E/M coding and abstracting, APC classification and reimbursement structures, applicable coding edits and general knowledge of Local Coverage for hospital and professional billing.

•Score a minimum of 80% on a pre-employment coding test. Contract coders with a proven coding accuracy rate of 95% at Parkland Health and Hospital System are exempt from this requirement.

•Must have knowledge of medical terminology, the human disease process, anatomy and physiology.

•Demonstrate proficiency in coding and encoder skills.

•Demonstrate knowledge of computer software applications including MS Office and Computer Assisted Coding (CAC).

•Knowledge of Epic EHR and 3M 360 coding and abstracting software is preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Code, abstract and conduct charge quality review on all episodes of care on emergency department (ED), same day surgery (SDS), outpatient clinic (OPC),observation (OBS) and/or inpatient OB/newborn hospital and specialty clinic encounters according to coding conventions, guidelines and hospital policy, analyzing questionable documentation to ensure to the accuracy of information and resolves identified issues.
  • Assigns appropriate diagnosis and procedures codes utilizing ICD 10-CM/PCS, CPT, HCPCS, HCC and HEDIS CAT II, E/M codes according to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) requirements for both professional and hospital billing. May assist in training and reviewing the work of other coders for accuracy and efficiency.
  • Achieve and maintain 95% accuracy on quality reviews and assigned productivity standards.
  • May verify, edit and/or enter charges based on documentation or payer/billing requirements reporting any discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Updates, as appropriate, patient database with classification codes and resolves conflicts or inconsistencies to provide sufficient patient health information according to Parkland’s standards.
  • Stays abreast of the latest developments, advancements, and trends in the field of health information management by attending workshops, reading professional journals, actively participating in professional organizations, and integrates knowledge gained into current work practices.
  • Identifies ways to improve work processes and improve customer satisfaction. Makes recommendations to supervisor, implements, and monitors results as appropriate in support of the overall goals of the department and Parkland.
  • Facilitate a positive working relationship with physicians, nurses, and medical staff and hospital employees to ensure that all work related encounters are productive.
  • Maintains knowledge of applicable rules, regulations, policies, laws and guidelines that impact the Coding area. Develops effective internal controls designed to promote adherence with applicable laws, accreditation agency requirements, and federal, state, and private health plans. Seeks advice and guidance as needed to ensure proper understanding.
  • Maintains CE hours and renew annual coding credentials.
  • This position is 100% Virtual. Virtual employees must also comply with all Parkland policies and procedures governing the use of Parkland information resources. Virtual employees must maintain all equipment lent by Parkland for performing the agreed upon job duties in good working condition. All employment responsibilities and conditions in applicable Parkland policies and procedures apply to employees while working virtually.

Job Accountabilities

  • Identifies ways to improve work processes and improve customer satisfaction. Makes recommendations to supervisor, implements, and monitors results as appropriate in support of the overall goals of the department and Parkland.
  • Stays abreast of the latest developments, advancements, and trends in the field by attending seminars/workshops, reading professional journals, actively participating in professional organizations, and/or maintaining certification or licensure. Integrates knowledge gained into current work practices.
  • Maintains knowledge of applicable rules, regulations, policies, laws and guidelines that impact the area. Develops effective internal controls designed to promote adherence with applicable laws, accreditation agency requirements, and federal, state, and private health plans. Seeks advice and guidance as needed to ensure proper understanding.

At Global Partners, business starts with people. Since 1933, we’ve believed in taking care of our customers, our guests, our communities, and each other—and that belief continues to guide us.

title: Expressions of Interest – Research and Development Team – Systematic Hedge Fund
description:
Expressions of Interest — Research and Development Team — Systematic Hedge Fund

Thank you for your interest in AE Capital. We’re always keen to hear from outstanding talent, even outside of an active hiring round.

If you’re interested in joining a systematic hedge fund that trades FX and Futures markets through a combination of top-down fundamental research, machine learning and rigorous quantitative modelling, we’d love to hear from you.

About Us

AE Capital is a team of market specialists, data scientists and engineers. Our team applies top-down fundamental analysis, machine learning and software engineering to financial markets.

We build systematic trading strategies for clients worldwide, grounded in a deep understanding of the fundamental drivers behind economies, industries and markets — and how that evolves over time.

About You

You’re articulate, intelligent, naturally inquisitive, and thrive in environments that encourage new ideas and value thought leadership.

We welcome interest from a range of backgrounds, including:

  • Recent graduates with a Bachelors, Masters or PhD in Physics, Atmospheric Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering or an equivalent STEM discipline
  • Software engineers
  • Quantitative developers
  • Computer scientists
  • Research scientists

Typical Roles at AEC

The research and development team falls into three camps:

  • Software engineering — owning important components of our trading, data and infrastructure platforms
  • Quantitative development — building research platforms, model infrastructure, data pipelines and back-testing tools
  • Quantitative analysis — analysing market and trading data, testing hypotheses and contributing to the prediction of financial markets

We’re happy to consider both entry-level and experienced applicants. Previous finance or trading experience is not essential.

Full working rights in Australia required. Sponsorship is not available.

Our Hiring Process

While we don’t currently have a specific vacancy open, when a role does arise our process typically moves quickly:

  • A technical screen
  • A whiteboard session
  • A team conversation

Register Your Interest

If you’re accountable, professional, and want to work with some of the brightest people in the business on genuinely hard problems, we encourage you to register your interest.

title: B2B-myyntikumppani – rakenna asiakaskantaa, joka tuottaa pitkään
description:
B2B-myyntikumppani – rakenna omaa asiakaskantaasi

Entä jos yksi onnistunut asiakashankinta voisi tuoda sinulle provisiota vielä kuukausien tai jopa vuosien päästä?

Duunex etsii motivoituneita B2B-myyntikumppaneita kasvavaan myyntiverkostoon.

Myyt yrityksille tuotteita, joita ne tarvitsevat toiminnassaan jatkuvasti – kuten paperi-, hygienia-, siivous- ja muita käyttötarvikkeita.

Ja juuri tässä tulee mallin kiinnostavin osa:

Kun hankkimasi asiakas jatkaa tilaamista, saat provisiota myös asiakkaan myöhemmistä tilauksista.

Eli tavoite ei ole tehdä yhtä kauppaa ja aloittaa ensi kuussa taas nollasta.

Tavoite on rakentaa omaa asiakaskantaa.

AJATTELE LUMIPALLOA

Hankit ensimmäisen asiakkaan.

Asiakas tilaa. saat provision.

Hankit seuraavan asiakkaan.

Uusi asiakas tilaa + ensimmäinen asiakas tilaa uudelleen.

Hankit lisää asiakkaita.

Asiakaskanta kasvaa jatkotilauksia tulee enemmän provisio kasvaa.

Paperi loppuu. Saippua loppuu. Käsipyyhkeet loppuvat. Jätesäkkejä tarvitaan lisää.

Yritykset joutuvat ostamaan näitä tuotteita uudelleen.

Et rakenna joka kuukausi uutta lumipalloa. Kasvatat sitä, jonka olet jo aloittanut.

MITÄ ENEMMÄN SAAT AIKAAN, SITÄ ENEMMÄN SAAT

Mitä suuremman aktiivisen asiakaskannan rakennat, sitä suuremmaksi myös aikaisemmin tekemäsi myyntityön arvo voi kasvaa.

Hyvän asiakaskannan rakentanut myyjä voi pääsee useiden tuhansien eurojen kuukausiansioihin.

Ansiot eivät ole taattuja, vaan riippuvat täysin omasta myyntituloksesta, asiakkaiden ostamisesta, katteesta ja asiakkuuksien kestosta.

MITÄ TEET KÄYTÄNNÖSSÄ?

Sun tehtäväsi on:

etsiä yrityksiä avata keskustelu selvittää tarve tehdä kauppa.

Voit esimerkiksi:

- soittaa yrityksille - käydä paikan päällä - sopia tapaamisia - hyödyntää omia kontaktejasi - etsiä uusia potentiaalisia asiakkaita

Saat valmiiksi:

tuotteet, hinnat, myyntimateriaalit, perehdytyksen, myyntiohjeet ja tuen.

Kun asiakas on saatu sisään, me hoidamme normaalit jatkotilaukset, toimitukset, laskutuksen ja asiakaspalvelun.

Sinä voit keskittyä siihen, missä ansaintasi kasvaa: seuraavan hyvän asiakkaan hankkimiseen.

TEE SILLOIN KUN SINULLE SOPII

Ei työvuoroja.

Päätät itse milloin ja kuinka paljon teet.

Tätä voi tehdä esimerkiksi:

- opiskelun ohella - muun työn ohella - yrittäjyyden rinnalla - tai tavoitteellisesti suuremmalla panoksella

Kyseessä on itsenäinen myyntikumppanuus, ei tavallinen työsuhde.

KENELLE TÄMÄ SOPII?

Et tarvitse valmiiksi vuosien myyntikokemusta.

Arvostamme enemmän sitä, että:

- uskallat ottaa yrityksiin yhteyttä - olet oma-aloitteinen - haluat kehittyä myyjänä - et luovuta ensimmäisen ei:n jälkeen - haluat oikeasti rakentaa jotain ajan kanssa

Myyntikokemus on tietenkin plussaa.

Kyseessä ei ole tavallinen työsuhteinen työpaikka, vaan itsenäinen myyntikumppanuus.

Jos sait tätä lukiessa ajatuksen:

Hetkinen, tämähän voisi oikeasti olla aika kova.

Lähetä hakemuksesi, CV:si ja puhelinnumerosi sähköpostitse osoitteeseen: info@duunex.fi Myös mahdolliset kysymykset voit lähettää samaan osoitteeseen.

Käydään sen jälkeen homma henkilökohtaisesti läpi.

Duunex

Hanki asiakkaita tänään. Rakenna tuloa myös huomiselle.

title: Graduate Software Engineer
description:
Right across infrastructure, there’s a requirement to not only maintain, but also renew and reimagine. Whatever stage you’re at in your career, with us you’ll have an opportunity to grow and develop. Delivering essential infrastructure services for life, while being safety first, and client and customer centric in a friendly, fun and respectful environment where you are encouraged to thrive.

Where will you be working?

Telent, part of M Group, is a leading technology company and specialist in the design, build, support and management of the UK’s critical digital infrastructure.

From the roads you drive on to the networks you rely on, our solutions are embedded in the everyday lives of millions supporting the delivery of vital public services. With decades of expertise in mission-critical communications and infrastructure technology, we are at the forefront of the digital revolution.

The work we do helps connect thousands of people and communities, using the best technology and innovation available. When you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact on all our futures by fulfilling your potential and delivering high performance. We work together to make everyday life work better for everyone.

About the role

We’re looking for a

Graduate Software Engineer

to join Telent, where you will apply your existing knowledge and skills working on real projects, whilst learning new skills along the way. You’ll have the opportunity to work on a range of different projects as well as progress your continuous professional development and become IET accredited.

This is a hybrid role with a blend of homeworking, working from the office based and occasional site visits.

What you’ll be doing

Work within agile software development teams to deliver high-quality solutions for critical digital infrastructure projects.

Design, develop and test software applications using languages and frameworks such as C#, Java, JavaScript and SQL.

Support integration and deployment of software systems, from requirements gathering through to delivery and commissioning.

Assist in troubleshooting, debugging and resolving software issues, ensuring systems perform reliably and securely in real-world environments.

Learn and apply industry best practices in coding, version control, testing, and documentation.

Participate in code reviews and collaborate with peers and senior engineers to enhance code quality and share knowledge.

Work closely with cross-functional teams including project managers, engineers, and external stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.

Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, adopting new tools, technologies, and methodologies that enhance project outcomes.

Access ongoing mentoring and training, progressing towards professional accreditation and developing both your technical and leadership capabilities.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a recent Graduate that has studied

Computer Science, Software Engineering, Maths or Physics

Experience of using C#, Java, web-based technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript Frameworks and SQL Service or other related platforms

A flair for solving complex technical issues and can identify and understand risk to a Project

Strong organisational skills and attention to detail

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, combined with proven team working and leadership abilities

Self-motivation, able to work on your own initiative and under pressure

Practical use of Microsoft Office applications

What’s in it for you?

A career at Telent provides the opportunity to work on complex, high-profile infrastructure projects that keep the UK connected and protected 24/7.

You'll benefit from:

Competitive starting salary

34 days annual leave which includes all public bank holidays, with option to buy/sell annual leave

Company pension scheme

Access to the flexible benefits and wellbeing support portal

Family-friendly policies

Discounts on retail, leisure, and entertainment

As a Telent Graduate, you will also benefit from the M Group Evolve and Thrive Development Programme

A structured development programme designed to help graduate and degree apprentices to build the skills, experience and confidence needed to become one of M Group's future leaders. Throughout your journey, you'll broaden your knowledge, develop your professional capabilities and benefit from a supportive network that empowers you to achieve your full potential.

Tailored development opportunities

including face-to-face development events, virtual workshops and team-building experiences. These opportunities are designed to strengthen your leadership, communication and collaboration skills while helping you build connections across the business.

A structured learning journey

covering a range of topics including leadership, communication, commercial awareness, sustainability, project management and AI, helping you develop the skills needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving industry.

Networking opportunities

with graduates, degree apprentices, business leaders and colleagues from across M Group, enabling you to build meaningful relationships and expand your professional network.

Professional development support , with access to guidance, resources and support to help you work towards relevant professional qualifications and achieve your long-term career ambitions.

A strong support network

from our Early Careers Team, business leaders and peers across the organisation, providing encouragement, insight and practical support throughout your development journey.

At M Group, we're committed to helping you grow and succeed, providing the experiences, connections and opportunities you need to thrive in your career and make a lasting impact.

At Telent, we’re committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels valued, supported, and able to thrive. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage diverse perspectives across our teams.

We are guided by our values and behaviours:

Be Inclusive

Take Responsibility

Collaborate

Be Customer-focussed

Join us and help deliver critical infrastructure projects that make a real difference.

It’s an exceptional time to be a part of M Group.

title: Technical Intern, Materials and Battery Engineering
description:
About us

HARDDRIVE is a Singapore-based engineering consultancy. We work across energy systems, advanced materials, medtech, electronics manufacturing and industrial supply chain. Companies bring us their systems when they need an independent engineer to assess whether the design is safe, whether it will perform as claimed and what will fail first.

A significant part of our work sits in energy. We work with cell and battery developers, system integrators and the operators who run battery systems in the field, across manufacturing, marine, mobility, data centre and industrial applications. That spans advanced cell development support, pack and system architecture review, charging and BMS assessment, failure investigation, test and commissioning, and independent technical review for owners, insurers and financiers.

We are small, the work is real and nothing here is a training exercise.

The role

You will work directly with the founder on live client projects. This is not a shadowing internship. You will be handed scope, given the source documents and expected to produce analysis that goes into a deliverable a client is paying for, with our review.

We are looking for someone who has already touched batteries in a lab, a test bench or a production environment and now wants to see how that knowledge is applied commercially, under a deadline, with a client on the other side.

You will be given scope, the source documents and a deadline, then left to it. We will review your work and push back hard on it, but we will not walk you through it step by step. You are expected to flag what you do not know early, then go and close the gap yourself.

What you will do

• Review datasheets, specifications and design documentation for battery packs, BMS units, chargers and inverters, and identify where the numbers do not agree with each other

• Support independent safety reviews: charging architecture, cell chemistry limits, BMS threshold configuration, protection logic and series or parallel topology

• Build and maintain technical risk registers, mapping failure modes to severity, likelihood and mitigation

• Draft test and commissioning plans, then support remote review of verification evidence and integrated safety testing

• Research and benchmark cell chemistries, materials and competing system architectures for client decisions

• Write clean, cited technical documentation to our reporting standard

• Contribute to project work outside batteries as it comes in. Materials selection, failure analysis and reliability work all show up here

Who we are looking for

• Degree or final-year study in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering

• Prior hands-on battery experience is required. Research lab, coin or pouch cell fabrication, pack assembly, battery test lab, QA or a previous industry internship all count. Tell us what you actually did, not what the group worked on

• Working understanding of Li-ion cell chemistry and how NMC, LFP, LCO and NCA differ in voltage window, energy density, thermal behaviour and failure mode

• Familiarity with at least some of: cycling and capacity fade testing, internal resistance or EIS measurement, thermal characterisation, SEM, XRD, DSC or TGA, glovebox work, BMS configuration, pack-level integration

• You are careful with numbers. In this work a decimal place is the difference between a safe recommendation and a dangerous one

• You can write. Technical judgment that cannot be explained on paper is worth nothing to a client

• You work independently and say so when you are stuck. Asking a sharp question on day two is fine. Going quiet for a week and producing nothing is not

Nice to have, not required

• Exposure to battery and energy storage standards: IEC 62619, IEC 62133, UN 38.3, UL 1973 or UL 9540A

• Comfortable using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT in a technical workflow, with a clear sense of where they stop being trustworthy

• Any experience with BESS, inverters, EV systems or power electronics

What you get

• Direct mentorship from the founder on live commercial engineering work

• Ownership of your own workstreams inside real projects, not a supporting role on someone else's

• Exposure to how independent technical assessment is scoped, priced and defended in front of a client

• A portfolio of real project contributions and a written reference

• Monthly stipend

Details

• Location: Singapore. Fully remote

• Duration: 3 to 6 months, with flexibility around your academic schedule

• Start: Immediate or by arrangement

• Eligibility: Open to Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents only

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note to harddrivecareers@gmail.com. In the note, answer this in under five sentences: describe one battery failure mode you have seen, read about or tested, explain the physical mechanism behind it and tell us what you would check in a design review to catch it early.

We read every application. If your answer is good you will hear from us within a week.

title: Clinical Lead Early Clinical and Experimental Therapeutics Oncology
description:
Job title: Clinical Lead Early Development and Experimental Therapeutics - Oncology

  • Location: Cambridge, MA or Morristown, NJ

About the job

This is an exciting opportunity to address unmet needs in oncology by developing an inhibitor of a key signalling pathway – as monotherapy and in potential combination with agents of varied modality. The successful candidate will also help translate a portfolio of preclinical assets into human studies.

The position falls within the Translational Medicine Unit (TMU) Clinical Patient Services (CPS) Team to support the Global Early Clinical and Experimental Therapeutics (ECET) Oncology Team. This role works within global asset teams to design and lead early clinical development of oncology assets such as small molecules, monoclonal antibodies, antibody drug conjugates and immune cell engagers, for solid tumors or hematologic malignancies. This position will be responsible for the early clinical development of RAS-associated pathway inhibitor(s), as well as some pre-clinical assets.

In addition to being an integral part of the Oncology ECET Team, the individual in this position is key member of asset Global Project Teams, Translational Medicine Subteams and Development disease area teams from preclinical development through phase 2a. A key focus of this role is to support the path from the research phase through early clinical development including early and rapid Proof-of-Mechanism/Proof-of-Concept, as well as natural history studies and experimental model validation to contribute to Human Target Validation (HTV) and evaluating the pharmacology of novel therapeutic approaches. Additionally, to identify potential signals of efficacy or safety notably for new indications and gain better understanding on the mode of action, signal seeking clinical and mechanistic trials are in the scope of expertise for this role.

Collaborative interactions with research scientists, toxicologists, pharmacokineticists, modelling & simulation experts, biomarker experts, and late phase therapeutic area clinicians are critical to success in the role. Operationally, this role will coordinate work by regulatory, safety/pharmacovigilance, biostatistics, biomarker and PK, and clinical operations, including oversite of CROs. The ability to integrate the outputs of multiple disciplines into a coherent translational medicine and human target validation plan and successful clinical trial is essential.

Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

About Sanofi

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:

At the project level, the Clinical Lead, ECET Oncology will be a member of the asset Global Project Team and the Translational Medicine Subteam. In these roles, duties include:

  • Design safe, rapid and informative First-In-Human studies for oncology assets potentially including natural history, experimental model validation, mechanistic and signal seeking, streamlined Proof-of-Mechanism as well as Proof-of-Concept studies providing robust data for early Go/No Go decisions and other pharmacokinetic studies.

  • Participate in designing the plans for the different steps of clinical development, integrating these into to the overall development strategy in collaboration with the responsible Therapeutic Areas in research and development.

  • Provide medical/clinical expertise and context to guide strategy for pre-clinical data generation and interpretation for oncology assets.

  • Decision Making Authority: Make front-line decisions on protocol design, execution, dose escalation and safety, information for Regulatory authorities.

In this role, you will contribute meaningfully to building and maintaining our audit logging pipelines. This position is intended to represent WeDriveU's interests throughout the implementation. The Project Manager must be able to challenge incomplete plans, identify gaps before they affect the project, hold internal and external resources accountable, and ensure that business readiness receives the same attention as technical configuration.

This is a fixed-term position expected to last approximately 12 to 18 months based on implementation needs. The position is expected to conclude after implementation, stabilization, project closure, and transition activities are completed.

Essential Responsibilities

• Serve as WeDriveU's internal project manager for the Workday implementation.

• Develop, maintain, and manage the integrated project plan across functional, technical, data, testing, training, change management, payroll, security, and deployment workstreams.

• Establish the project governance structure, meeting cadence, decision-making process, escalation path, and reporting expectations.

• Coordinate activities among WeDriveU stakeholders, Workday, the implementation partner, third-party vendors, and other project resources.

• Define project roles, responsibilities, deliverables, dependencies, milestones, and due dates.

• Confirm that internal business and technical resources understand their responsibilities and have sufficient capacity to complete assigned work.

• Track project progress against scope, schedule, budget, resource plans, contracts, and approved implementation objectives.

• Maintain the project schedule, milestone tracker, risk register, issue log, decision log, action log, dependency tracker, scope-change log, and project documentation repository.

• Facilitate project team meetings, workstream meetings, steering committee meetings, readiness reviews, and executive updates.

• Prepare clear status reports showing completed work, upcoming milestones, decisions required, risks, issues, dependencies, budget considerations, and corrective actions.

• Identify schedule delays, resource constraints, unresolved decisions, scope gaps, and cross-functional dependencies before they materially affect the project.

• Hold internal teams, implementation partners, and vendors accountable for agreed deliverables and deadlines.

• Manage the project's change-control process and ensure that scope, cost, timing, operational impact, and resource requirements are understood before changes are approved.

• Coordinate requirements gathering, design, configuration, data conversion, integration development, testing, training, deployment, and stabilization activities.

• Ensure project plans include sufficient time and ownership for data validation, end-to-end testing, payroll parallel testing, user acceptance testing, defect resolution, training, and operational readiness.

• Partner with the Functional Consultant and Technical Integration Lead to coordinate workstream dependencies and resolve cross-functional issues.

• Coordinate with Payroll leadership to ensure payroll requirements, testing, reconciliation, compliance, and cutover activities are fully integrated into the overall plan.

• Manage vendor dependencies and monitor third-party deliverables that may affect implementation timing or readiness.

• Review implementation partner plans and deliverables for completeness, feasibility, sequencing, and alignment with WeDriveU's business requirements.

• Monitor professional services utilization, project expenses, change orders, and potential budget impacts.

• Escalate unresolved issues and decisions through the appropriate governance structure.

• Establish clear milestone-entry and milestone-exit criteria.

• Coordinate go-live readiness assessments and ensure unresolved items have documented owners, mitigation plans, and leadership visibility.

• Develop and manage the cutover plan, including system activities, business activities, communications, validation, contingency planning, and decision checkpoints.

• Coordinate command-center activities and issue management during go-live and stabilization.

• Ensure that knowledge transfer, documentation, support ownership, and transition requirements are completed before project closure.

• Conduct project closeout activities, document lessons learned, confirm acceptance of deliverables, and transition remaining work to the ongoing support organization.

• Perform other implementation-related responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Human Resources, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• At least seven years of project or program management experience involving enterprise systems, HR technology, payroll, finance, or organizational transformation.

• Experience managing at least one full Workday implementation or a similarly complex enterprise cloud-system implementation.

• Experience managing projects with multiple functional workstreams, technical integrations, data conversion, testing, training, vendors, and executive stakeholders.

• Demonstrated ability to develop and manage detailed integrated project plans.

• Experience with project governance, risk management, issue management, change control, budget tracking, resource planning, and executive reporting.

• Experience managing external implementation partners, consultants, and third-party vendors.

• Strong understanding of enterprise implementation lifecycles and dependencies.

• Ability to facilitate decisions and resolve issues involving competing business priorities.

• Strong written, verbal, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain attention to detail in a fast-paced implementation environment.

• Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools.

Preferred Qualifications

• Project Management Professional certification, Program Management Professional certification, or comparable project management credential.

  • Spanish fluency is preferred.

• Workday implementation methodology experience or formal Workday project management training.

• Experience managing a Workday HCM, Payroll, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Benefits, or Financial Management implementation.

• Experience managing the transition from ADP or another enterprise HR and payroll platform to Workday.

• Experience supporting a complex, geographically dispersed, multi-state, hourly, or frontline workforce.

• Experience in transportation, union, or regulated operating environments.

• Experience with payroll parallel testing, data conversion, change management, end-user training, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization.

• Experience establishing an internal governance and support model following implementation.

Workday certification is preferred but not required. Access to Workday certification is often limited to individuals with prior employment at a Workday customer or partner, so equivalent hands-on Workday experience will be considered in place of formal certification.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

• Strong understanding of project governance and disciplined implementation management.

• Ability to see connections and dependencies across functional, technical, operational, and vendor workstreams.

• Ability to communicate project status honestly and clearly, including when milestones are at risk.

• Ability to distinguish between urgent activity and work that is critical to successful implementation.

• Strong meeting facilitation and decision-management skills.

• Ability to hold stakeholders accountable while maintaining productive working relationships.

• Ability to summarize complex issues for senior leadership and recommend practical next steps.

• Strong judgment regarding when an issue can be resolved within a workstream and when it requires escalation.

• High attention to detail and commitment to accurate project reporting and documentation.

• Ability to operate independently while maintaining strong alignment with executive sponsors and project leadership.

Fixed-Term Employment
This position is being established to support WeDriveU's Workday implementation and is expected to remain active for approximately 12 to 18 months. The actual duration may vary based on implementation requirements, project timing, stabilization needs, and business circumstances. This position is not intended to become a permanent role and is expected to conclude after the assigned implementation and transition responsibilities are completed.

Reasonable accommodations may be provided to qualified individuals with disabilities.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Center
description:
Job Details:

Job Description:

Intel is shaping the future of data center computing through technologies powering critical cloud, AI, enterprise, and high-performance computing workloads.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Data Center to drive the strategy, execution, and lifecycle of next-generation Intel® Xeon® products. This highly visible role operates at the intersection of technology, customers, and business strategy, translating market insights, customer needs, and technical trade-offs into product decisions that strengthen competitive positioning and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical acumen, strategic thinking, customer focus, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across a highly matrixed organization.

What You'll Do

Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

Product Ownership & Lifecycle Leadership

  • Own a Xeon product through its full lifecycle: product definition, planning, development, production, launch, and end‑of‑life.
  • Serve as the central point of coordination across design, architecture, process technology, manufacturing, test, quality, and marketing.
  • Maintain lifecycle accountability, including upgrades, feature changes, and product sustaining decisions.

Product Strategy & Roadmap Influence

  • Apply competitive intelligence, customer insights, and workload analysis to influence product priorities within the broader Xeon portfolio framework.
  • Partner with platform and system architects to assess emerging technologies and provide informed recommendations for future product investments.
  • Translate customer and ecosystem feedback into actionable inputs for roadmap and feature decisions.

Competitive Positioning & Product Messaging

  • Analyze the competitive landscape and define product positioning that clearly communicates customer value.
  • Develop performance leadership narratives grounded in real workload KPIs, not just specifications.
  • Support go‑to‑market planning and engage with customers and ecosystem partners to validate workloads, use cases, and performance targets.

Technology Readiness & Launch Execution

  • Own workload and KPI readiness gates, driving execution across validation, debug, and performance optimization teams.
  • Represent product readiness, risks, and mitigation plans in executive and cross‑organizational reviews.
  • Support global product launches in partnership with marketing, communications, PR, and sales enablement teams.

Cross‑Functional Leadership

  • Align engineering, marketing, manufacturing, and business stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, and definitions of success.
  • Drive convergence across validation, debug, and performance teams to ensure outcomes reflect real customer requirements.
  • Operate effectively in a highly matrixed environment, influencing without direct authority.

Behavioral traits that we are looking for:

  • Strategic thinker with strong business judgment.
  • Customer-focused and data-driven.
  • Strong executive communication and influence.
  • Comfortable making decisions in ambiguous environments.
  • Proven ability to align senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Strong ownership and results orientation.

Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life.

  • See Intel Benefits for more details.

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's in Electrical /Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or STEM related field with 7+ year of experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in semiconductor product management, technical marketing, or product architecture.
  • 7+ years of experience owning end‑to‑end hardware or platform products, including launch and lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated depth operating at the system or platform level.
  • Proven track record owning product decisions under ambiguity — including setting success criteria, driving tradeoffs, and carrying consequences.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead senior engineering stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Ability to articulate a coherent product narrative that connects architecture intent, workload performance, competitive positioning, and customer value.
  • MBA or equivalent experience translating technical tradeoffs into business, portfolio, and market implications.
  • Direct experience with server or datacenter platform business involving CPU, memory, and I/O.
  • Demonstrated exposure to hyperscale, CSP, or OEM/ODM customers or ecosystems.
  • Hands‑on involvement with workload‑based performance or benchmarking frameworks (e.g., MLPerf, SPEC, TPC, or equivalent internal systems).

Help shape the future of data center computing by driving Intel® Xeon® products that power critical cloud, AI, and enterprise workloads worldwide. Collaborate with leading technologists and customers to turn breakthrough innovation into meaningful business and customer impact. Apply today and help define what’s next in data center computing.

description:
